bluejetty:00027172:ios.description:
NAVITIME Transit Tokyo Japan is a transfer information app that allows you to easily search for necessary information such as timetables and route information anywhere in Japan, easy to understand route maps, and the locations of boarding areas to transfer smoothly. It supports not only trains, but also provides transfer routes, travel time, and fares for nationwide air travel, city buses, highway buses, ferries, and more.
=====================================
【About Premium Course (paid subscription)】
■ Rates form
Monthly ticket (automatic update): 400 yen (including tax) / month
1-year ticket: 3,000 yen (including tax) / year
■ Details
"The agreement to Terms of Use" is necessary for the registration to the premium course.
It will be charged to your iTunes account by the registration to the premium course.
Monthly ticket uses "Auto Renewable Subscription".
Accounting of auto-renewal is done until the end from the 24 hours prior to the effective end of the period.
■ Automatic Update Release method
Canceling or setting of auto renewable subscription can be changed in the "Settings"> "Store"> "Apple ID"> "subscription management"> "Auto-update".
You can cancel of auto renewable subscription by setting to "turn off the automatic update" from the "Settings" 24-hours or more prior to the effective end of the period.
■ Terms of Use
https://touch.navitime.co.jp/touchstorage/html/app/transfer/common/terms.html
■ Privacy Policy
https://touch.navitime.co.jp/touchstorage/html/app/transfer/iphone/privacy.html
※ By registration of premium courses, both iPhone and iPad are available.
※ iPad is not supported by "operation information on the diagram route" and "My line of service notification".
※ You can do the release and setting of similar verification and automatic update from iTunes.
※ If you purchase a premium course during the free trial period, the remaining free trial period that was offered will expire.
=====================================

PROMT.One is an online and offline translator, a dictionary with transcription and phrasebooks .
FREE ONLINE VERSION OPTIONS
- 3-in-1: translator, dictionary and phrasebook
- Speech and text translation in “Dialog” mode 
- Text translation in images and photos
- Voice input and pronunciation
- Roaming traffic saving mode
PREMIUM OFFLINE SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS 
- 7-day free trial period
- ADS FREE app 
- Offline Translator, Phrasebook and Dictionary 
- 7 popular languages are accessible for offline translation: 
English, French, German, Russian, Spanish, Italian, Portugal
- and 20 languages are always accessible online
TRANSLATION IN “DIALOG” MODE
Speech translation in dialog mode allows you to communicate easily at any time and place. Choose the languages for communication, speak your native language and receive a translation of your dialog partner speech.
TRANSLATE IN ANY APP
Just copy the selected text fragment, its translation appears in the notification area. Context menu is also accessible for work with texts in any app for iOS.
PHOTO TRANSLATION
Translation of text directly from camera or from gallery photos. Just select a text fragment or a word at the image.
SPEAK AND LISTEN
It is not necessary to type text, just pronounce a phrase and listen to its translation. It is convenient at the travel abroad and during foreign languages studies!
STUDY LANGUAGES EASILY
Use the app as a full-fledged dictionary containing translations of words from different subjects areas, information about parts of speech and transcription. You also can listen how a word and any of its translations are pronounced.
SAVE ROAMING TRAFFIC
Special mode which allows you to minimize mobile web traffic when you translate during travel abroad. 
TRANSLATION FOR POPULAR LANGUAGES
English, Arabic, Greek, Hebrew, Spanish, Italian, Kazakh, Chinese (simplified), Korean, German, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Finnish, French, Japanese.
Required Permissions:
• Microphone - for speech translation
• Camera – for translation of text from images
Subscription Terms of Use:
https://www.promt.com/mobile/translate/eula/

Don’t give us a poor mark immediately. If the app didn’t meet your expectations, please contact us at support@promt.com and we will improve the product for your special benefit!

bluejetty:00021907:ios.summary:

Created by experts in early education and neurop
bluejetty:00021907:ios.description:
Welcome to the adventure of learning by playing!
Kokoro Kids is an educational games application where children learn while having fun with hundreds of games, activities, stories and songs.
Created by experts in early education and neuropsychology to help in the emotional and cognitive development of the little ones, based on game-based learning and the theory of multiple intelligences.
The application has hundreds of activities and games that offer a personalized experience at each child's level. With Kokoro's content, they can play instruments, solve challenges, learn to count, learn vocabulary or express their creativity. It is a complement to the curricular activities of the school and perfect to start learning skills for their future. 
Each child learns at his or her own pace, so the games are suitable for all ages, but especially for children in kindergarten and primary school. They are also in 4 languages (Spanish, English, Portuguese, and Bahasa). Children and adults can have fun and learn while playing!
CATEGORIES
Math: activities to learn numbers, geometric shapes, adding, subtracting, sorting, and using logic to solve problems. 
Communication: games to encourage reading, learning vowels and consonants, spelling, and vocabulary activities. 
Brain games: puzzle, find the differences, connect the dotted line, memory, Simon, find objects in the dark. They will improve attention and reasoning. 
Science: STEAM, learn about the human body, animals, and planets and learn how to take care of the oceans. 
Creativity: music games, painting, decorating the most delicious pizzas, customizing your kokoros with costumes and vehicles. He will explore his curiosity and imagination. 
Emotional intelligence: Learn emotions, to name them and to recognize them in others. They will also work on skills such as empathy, cooperation, resilience, and frustration tolerance. 
Multiplayer games: Now you can play as a family and develop skills such as communication, collaboration, patience, or resilience.
Playing with Kokoro, your little one will reinforce skills such as perception, concentration, attention, memory, hand-eye coordination, reasoning and more.
All this while playing!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR AVATAR
Develop your imagination by designing your own kokoro with super cool costumes and vehicles. They can customize their character and be a bee, a ninja, a policeman, a cook, a dinosaur, or astronaut.
ADAPTIVE LEARNING
The Kokoro method incorporates Artificial Intelligence to assign the most appropriate content at the right time, reinforcing the less developed areas and increasing the difficulty in those in which the child excels, thus creating a tailored learning path.
Children learn as they want, at their own pace and with immediate feedback on their results. The main objective is to teach and keep the child motivated by always offering challenging and achievable activities.
KIDS SAFE
Kokoro Kids has been developed with several security protocols to guarantee our children's stay in a safe environment, without inappropriate content and without ads.
DISCOVER YOUR CHILD'S PROGRESS
You can stay on top of your child's needs whenever you want. We have designed a parent dashboard just for you. Find out what your child is achieving and quickly detect those areas where he or she needs more help.
RECOGNITION AND AWARDS
Best Game Beyond entertainment (Game Connection Awards)
Certificate of educational quality (Educational App Store)
Best mobile game (Valencia Indie Awards)
Smart Media (Academics’ choice award-winning)
Kokoro Kids is an educational solution by Apolo Kids, creators of inclusive experiences, for the cognitive and emotional development of children.
Always a pleasure to hear from you! If you have any comments or questions, write to us at: support@kokorokids.app
Terms of Use (Eula) https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms and Conditions https://kokorokids.app/en/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00022497:ios.summary:
"Now the trumpet summons us again, not as a call to bear arms, though arms we need; not as a call to battle, though embattled we are – but a call to bear the burden of a long twilight struggle..." – President John F. Kennedy
HISTORY IN THE
bluejetty:00022497:ios.description:
"Now the trumpet summons us again, not as a call to bear arms, though arms we need; not as a call to battle, though embattled we are – but a call to bear the burden of a long twilight struggle..." – President John F. Kennedy
HISTORY IN THE MAKING 
Twilight Struggle puts the player at the center of the Cold War, the political and economic struggle between the U.S. and the U.S.S.R that spanned 5 decades from the 1950's to the 1990's. Designed by award winning creators Ananda Gupta and Jason Matthews, players control one of the two modern superpowers, as they work to spread their dominance throughout the world via political influence and coup attempts. But if either side triggers nuclear war, it's game over!
CARD BASED EVENTS 
The event cards in the game are based on actual historical events from the Cold War era. Through the playing of these events, players exert their superpower's influence as they attempt to gain allies and regional control of the globe. From the early days of De-Stalinization, to the Cuban Missile Crisis, the Vietnam War and beyond, players are immersed in the actual events of the struggle between these two nations to be the dominant superpower in the world!
IMMERSIVE STRATEGY 
Hone your skill and strategy as a world leader against an A.I. opponent, and then take your game global with matches against other players via asynchronous online game play. 
FEATURES
•A.I. Opponent 
•In-game Tutorial
•Pass-and-Play Multiplayer
•Asynchronous or Real-time Online Play
•Invite Playdek Friends
•Online Profile and Stats
•Customized Online Game Clock
•Player Rating System 
"As a strategy game, Twilight Struggle is a revelation." - PC Gamer 
"...every strategy gamer should play Twilight Struggle without fail: it's just that good." - Pocket Tactics 
AWARDS 
2012 Ludoteca Ideale Winner 
2011 Lucca Games Best Boardgame for Experts 
2006 International Gamers Awards - Historical Simulation 
2006 International Gamers Awards - General Strategy; Two-players 
2006 Golden Geek Best Wargame Winner 
2006 Golden Geek Best 2-Player Board Game Winner 
2005 James F. Dunnigan Award Winner 
2005 Charles S. Roberts Best Modern Era Boardgame Winner 
*AN INTERNET CONNECTION AND PLAYDEK ACCOUNT ARE REQUIRED FOR ONLINE PLAY.* 
Per our Terms of Service, you must be 13 years old or older to use the Playdek online games service. 
For Twilight Struggle game support, please contact: support@playdekgames.com

bluejetty:00087699:ios.description:
Set the alarm time in just two seconds.
This simple alarm clock app has been designed for maximum ease of use.
Set your favorite music as your alarm and wake up happy!
ALARM FUNCTIONS:
- Snooze (3 - 30 minutes)
- Vibration
- Fade in alarm
OTHER FEATURES:
- Sleep timer (sleep music)
- 12 hour and 24 hour time format
- Vertical and horizontal modes
MORNING:
Use music of your choice or select one of the preset alarms to wake up happy and smiling.
EVENING:
Relax and fall asleep to the sound of your favorite song or one of the preset sleep music.
APP FEATURES:
Unique and intuitive interface is easy to use: launch the app and have your alarm ready in just two seconds.
WHY WE DEVELOPED THIS APP:
There are many alarm clock apps found on the App Store today.
However, most of these require the user to tap through numerous screens just to set an alarm.
Also, most of these apps use a built-in widget for the interface, making it hard to interact with them intuitively.
If you find yourself regularly changing your alarm time, the existing apps out there are a real pain.
That's why we developed this new app, which uses an analog clock for inspiration.

bluejetty:00071401:ios.summary:
Bible Maps: Scripture Atlas is the most complete biblical map reference app for iPhone and iPad, featuring over 182 full-color maps covering the Old and New Testament.
Whether you are a pastor preparing a sermon, a student in a Bible class
bluejetty:00071401:ios.description:
Bible Maps: Scripture Atlas is the most complete biblical map reference app for iPhone and iPad, featuring over 182 full-color maps covering the Old and New Testament.
Whether you are a pastor preparing a sermon, a student in a Bible class, or a believer deepening your faith, this app puts the entire biblical world at your fingertips.
WHAT YOU GET:
- 182 biblical maps of the Old and New Testament
- Physical geography of the Holy Land and ancient Palestine
- The journeys of Abraham, Moses, and the Exodus from Egypt
- The missionary travels of the Apostle Paul
- Division of the Promised Land among the twelve tribes
- Satellite views of biblical routes and territories
- Distance and travel context for each journey
- Full zoom support — pinch to zoom up to 5x
- Bilingual support: English and Spanish
- Offline access after first load
- Favorites — save your most-used maps
- Personal notes on any map
- Built-in biblical timeline by historical era
- Quiz mode to test your biblical geography knowledge
- Share any map with one tap
PERFECT FOR:
Pastors, Sunday school teachers, seminary students, Bible study groups, missionaries, and anyone who wants to understand where biblical events happened and why they matter.
Understanding the geography of the Bible changes how you read it. Knowing how far Abraham traveled, where the tribes settled, or the routes Paul walked makes Scripture come alive in a completely new way.
Download Bible Maps: Scripture Atlas and explore the biblical world today.

bluejetty:00105004:android.name: Junkyard Tycoon: Car Dealer
bluejetty:00105004:android.summary:
Ready to turn rust into riches? Build an automotive empire by buying junk cars, salvaging valuable parts, and selling restored vehicles for massive profit. Transform wrecks into cash in the ultimate car business tycoon simulator!
🚗 BUILD Y
bluejetty:00105004:android.description:
Ready to turn rust into riches? Build an automotive empire by buying junk cars, salvaging valuable parts, and selling restored vehicles for massive profit. Transform wrecks into cash in the ultimate car business tycoon simulator!
🚗 BUILD YOUR JUNKYARD EMPIRE 🏭
Start from nothing and build the most profitable car salvage business. Expand your junkyard, unlock dismantling stations, and grow from a small scrapyard into a multi-million dollar automotive empire!
✔️ Expand with parking slots and ramp stations
✔️ Unlock diagnostic scanners and advanced equipment
✔️ Construct factories: Brick, Concrete, Forestry, Stone Quarry
✔️ Progress from scrapyard to premier dealership
🔧 DISMANTLE & SALVAGE VEHICLES 💰
Buy junk cars when the transporter arrives. Strip each car for valuable parts like engines, battery, rims, brakes, glass, doors, and transmissions. Crush scrap metal for recycling profits or repair vehicles for premium prices!
✔️ Dismantle cars to extract authentic automotive parts
✔️ Discover hidden materials and valuable illegal items
✔️ Use Vehicle Press to compress parts for 2-3x value
✔️ Sell parts individually or restore complete vehicles
⚙️ EARN WHILE OFFLINE - IDLE INCOME 💵
Build passive income systems that work when you're not playing! The Oasis generates money every hour, factories continue production, and energy regenerates automatically.
✔️ Collect offline earnings when you return
✔️ Oasis provides steady passive income
✔️ Auto-sell premium feature sells vehicles while away
✔️ Queue factory production to complete offline
🔨 REPAIR WITH DIAGNOSTIC SCANNER 🏆
Use the Diagnostic Scanner to identify damaged parts. Repair using materials collected from dismantling. Restored vehicles sell for maximum profit in your showroom!
✔️ Scan vehicles to find damaged parts
✔️ Repair engines, battery, rims, brakes, glass
✔️ Restored parts increase value by 50-100%
✔️ Speed up repairs with diamonds
🏭 FACTORIES & PRODUCTION
Construct four specialized factories. Hire employees for production bonuses and install equipment to maximize output!
✔️ Produce bricks, concrete, lumber, stone
✔️ Hire workers for automation bonuses
✔️ Upgrade factories for faster production
💎 LEVEL UP & REWARDS
Progress through 99+ levels. Each level unlocks new vehicles, buildings, and abilities. Earn money, energy, and diamonds!
✔️ Unlock new vehicle types as you level
✔️ Develop company skills for passive bonuses
✔️ Complete 100+ achievements for rewards
🎮 MINI-GAMES FOR INCOME
Earn extra money through mini-games! Compete in drag racing, lap racing, arena challenges, and casino slot machines.
✔️ Drag Racing and Lap Racing with your vehicles
✔️ Arena combat tournaments
✔️ Casino slot machines for jackpots
📊 ADVANCED SYSTEMS
Master the stock market, track transactions through banking system, and manage three currencies (Money, Diamonds, Casino Coins).
✔️ Stock Market for investing profits
✔️ Banking System tracks all transactions
✔️ Multiple save slots for different strategies
✔️ Dynamic pricing based on vehicle condition
🎯 WHY JUNKYARD TYCOON
Perfect for car enthusiasts, business simulation fans, and idle game lovers! Control every aspect of the junkyard business with deep mechanics and satisfying progression. Master vehicle evaluation, optimize factory production, and build your automotive empire!
Play offline anytime - no internet required! Easy one-hand controls, quick 5-15 minute sessions, and rewarding idle mechanics let you earn money even when you're not playing.
Whether you're a simulation veteran or new to tycoon games, Junkyard Tycoon delivers addictive gameplay. Buy low, dismantle smart, repair strategically, sell high!
🏁 START YOUR EMPIRE TODAY
From dusty scrapyard to automotive tycoon - download Junkyard Tycoon and turn junk cars into massive profits. Build factories, master dismantling, automate production, and dominate the car salvage industry!
Download now and start your journey from scrap to empire! 🚗💰

bluejetty:00073958:ios.name: Annie Baby Monitor: Nanny Cam
bluejetty:00073958:ios.summary: Annie Baby Monitor is a smart baby camera app that turns two devices—smartphones, tablets, or computers—into a reliable baby monitor. Compatible with iPhone, iPad, and other mobile devices, Annie offers flexibility with WiFi or mobile data,
bluejetty:00073958:ios.description:
Annie Baby Monitor is a smart baby camera app that turns two devices—smartphones, tablets, or computers—into a reliable baby monitor. Compatible with iPhone, iPad, and other mobile devices, Annie offers flexibility with WiFi or mobile data, letting you watch and listen to your baby anytime, anywhere, with unlimited range.
Features at a Glance:
● HD video and audio monitoring
● Cry and sound detection to capture every noise
● Motion detection to know about every move
● Real-time alerts so you’re always informed
● Unlimited reach via Wi-Fi, 3G, 5G or LTE for monitoring anywhere
● Night vision to see your baby clearly in low light
● Two-way audio to soothe your baby from afar
● Lullaby & white noise player to help your baby sleep peacefully
● Baby sleep tracker to keep an eye on your baby's sleep habits
● Multi-babies to watch over up to four babies at the same time
● Baby diary to log every feeding, diaper changes, sleep patterns, and more
● Multi-device connectivity so both parents can monitor at once
● Simple setup using your phone, tablet, or computer—no extra equipment needed
WHAT MAKES ANNIE THE #1 BABY MONITOR?
Watch over your little one
Watch your baby in real-time with a live video feed. With automatically enhanced visibility, you’ll see your baby even at night.
Monitor with unlimited reach
No need to be limited by your location. Annie Baby Monitor works seamlessly over Wi-Fi, 3G, or LTE, allowing you to monitor your baby from anywhere with unlimited range.
Ideal for travelling parents
Forget about bulky baby monitors! Annie Baby Monitor is always within reach and works perfectly over Wi-Fi and mobile data, making it the perfect travel companion for parents on the go.
Enhanced audio for every sound
If you need to hear every noise clearly, you can adjust the microphone sensitivity to ensure you catch even the faintest sounds from your baby.
Hear and soothe your baby
If your baby wakes up or gets fussy, soothe your little one remotely through a two-way video and microphone.
Lull your baby to sleep
Play soothing lullabies, white noise, or calming sounds to help your baby drift off to sleep. Adjust the volume and timer to create the perfect atmosphere.
View sleep trends
Keep an eye on your baby's sleep habits over time. This helps you figure out their natural sleep patterns and detect any changes or problems right away.
Keep track of baby’s routine
Log every feeding, diaper changes, sleep patterns, doctor visits, vaccinations, growth milestones and all memorable "firsts".
Review past monitoring feeds
Replay and review past recordings, ensuring you never miss any important moments, whether it’s a noise, video, or photo captured during monitoring.
Monitor multiple babies
Watch over up to four babies at the same time from one Parent Station. Keep an eye on all sleeping children at the same time.
Share your baby monitor
Both parents can monitor a the same time. Annie Baby Monitor allows multiple parent devices to be linked to the same baby station so you can watch over the baby simultaneously.
Simple to set up & repurpose your old devices
All you need are two devices – your phone, tablet, or computer. Place one in the baby’s room as the Baby Station, and use the other to monitor. It’s that easy. 
Annie Baby Monitor is free to download and provides users with free monitoring during the trial. Choose weekly, monthly, or yearly subscriptions. Annie Baby Monitor renews automatically; cancellations must be made at least 24 hours before your subscription ends to avoid renewal. You can manage or turn off Annie Baby Monitor auto-renew from your iTunes Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.anniebabymonitor.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://www.anniebabymonitor.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00135356:ios.description:
Step into the world of Checkers, also known as Draughts, with our app that rejuvenates this age-old game for the digital era. This app isn't just about playing; it's an homage to the strategic depth and simple joys that have made Checkers/Draughts a favorite for centuries. Whether you're reliving cherished memories or discovering its charm for the first time, our app offers a captivating experience for all ages.
Key Features for an Unmatched Experience:
Diverse Game Modes: Battle the computer across 5 difficulty levels, or engage in a head-to-head battle with friends in the 2-player mode featuring a time limit.
Worldwide Variations: Explore the global appeal of Checkers/Draughts with numerous variants like English/American, Russian, German, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian, Thai, and International styles.
Customization at Your Fingertips: Personalize your play with unique board and piece sets, and express your creativity with our custom board editor.
Authentic Look and Feel: The app's sleek design offers a realistic gaming experience, rekindling the warmth of traditional Checkers/Draughts games.
Advanced AI Challenge: Engage with intelligent AI opponents that provide a competitive edge, making you forget that you're playing against a program.
Player-Friendly Features: Utilize the undo function, save/load games in progress, and enjoy the thrill of timer-based matches.
Earn and Progress:
Rack up experience points by overcoming AI opponents (+1 for Easy, +3 for Medium, +5 for Hard, +7 for Very Hard), showcasing your skill development in the game.
Perfect for enthusiasts of strategic board games, our Checkers/Draughts app is a blend of nostalgia and modern gameplay. Ideal for players seeking a mix of classic fun with contemporary features. Download now and step into the world of Checkers/Draughts, where strategy and nostalgia meet!

bluejetty:00144627:ios.summary:
Meet your new favorite contact management tool, Contacts+.
Contacts+ is a cloud-based address book designed to take the hassle out of contact management so you can focus on what matters most - relationships. Truly multi-platform, Contacts+
bluejetty:00144627:ios.description:
Meet your new favorite contact management tool, Contacts+.
Contacts+ is a cloud-based address book designed to take the hassle out of contact management so you can focus on what matters most - relationships. Truly multi-platform, Contacts+ syncs your contacts across your devices as well as across various accounts you may store contacts in (such as Gmail, Exchange, Office365, and iCloud).
Why use Contacts+?
• Contact deduplication - Consolidate all your information about each contact into one, holistic profile. Never wonder again which pieces of contact information are correct.
• Cross-device, cross-platform sync - Your address book is now available everywhere.
• Scan & save business cards - Upload a picture of scanned business card, and we'll transcribe the information & add it to your address book.
• Organized your way - Tag contacts to create custom groupings, or leave notes for added context.
• Automatic contact enrichment - We'll help fill in the details about your contacts (photos, social profiles, & more) by adding content we find from around the web.
• Spam Block - We help enable you to connect with friends and colleagues and block unwanted people, telemarketers, and spam.
Do even MORE with Contacts+ Premium. With Premium, you can:
• Scan MORE business cards - Scan & save up to 1,000 business cards a year.
• Sync multiple accounts - Sync up to 5 address books & keep your contacts in sync across multiple platforms.
• Choose Monthly or Annual Premium subscription - Pick a plan that fits your needs.
Contacts+ is free to download and use, and Contacts+ Premium is available by subscription and unlocks all of the features above. Prices may vary by location. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase.
Privacy & Terms of Service
This App is for professional use and not intended for children under the age of 16, and we will never intentionally collect any information from users under the age of 16.
For more information, please visit our privacy policy.
Privacy Policy: https://www.contactsplus.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.contactsplus.com/terms
Questions, feedback, just want to say "hi"?
You can email us at support@contactsplus.com!

Prime Medic provides expert medical advice and assistance for patients across Australia. In an increasingly digital world, it makes sense that patients should be able to harness the power and accessibility of the internet to secure the best healthcare possible. This is the ethos behind Prime Medic.
To achieve this, we have brought together a team of experts and industry leaders from two very different fields. On the one hand, we want to give our patients the very best healthcare and treatment possible, so we have put together a team of medical professionals with extensive experience of delivering this in Australia.
On the other hand, clarity and accessibility are both at the heart of what we do. To achieve this, we formed an expert IT team, constructing a platform by which anyone can access the healthcare they need, from anywhere in the country. Our IT professionals have gained experience from a wide range of industries, and they bring this experience to bear as they create unique solutions for healthcare.
We also provide preliminary self-diagnosis based on user-reported symptoms. The information provided is sourced from reputable medical databases and is intended for informational purposes only. Users are encouraged to consult a healthcare professional for accurate diagnosis and treatment. Please refer to the in-app 'References' section for more information on the sources of our medical content.

bluejetty:00043817:ios.description:
The best learning companion for your child's screen-time, after you.
SCREEN-TIME ALIGNED WITH PEDIATRIC RECOMMENDATIONS
Pediatricians recommend co-viewing to improve quality of screen-time. Kidzovo offers a digital learning buddy when you're not around to make sure screen-time remains high quality. It combines high-quality, age-appropriate content from 50+ top creators (like Vooks, SciShow Kids, Kids Learning Tube) with interactive activities to create a play-and-learn experience that feels like a real teacher or friend guiding your child. Say YES to ABCs, 123s, math, science, STEM, phonics, reading, shapes, social skills, coloring, painting, puzzles, all in one app!
OVO: YOUR CHILD'S AI LEARNING BUDDY
Ovo is your child’s personalized co-viewing companion! Ovo greets kids by their name, asks questions like “How was your day?”, and engages them with learning games while watching their favorite content to help reinforce & retain the content better. It uses learning games where kids identify, tap, speak, answer, color, solve puzzles, and more! While Ovo personalizes the experience for your child, they get to personalize Ovo with hats, scarfs, and other accessories as they learn and grow.Every activity builds:
- Fine & gross motor skills (coloring, tapping)
- Language & speech development (voice responses)
- Cognitive growth (puzzles, problem-solving)
- Creativity & expression (art, storytelling)
ENDLESS HIGH-QUALITY CONTENT FROM 50+ CREATORS
- Kidzovo curates top-notch, age-appropriate content from over 50 renowned kids’ content creators including Vooks, SciShow Kids, Kiboomers, and Kiboomers. 
- Whether it’s 123 counting, ABC basics, phonics, math, science, STEM, or social & emotional learning, our library offers a vast array of engaging subjects that go beyond repetitive, limited content.
PARENTS, CONNECT DEEPER WITH YOUR CHILD
Go beyond screen-time tracking:
- Hear audio clips of your child’s conversations with Ovo.
- Watch timelapse videos of their coloring masterpieces.
- Get personalized tips to discuss their favorite topics (like science or math).
- Discover their interests with insights on what excites them most.
AWARDS & RECOGNITION
- Nominated for The Webby Awards 2025 for the best kids app alongside PBS & Cocomelon
- Best Consumer Tech Startup winner in 2025 CODiE awards
- Won Best Mobile App in EdTechDigest Cool Tool Awards 2025 & Finalist in Early Childhood category
- 5-Star Educational App Store Rating
- Mom’s Choice Gold
- Parents’ Pick Award
- National Parenting Product Award
- Featured in Forbes, Financial Express, AP News, Yahoo Finance & more!
SAFE & AD-FREE
- Trusted by Parents & Loved by Kids: Join over 100,000 families across 150+ countries who love the fastest growing kids' app, Kidzovo for their child's screen time.
- 100% Ad-Free & COPPA Certified: Zero distractions, maximum safety. COPPA certified by kidSAFE.
- Offline Mode: Keep toddlers, preschoolers, and kids engaged on flights or road trips.
- 1000+ Coloring sheets: Color hundreds of sheets with dinosaurs, princess, animals, cars, & more.
- 500+ Puzzles & Worksheets: Solve hundreds of jigsaw puzzles, speech exercises & worksheets.
WHAT PARENTS SAY ABOUT KIDZOVO
- "We love using this app! My daughter keeps asking for it herself and watches less youtube. The only app that can reduce youtube in my family." - Sabrina
- "Plus, there’s a parent portal that lets you see what videos they’ve watched, drawings they’ve colored, and funny things they’ve said. We just love Kidovo!" - Danii
KIDZOVO UNLIMITED SUBSCRIPTION
- Unlimited access to Kidzovo's content without any daily limits. 
- Offline access 2000+ activities inside Kidzovo . Make your flight or road trip smooth & tantrum free.
- Unlimited number of screens at once.
- Upto 4 child profiles so every child gets their personalized experience.
Privacy Policy - https://kidzovo.com/privacy
Terms of Service - https://kidzovo.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00168133:ios.description:
Turn your Apple Watch into a retro game console.
Play Game Boy, NES, SNES, Genesis, and more on your wrist, with multi-touch controls and the Digital Crown. ArcEmu also runs on iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV.
▸ SUPPORTED CONSOLES
Included for free: 
- Game Boy 
- Game Boy Color 
- Nintendo Entertainment System (NES)
Available through in-app purchases: 
- Game Boy Advance 
- Pokémon Mini 
- Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES) 
- Atari 2600 
- Sega Mega Drive / Genesis 
- Sega Master System 
- Sega Game Gear 
- Sega SG-1000
▸ MULTIPLAYER AND LINK CABLE
Play home-console games online and locally with friends, or link Game Boy and Game Boy Advance games over the internet. Game Link Cable supports up to four players in compatible games.
Online play requires a Game Center account.
▸ SHARE ROMs WITH A CODE
Import your ROMs on iPhone, keep them in iCloud, and download them directly to Apple Watch or Apple TV.
Share them through iCloud using a code, including with an Apple Watch configured with Family Setup.
▸ SCREEN AND CONTROLS
Move and resize the game screen, choose an LCD or CRT filter, and set up the controls the way you like them.
On Apple Watch, use multi-touch controls, customize the control layout, and assign actions to the Digital Crown. On iPhone and iPad, adjust button positions and transparency, and play in any orientation.

bluejetty:00085808:ios.description:
** An awarded mobile tool for rheumatologists **
RheumaHelper is a pocket rheumatology assistant. Classification criteria, disease activity calculators, and everyday clinical tools — always with you, easy to use, and ready when you need them. Designed for iOS 26 with Liquid Glass on iPhone and iPad.
** Verified content **
Reviewed by Prof. Matija Tomšič, M.D., Ph.D., Asst. Prof. Žiga Rotar, M.D., Ph.D. (rheumatologists at University Medical Centre Ljubljana, Slovenia), and Rok Ješe, M.D., Ph.D. (rheumatologist and medical advisor at Mediately). All calculators and criteria are based on referenced equations. References are available inside the app.
** Available tools **
More than 40 tools with fast search access.
Classification criteria:
• Adult Still's disease (Cush, Fautrel, Yamaguchi)
• Antiphospholipid syndrome
• Arthralgia suspicious for progression to RA (2016 EULAR)
• Autoinflammatory recurrent fevers (clinical classification)
• Axial spondyloarthritis
• Behçet's Disease (ICBD)
• Fibromyalgia (2016 ACR)
• Gout (2014 Oxford; 2015 ACR-EULAR)
• IgG4-related disease (2019 ACR/EULAR)
• Idiopathic inflammatory myopathies (2017 ACR/EULAR)
• Inflammatory Back Pain
• Peripheral spondyloarthritis
• Polymyalgia rheumatica
• Primary Sjögren's syndrome (2016 ACR/EULAR)
• Psoriatic arthritis (CASPAR)
• Rheumatoid arthritis (2010 ACR/EULAR)
• Systemic lupus erythematosus (ACR, SLICC, 2019 EULAR/ACR)
• Systemic sclerosis (ACR/EULAR)
• …and more
Disease activity calculators:
• ASDAS — Ankylosing spondylitis disease activity score
• BASDAI — Bath ankylosing spondylitis disease activity index
• BVAS — Birmingham vasculitis activity score (v3)
• DAPSA, DAPSA28
• DAS28
• ESSDAI, ESSPRI
• Five-Factor Score
• PASI — Psoriasis area and severity index
• SDAI / CDAI
• SELENA-SLEDAI
• VDI — Vasculitis damage index
• …and more
General tools:
• QTc (Corrected QT Interval)
• Creatinine Clearance (Cockcroft–Gault)
• eGFR (CKD-EPI and MDRD)
• …and more coming soon

bluejetty:00087318:ios.name: FollowMee GPS Location Tracker
bluejetty:00087318:ios.summary: FollowMee GPS Tracker converts your iPhone or iPad into a GPS tracking device. Installing this app to the device that you want to track, you can monitor its whereabouts on the FollowMee.com web site. Using this app,  you can track your fami
bluejetty:00087318:ios.description:
FollowMee GPS Tracker converts your iPhone or iPad into a GPS tracking device. Installing this app to the device that you want to track, you can monitor its whereabouts on the FollowMee.com web site. Using this app,  you can track your family members, company devices, or even your employees.
► Location Monitor 
Simply login to the FollowMee.com web site with your desktop or mobile browser. You can view last known location for free. Geofencing, location reporting, location sharing, and other tracking services are available on the web site.
► Data Privacy
We don't serve ad in this mobile app or on the FollowMee.com web site. We don't share your data with outside parties.
► Always On 
Once the app starts, it runs quietly in the background and requires no human interaction. It will restart itself after reboots, or terminated by the phone user. It only stops when the stop button is pressed.
► Configurable App Settings
You can configure tracking power, tracking schedule, or even a password protected lock screen. Business users can use MDM to deploy this app and its settings to the remote devices.
► Tracking Multiple Devices
You can track multiple devices in your account, including devices of other mobile platforms. All your devices are shown on the same map.
► Multiple Mobile Platforms 
Apps for other mobile platforms are available on the FollowMee.com web site.
► No-Internet Contingency 
Cellular or Wifi connection is required to upload location data to the FollowMee server. When connection is interrupted, the app continue to track and data is saved in the device storage. When connection resumes, data is then uploaded. After that, your map will show up-to-date data.
► SOS Panic Button 
Email your current location and call a designated telephone number through cellular (for iPhone) or VOIP (for iPad or iPod Touch).
SIDE NOTE 
► Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00072988:ios.description:
This is a fun and challenging way to test your intelligence. With our IQ test, you can see how well you can think, solve problems, and understand new ideas. You'll be asked a lot of questions, ranging from math problems to puzzles.
Once you've completed the IQ test, you'll receive an IQ score that tells you how well you did. This score can help you understand how smart you are compared to others who have taken the test. People who score high on the test are thought to be really smart.
Our IQ test app provides a great opportunity to challenge yourself and improve your cognitive abilities. Download our app today and see how well you do on our IQ test!
Features:
- Check your answers
- Get a Certificate
- Global Leaderboard
How does it work?
You have 30 minutes to answer 39 questions. The level of difficulty of the questions increases gradually. If you find two logical answers to one question you should choose the simplest answer. You are not rewarded for finishing before time is up - so take your time! Wrong answers do not influence your result - so guess rather than omit a question!
Good luck with the test, and share your IQ with us!

bluejetty:00038477:ios.description:
Tap into the endless possibilities of Aussie travel with the Wotif app. 
We’re more than just hotel deals. With loads of accommodation options, flights, packages, activities and car hire, you’re only a Wotif away from your next adventure. 
AUSSIE TRAVEL MADE EASIER IN ONE APP 
Plan, collaborate, book and manage your trip, all in one place – we’ve got you covered with accommodation, flights, car hire and experiences. How good! PLUS bundle your hotel, flight and more together to save.*
INSTANT SAVINGS 
Our mates get instant travel discounts on selected hotels, flights, car hire, activities and more. Sign in on the app and save 10% or more on over 100,000 hotels worldwide with Mates Rates, plus up to 35% when adding select hotels to your flight.
FIND THE BEST VALUE STAY FOR YOUR GETAWAY
Choose from stacks of different accommodation options in thousands of destinations around Australia and beyond (think hotels, resorts, holiday parks, holiday rentals, cabins and much more). View hotel search results on an interactive map. Read real reviews from verified hotel guests. Even compare prices, ratings and amenities side-by-side in the app. 
PLAN TRIPS TOGETHER WITH TRIP BOARDS
Organising group trips just got waaaay easier. Start saving your ‘maybe’ stays in one place – no need for loads of open tabs! – then invite friends and family to join your Trip board. Everyone can easily add to wishlists, and view bookings and trip details (only you can manage bookings).
FAST, EASY & SECURE BOOKING 
It can be as quick as a few taps to book, and you can book with confidence knowing we keep things flexi. Lots of hotels are fully refundable** and some offer the option to book now and pay on arrival. Save your payment details to book future trips even faster.
MANAGE YOUR TRIP ON THE MOVE
Travel like a pro. View all of your Wotif bookings, while you’re on the go. Get mobile alerts about flight delays, hotel checkout times and more. And don’t forget to brag about it: share your hotel itinerary with family and friends via email or text message. 
WOTIF TIPS
The Wotif app is your ‘in the know’ travel mate. Check out trending destinations for Aussie and NZ travellers, plus curated accom recommendations. Track flight prices for hundreds of airlines and receive alerts when the price is right. 
The Wotif.com app makes it easy to say why not! Download i

App Store Review
2020
# STORY
Read it here → paper.pro/story
# HIGHLIGHTS
· Gorgeous writing space
· Silky-smooth typing
· Deep personalization (Pro)
· Markdown or Plain Text
· Syncs with iCloud
· Integrates with TextExpander
· Publishes drafts to Medium, WordPress, Ghost, or Micro.blog
· Exports to PDF, HTML, RTF, DOCX, ePub, image, or clipboard
· Works seamlessly across your iPhone, iPad, and Mac
# PRO FEATURES
Basic adjustments like text size are free in Paper. More advanced personalization can be purchased with Pro Features. You will not be buying anything blindly, though. The trial period for Pro Features is untimed, so you can take your time to decide if they are a worthy investment.
While trialing Pro Features, you might occasionally see a popup. Simply press Reset in the popup to get rid of it completely.
Pro Features are either a subscription or a one-time purchase. Both the subscription and the one-time purchase unlock Pro Features on all your iPhones and iPads that share the same Apple ID. This subscription (or one-time purchase) applies only to iPhones and iPads. Macs require a separate subscription (or one-time purchase).
The one-time purchase is hidden by default. To enable it, go to the Settings app → Apps → Paper → Purchases → toggle "Show Lifetime Option".
If you want to upgrade from a Monthly subscription to a Yearly one (or to a Lifetime license), go to Paper’s page in the App Store and press the rounded button with the price next to the Yearly subscription option (or next to the Lifetime in-app purchase).
# BUSINESSES, SCHOOLS & ORGANIZATIONS
Businesses, schools, and organizations can use one of the following methods to purchase the Pro version of the app:
· Apple Business Manager
· Apple School Manager
· Volume Purchasing
The Pro version of the app can be accessed from this link → paper.pro/get

# FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
## How do I share my document?
· On the main screen with documents: Tap and hold the document. Select "Share" from the menu.
· In the document editor: Tap the title of the document in the top bar, then tap the round "Share" button in the popup.
## How do I print my document?
· On the main screen with documents: Tap and hold the document. Select "Print" from the menu.
· In the document editor: Tap the title of the document in the top bar. Select "Print" from the menu.
## Can I draw in the app?
No. Paper is purely a plain-text editor.
## Can I add pictures?
You can only link to public images on the Web.
## Can I password-protect my notes?
No.
## Paper changes the font when I switch between alphabetic and non-alphabetic keyboards. How do I prevent it?
· Change the keyboard to a non-alphabetic one (Japanese, Chinese, Korean, etc.).
· Tap the "Settings" button in the top right corner.
· Under the "Font" submenu, toggle "Keep for ABC Keyboards".
## Need more help?
You can reach me via the in-app chat → "Settings" button in the corner → "Chat with the Maker"

# FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## How do I share my document?

· On the main screen with documents: Tap and hold the document. Select "Share" from the menu.
· In the document editor: Tap the title of the document in the top bar, then tap the round "Share" button in the popup.

## How do I print my document?

· On the main screen with documents: Tap and hold the document. Select "Print" from the menu.
· In the document editor: Tap the title of the document in the top bar. Select "Print" from the menu.

## Can I draw in the app?

No. Paper is purely a plain-text editor.

## Can I add pictures?

You can only link to public images on the Web.

## Can I password-protect my notes?

No.

## Paper changes the font when I switch between alphabetic and non-alphabetic keyboards. How do I prevent it?

· Change the keyboard to a non-alphabetic one (Japanese, Chinese, Korean, etc.).
· Tap the "Settings" button in the top right corner.
· Under the "Font" submenu, toggle "Keep for ABC Keyboards".

## Need more help?

You can reach me via the in-app chat → "Settings" button in the corner → "Chat with the Maker"

bluejetty:00017014:ios.description:
COMBINE RABBITS TO CREATE MUTANTS AND TAKE OVER THE WORLD
I’ve got ears for days and big teeth, and I can bring you eggs but I’m not a bird. What am I? An ugly waiter? No, dummy, a rabbit! It might not be Easter, but it’s definitely bunny season for the addictive Evolution series, so get ready to drag, drop and dare, because your new favorite pet will be a hare!
Mix and match to your heart’s content and fill the world with tons of cute, fluffy and sometimes slightly scary rabbit mutations. It’s so adorable you’ll want to hug your screen!
FLUFFY FEATURES
• Pantheon: a new place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
• Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the rabbits
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar rabbits to create new mysterious creatures
• Use rabbit eggs to earn coins, buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap a rabbit to make coins pop from their eggs
HIGHLIGHTS
• Different stages and many rabbit species to discover
• A mind-blowing story with hare-fying twists
• The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution and incremental clicker games
• Doodle-like illustrations
• Various possible endings: find your destiny
• No rabbits were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
It’s bunny time, hunny!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.

Find all hidden objects by moving around the interactive maps and completing quests to unlock new colorful locations. Found It! is a fun and engaging hidden picture game that exercises your brain and promotes problem-solving skills. 

Found It is a new search and find bright hidden object game where you should solve the objects puzzles and unlock new maps for free. All you need to do is to focus on the requested item, do a scavenger hunt, step inside various locations with engaging scenes, and complete the tasks. Use hints to put your target and find it. You can also zoom in, out, and swipe through every corner of the map. 

Search, seek and find out fantastic graphics. Hundreds of hidden objects await you to collect and unlock new levels. If you are fond of playing detective, scavenger hunt games, finding hidden objects, and puzzle games, then this brain teaser is your best choice. Playing Found It you will train your brain and improve your searching skills and attention. 

Features: 

- Enjoy the pleasure of playing the hidden object games for free!
- Relax with the best Found It game anywhere & anytime!
- Simple gameplay and rules. Observe the scene, find the hidden objects, and finish the scene!
- Suitable for groups of all ages. Play the picture puzzle game with your friends and family members. 
- Various difficulties. The more hidden objects you find out, the more intricate maps you can challenge.
- Powerful tools. Use helpful hints to find the hidden object when you get stuck.
- Zoom feature. Zoom in and out at any moment to see the well hidden objects!
- Multiple scenes and levels. Playground, animal park, ocean world, and more destinations are waiting for you!

Improve your concentration, attention, and observation skills with Found It! 

Visit https://lionstudios.cc/contact-us/ if have any feedback, need help on beating a level or have any awesome ideas you would like to see in the game! From the Studio that brought you Wordle!, Match 3D, Mr. Bullet, Happy Glass and Cake Sort Puzzle 3D!

Follow us to get news and updates on our other Award Winning titles;

bluejetty:00150211:ios.description:
See a board-certified doctor in as few as 10 minutes, 24/7 from any location.
With Bayhealth’s Virtual Urgent care, get the care you need sooner, no matter where you are located. Allergies, rashes, infections, sore throat, pink eye, cold and flu, urinary tract infection (UTI), anxiety/depression. Whatever the symptoms, get the care you need now.
Our doctors can treat all ages – from infants to the elderly. Simply download the app, check into the portal, select a physician, and complete your visit. You may also allow others to join your visit.
Bayhealth’s team of physicians can prescribe you the appropriate medications and get you on the path to good health.
Each virtual urgent care visit costs $64* regardless of insurance. Payment will be completed through the app.
Once your visit is complete, your after-summary visit is saved in Bayhealth’s patient portal, MyChart. Visit Bayhealth.org/MyChart to sign up for an account or to log in as a guest.
*Bayhealth employees and their dependents enrolled in the health system’s medical plan are charged at a lower rate.
If you are an Apple Health user you will have the option to share important health information with your provider during your video visit. Sharing Apple Health data is optional but allows the provider to see heart rate, weight, and other health information to help them make a more accurate diagnosis.

bluejetty:00140990:ios.description:
Thenics helps you to achieve impressive Calisthenic skills and functional muscles. There are a lot of trend sports (Street Workout, CrossFit) and Calisthenics Movements (Bar Brothers, Barstarzz) where you will see these skills. 
Free Skills: 
* Muscle Up
* Planche
* Front Lever
* Back Lever
* Pistol Squat
* Handstand Push Up
* V-Sit
Thenics Pro Skills*:
* One Arm Pull Up
* Human Flag
* One Arm Push Up
* One Arm Handstand
* Shrimp Squat
* Hefesto
* Dragon Flag
Thenics will guide you with descriptions and technique explanation of the skills and progressions. Every skill is divided into several progressions which include different workouts. Thereby you are able to learn skills step by step adapted to your current level. 
How is Thenics different to other fitness apps? 
Your goal isn't just to lift more weight or execute more reps. The Workouts and Progressions lead you to achieving new impressive skills. Additionally you will gain strength and get lean functional muscles!
THENICS COACH* 
How to plan your workouts?
- Can I work on multiple skills in parallel?
- How long should I rest?
- How to combine basic workouts with skill training?
A good answer to that highly depends on your specific goals and conditions.
The THENICS COACH will generate personalized Workout plans for you, adapted to your goals and conditions.
*(only available with Thenics Pro)
Terms of use:
https://thenics.de/TermsOfUse.html

bluejetty:00044451:ios.summary:

Nourish provides personalized, empathetic care and a focus on sustainable h
bluejetty:00044451:ios.description:
Are you trying to improve your health by eating better? Nourish connects you with a Registered Dietitian through telehealth, and gets it covered by your insurance!
Nourish provides personalized, empathetic care and a focus on sustainable healthy habits. A Registered Dietitian will help you build a plan to achieve your health goals. By pairing this evidence-based nutrition therapy with technology that supports you on your health journey, Nourish makes it easier for you to eat better.
With the Nourish app, you can:
• Schedule and manage appointments with your registered dietitian
• Chat with your dietitian
• Track your macros easily with AI-powered meal logging
• Explore healthy recipes
• Order healthy, medically-tailored meals for delivery
• Measure your health progress, including an Apple Health integration
• Track your nutrition goals and health progress
• View summaries written by your registered dietitian and the status of your insurance claims for past appointments
In the coming months, the Nourish app will launch additional features that help our patients eat better, including meal planning, goal setting, and more! 
Patients that use Nourish report an average satisfaction of 9.5 out of 10, and love that Nourish is:
• Affordable: 94% of Nourish patients pay $0 out of pocket
• Convenient: 100% virtual - use telehealth to meet with your registered dietitian wherever you are, whenever it's best for you
• Effective: 91% of people who used Nourish reported they felt happier and healthier after twelve weeks of working with their registered dietitian
Who can Nourish help? In short, anyone that needs help eating better! We have registered dietitians who are experts and serve patients looking for help with:
• Weight loss
• Eating disorders
• Diabetes and prediabetes
• General health
• Emotional eating
• Gut health
• Heart health
• Women's health, and pre and postnatal nutrition
• Pediatrics
• Sports nutrition
• Vegan/vegetarian eating
• and more!
Download the Nourish app or visit our website https://www.nourish.com to get started today!

bluejetty:00099954:ios.description:
Welcome to your new virtual baby care game — the cutest mom life simulator family adventure!
From happy giggles to hungry cries, every moment in this babysitting game is part of a warm journey your children will love. This kids game lets your child learn to nurture, feed, and play with virtual little ones anytime and anywhere. It turns everyday care into fun games for girls and joyful learning for the whole family - a perfect start for early development and preschool fun.
Key features
- Virtual family baby daycare for safe and caring play
- Fun mini-games for kids
- Adorable room decorations
- Cute dress-up items for baby style
- Camera to capture family moments
Keep your baby happy
The baby’s needs change over time. Care for them with love and attention to keep them happy and smiling. You and your family can enjoy this baby simulator together. It teaches empathy, patience, and the joy of caring for others. This baby learning game brings families closer through play and helps kids understand what it means to raise a baby in a loving home.
Customize the room
Decorate a cozy space with colours, furniture, and accessories to make it warm and welcoming. Use imagination to make every corner special and full of joy for your family in this infant game. 
Dress up your baby
This kids game for girls is perfect for those who love fashion and creativity. Choose between different clothes, shoes, and accessories to dress your virtual baby in cute and playful outfits your whole family will enjoy. 
Capture special moments
Use the in-game camera to capture sweet family memories in your baby’s world. Create joyful moments that parents and children can cherish together every day. 
Why kids and parents love it
This is more than a mother simulator baby sitting app — it’s a full babysitter game where children and parents share joyful learning. Kids practice caring, feeding, and creativity. The app is safe and cheerful, offering parents a fun way to bond with their children and experience everyday life moments together.
Discover the joy of nurturing, playing, and creating in this family-oriented baby game with smooth controls and bright design. It’s perfect for fans of fun games for girls and for family playtime.
SUBSCRIPTION
Enjoy the game and get exclusive bonuses:
1. 18 premium games
2. 225 unique content items
3. "Baby Room Customization" feature
4. "Photo Saving" feature
5. Regular updates
Make your life easier with premium access:
- Check its advantages, by getting a free three-day trial. After 3 days, the trial will automatically turn to the weekly paid subscription.
- The paid subscription is divided into the 3 types: weekly, monthly, and year.
- A week paid subscription costs $9.99. Month - $19.99. Year - $99.99.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel the subscription or a free trial at any time, but at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE, it will be automatically renewed.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage the subscription and turn off the auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription.
- Read our privacy policy https://jmhdevelopers.com/privacy.html
And Terms of use https://jmhdevelopers.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00184801:ios.description:
Welcome to Sleep Fan!
The ORIGINAL sleep aid app!
Sleep Fan has helped countless satisfied users get to bed on time and stay asleep longer. We all know we should be getting more sleep. Studies have shown that a full night's sleep can significantly reduce all-cause mortality. Don’t sacrifice your health and well being. Download Sleep Fan tonight and wake up refreshed in the morning.
• Sleep fan is simple and easy to use.
• No signup, no hassle.
• Listen within seconds.
• Choose from an expanded library of sounds: original fan noises, plus Rain, Nighttime crickets, Relaxing meditation, Crashing Waves, and the River.
• Single-Day Sleep Tracking: Monitor your sleep cycles, blood oxygen, and heart data to get a personalized Custom Sleep Score.
• Apple Health Integration: Syncs seamlessly with Apple Watch and other compatible sleep trackers.
• Set a timer for your sleep sounds.
• Set the alarm clock to wake you up or hit snooze to get a little more sleep.
Sleep Fan is a perfect and simple tool that will reliably aid in the ease of falling asleep. Join the millions of satisfied users that proudly use Sleep Fan every night.
**PREMIUM FEATURES**
• Long-Term Sleep Trends: Full access to comprehensive Week and Month sleep tracking views.
• Ability to overlay binaural beats on top of sleep sounds.
• Listen to mind enhancing binaural beats by themselves.
• No advertisements.
Subscription pricing and terms:
Sleep Fan offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription at $1.99/month and an auto-renewing annual subscription at $14.99/year to provide you with unlimited access to the above features while you maintain an active subscription. Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of service: https://www.yappyapps.com/sleepfan/tos.html
Privacy policy: https://www.yappyapps.com/sleepfan/privacypolicy.html

bluejetty:00082465:ios.description:
【Ghoul World】
“Ghouls” lurk around Tokyo, hunting humans and devouring their flesh. Ken Kaneki, a bookworm who frequented the café “Anteiku”, met a woman there. Both were at a similar age, in a similar situation, and even fond of the same books; they began to grow closer. And yet… after a date in a bookstore, Ken Kaneki was involved in an accident that changed his fate, and was forced to transplant a "ghoul" organ...
Ken Kaneki regards this twisted world with doubt and uncertainty, yet all the while he's drawn into its clutches in an inescapably terrible spiral.
【Game Introduction】
◆Meet your favorite characters
Experience the dynamic battle scenes of the characters with 3D cel-shaded CG animation.
Create your powerful lineup with more than 30 characters!
◆Relive the classic scenes of “Tokyo Ghoul”
Return to the ghoul world in iconic cutscenes reimagined with 3D cel-shaded CG animation!
Experience this world that is never-fading, full of charm and uncertainty!
◆Battles full of strategies
The timing of releasing the Ultimate Skills and the lineups are the keys to your victory!
Strategic factors such as the order of skill releasing and the timing of the Ultimate Skills may also turn the tide!
◆Multiple game modes
Classic storylines between “humans and Ghouls”, Instances that can be challenged by a single player, co-op battles that allows you to fight along with other players, real-time PVP battles... There are so much more for you to experience!
【Automatic Subscription Service Description】
Subscription Service:
a) Monthly Pack (One Month)
Subscription Price:
a) Monthly Pack: The auto-renewing monthly product is priced at 4.99 USD/month.
Payment: After the user confirms the purchase and completes the payment, the amount will be charged to the iTunes account.
Auto-Renewal: The Apple iTunes account will be charged 24 hours before the current subscription expires. Once payment is successful, the subscription period will be extended by one cycle.
Service Cancellation: You can manage your auto-subscription service by going to "Settings" on your iPhone --> Enter "iTunes Store & App Store" --> Click "Apple ID," select "View Apple ID," and go to the "Account Settings" page. Tap "Subscriptions" to manage your subscription. To cancel, turn off the auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle. If canceled within 24 hours before expiration, no further charges will be made.
Privacy Policy: http://www.funcatgames.com/privacy-yy
terms：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00129061:ios.summary: Sikh World - Nitnem & Gurbani is your all-in-one app for daily Sikh spiritual practice. Read Nitnem Banis with synced audio, receive the daily Hukamnama, listen to live Gurbani radio, explore GuruSakhis, and read the complete Sri Guru Grant
bluejetty:00129061:ios.description:
Sikh World - Nitnem & Gurbani is your all-in-one app for daily Sikh spiritual practice. Read Nitnem Banis with synced audio, receive the daily Hukamnama, listen to live Gurbani radio, explore GuruSakhis, and read the complete Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji and Dasam Granth – all in one place.
KEY FEATURES
Live Gurbani Radio
● 24/7 Gurbani radio stations, including live Kirtan from Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple).
● Newly added stations for nonstop Gurbani & Kirtan.
● Lock screen and player controls with artist/song information.
● Sleep timer to stop the radio automatically.
● Alarm to wake up to live Gurbani.
Nitnem Banis
● All Nitnem Banis in one app – Japji Sahib, Jaap Sahib, Rehras Sahib, Kirtan Sohila, Sukhmani Sahib and more.
● Real-time text highlighting synced with Nitnem audio for an enhanced Paath experience.
● Read in Gurmukhi, Hindi and English with detailed meanings and explanations.
Hukamnama & Katha
● Daily Hukamnama with audio Katha for spiritual guidance and inspiration.
● Daily Hukamnama notifications.
Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji & Dasam Granth
● Complete Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji and Dasam Granth with improved text clarity and layout.
● Bookmark pages and save favourites for quick access.
Sikh History & Reference
● All Sikh Gurus with history and detailed information about Sikhism.
● Significance of Harmandir Sahib and other key landmarks.
Learn Gurmukhi
● Punjabi vowels, consonants and a Barakhadi chart with clear, easy-to-read guides.
Sikh Baby Names
● Meaningful Sikh baby names with descriptions and significance.
Gurudwara Finder
● Locate nearby Gurudwaras with details, photos and easy directions.
GuruSakhi with Audio
● Listen to Sakhis in audio with real-time text highlighting synced to the narration.
● 90+ Guru Nanak Dev Ji Sakhis and inspiring stories from Sikh history.
Shabad Kirtan
● Read a collection of Shabads in clear, easy-to-follow text.
● Follow along during Kirtan or use it for your daily Paath.
Waheguru Simran & Naam Jaap
● Immerse yourself in "Waheguru" Simran for meditation, focus and inner peace.
● Ideal for Amrit Vela, travel, or winding down before sleep.
More
● Multi-language support.
● Sikhwall – share your Sikhism posts with the community.
● Chat and share spiritual thoughts with the worldwide Sikh community.
● Add Nitnem, Hukamnama, Gurbani and Sakhi to favourites.
● Regular updates with new features and improvements.
WHY CHOOSE SIKH WORLD?
A dedicated app for Gurbani, Sikh teachings and community connection – with a clean, user-friendly interface and regular updates.
We are SHOUTcast partners and respect their work. To support us or listen to radio stations on your PC, please visit the SHOUTcast website. Questions? Email us at info@appaspecttechnologies.com
Disclaimer:
We strive to present authentic Sikh teachings through the Sikh World app, including Nitnem and other sacred texts. Minor variations may occur due to historical, linguistic or regional differences. If you notice any discrepancies, please contact us – your feedback helps us serve the community better.
Terms of Use: https://sikhworld.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://sikhworld.app/privacy.html
Join thousands of Sikhs worldwide. Download Sikh World today and begin your daily journey with Gurbani.

NOW HANGING IN CHICAGO, AUSTIN, BAY AREA AND COLUMBUS
Not in one of these cities? Sit tight—we’ll get to you soon. Or move here. Your call.
Hi, we’re Pie, a social app that helps you get a life. We wanna live in a world where finding things you like to do with people you enjoy is as easy as calling an Uber…so we’re building it.
The two main pieces of our Pie (we had to):
Things You Like To Do
Free local, IRL, actually-fun events that match your vibe. Think: DJ in a coffee shop, Sunday Morning Club, and Pop Culture Jeopardy.
People You Enjoy
Interesting, like-minded, actually-fun people you run into so many times that you accidentally become best friends. No pressure, no promises.
Other Ways Pie helps you Get a Life™ 
• A Personalized Feed: See what your friends and friends-of-friends are up to and who’s going to what.
• In-App Chat: Say hi, share photos, and make plans with all your new friends.
• Event Hosting: Create a private event or open it up to your friends’ network using snowball mode. (And duh, you can share the hang directly from the app via link, text, or airdrop.)
• Calendar Sync: Add events directly to your calendar so you can stay organized and curb your FOMO. 
Have feedback for us? Send it our way at support@getpie.app

bluejetty:00122266:ios.name: TV Cast for Sony Smart TV
bluejetty:00122266:ios.summary:
Watch any web-video, online movie, livestream or live tv show on your Sony TV, Hisense TV or VIDAA/VEWD powered Smart TVs. Enjoy the show on your big screen with the no#1 web video streamer.
With Video & TV Cast for Sony TV you can browse
bluejetty:00122266:ios.description:
Watch any web-video, online movie, livestream or live tv show on your Sony TV, Hisense TV or VIDAA/VEWD powered Smart TVs. Enjoy the show on your big screen with the no#1 web video streamer.
With Video & TV Cast for Sony TV you can browse the web and stream any web video, online movie, livestream or live tv show you want on your Sony TV. Mp4, m3u8, hls livestreams and also video-over-https are supported.
There is no time limit at all! You can watch videos of 2 minutes or 2 hours or even more. Just open Video & TV Cast, navigate to a website, wait for link detection and send the video with a single tap to your Sony TV. The discovered link will be shown below the browser. A tap on the link will start the show. You don't need to install a big media server like Plex or any other third party software.
>>> Important Notes
* To enable video casting please open the App Store on your Sony TV, search for 'TV Cast' and install the companion app.
* If your Sony TV is powered by Google Cast or Chromecast built-in, please download our dedicated App 'Video & TV Cast | Google Cast' to enable casting.
* Please enter the ip-address of your iPhone/iPad by using the number pad and up/down/left/right keys on your Sony Remote. Just enter the numbers, no need to press the enter key.
* iTunes movies, Flash video and DRM protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO now are not supported!
* Please test your favorite videos with the free edition before upgrading!
* Please use the Remote Playbar for video control while browsing (see more info below)
* The app streams only the video part of a website and not the whole website content (No screen or tab mirroring!). 
* Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming. It may also be neccessary to start casting multiple times until it works with specific videos.
* If a specific video is not working, please check the FAQ on the app startpage. If that does not help you, please drop us an email before leaving a negative comment on the App Store. We will try to add support for that website as soon as possible.
>>> UPGRADE FEATURES (available as in-app purchases)
* Premium Edition: Unlocks all of the features listed here. Also future features are included, so you do not have to pay for them when they are released in an updated app version. 
* Remote Playbar: Use the Playbar for advanced video control while browsing, including video scrubbing, forward, rewind, play, pause, stop.
* Local Videos: Cast your camera roll videos from an iPhone or iPad. Supports mp4, m4v and mov videos that were saved to the camera roll via Apples SD-Card/USB Adapter, iTunes Desktop Software or third party apps.
* Ad-Blocker: Blocks ads & popups on most websites and removes the sponsoring ads from the app. You can update and enable/disable ad-blocking at any time in the settings. 
* Bookmarks: Save unlimited website bookmarks. Synchronize and transfer them between different TV Cast apps and iOS devices by using backup and restore via iCloud.
* Desktop Mode: Change the browser user-agent and cloak your iPhone/iPad as a desktop PC to load the desktop website instead of a mobile website. Please note that this will NOT enable video casting on websites that serve Flash videos in desktop mode.
* Change Homepage: Set your personal homepage in the settings.
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with Sony or any other trademark mentioned here.

The Brazilian Table of Food Composition (TACO) is the result of a project coordinated by NEPA of UNICAMP with the support and financing of the Ministries of Health and Social Development.
In this table you will find more than 500 foods with their detailed nutritional compositions.
This application allows the table data, authored by the authors above, to be searched and organized automatically.

PRO VERSION:
- Save food as favorites, making it easier to search and use on a daily basis
- Generate an image with the nutritional properties of each food so that it can be shared
- Create lists to organize your diets: for example, create lists of breakfast, post workout, afternoon snack, etc!

The subscription will be renewed at the same cost. Please note: unused parts of the free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to the publication, when applicable. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase and at the beginning of each renewal period.

bluejetty:00178178:ios.description:
4=10 is a simple number puzzle game suitable for all ages. The objective is to use four given numbers and combine them in an expression that equals 10. For example, you can solve it by adding 1, 2, 3, and 4 together (1+2+3+4=10).
The game relies on basic math operations and starts off easy, gradually increasing in difficulty. It's designed to be a relaxed and soothing experience. You can play it with just one hand, using your phone whenever and wherever you like.
By playing this game, you'll become more comfortable with numbers and improve your basic math skills, including mental calculations, using parentheses, and following the correct order of operations.
Enjoy the game and happy calculating! :)

bluejetty:00146992:ios.summary:
Carrs Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Carrs’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food, pharmacy prescriptions and fuel. Choose convenience that fits your sche
bluejetty:00146992:ios.description:
Carrs Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Carrs’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food, pharmacy prescriptions and fuel. Choose convenience that fits your schedule: grocery delivery or DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup service. 
CONVENIENT GROCERY DELIVERY OR PICKUP 
Get grocery delivery or choose DriveUp & Go™ for easy curbside grocery pickup. Use Schedule & Save to automate your household essentials and save more on every order. Flash™ 30-minute delivery available in select markets for additional convenience. 
SEND GROCERIES AS A GIFT 
Shop, add a personalized message & send fresh groceries, flowers, chocolates or everyday essentials to anyone — delivered to their door or ready for store pickup. Select "Make this order a gift" at checkout, with no extra gifting fees. It is the perfect way to care for loved ones, celebrate special occasions, send a thoughtful thank-you gift or help out a friend with a fully stocked fridge. 
MEET YOUR AI SHOPPING ASSISTANT 
Take the guesswork out of meals with Ask AI. Use everyday language to ask for recipe ideas, find items based on dietary needs or compare products. Whether you're asking "What can I make with chicken and rice?" or looking for "gluten-free snacks," our assistant helps you build your grocery list fast. 
MEAL PLANNING & RECIPES 
Get inspired with thousands of shoppable recipes designed to fit every budget and preference. Import your favorite recipes into the app to convert ingredients into a digital shopping list. Plan your weekly menu & add all necessary items to your grocery shopping list with a single tap. 
SHOP EASIER & FASTER 
Quickly add items to your cart based on frequent purchases, recommendations & past orders. View and reorder from your order history at any time. Save your favorite household items, scan barcodes at home to add products to your digital cart instantly and build repeatable shopping lists. 
LOYALTY, DEALS & COUPONS 
Maximize your budget by clipping digital coupons, tracking your fuel points and watching your savings stack up automatically at checkout. Find hundreds of weekly grocery coupons, digital offers and exclusive sales. Earn, track and redeem Carrs for U™ rewards automatically as you shop. Try FreshPass® for unlimited free grocery delivery on eligible orders, exclusive perks and subscriber-only savings. 
SECURE SNAP/EBT & WIC PAYMENT OPTIONS 
Use your SNAP/EBT benefits to easily pay for online grocery delivery and DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup orders on eligible items, subject to state availability. WIC benefits are also accepted in store at participating Carrs locations only. 
YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD PHARMACY & HEALTH APP 
Order eligible prescriptions in the app and pick them up curbside through DriveUp & Go™ at 1,700+ participating pharmacy locations nationwide. Transfer your prescriptions to save more on your next grocery order, refill scripts for your family or pets, schedule vaccine appointments, access health tests and manage your wellness goals with Sincerely Health. Choose to bundle your Rx with your grocery pickup in one easy trip or go pharmacy-only. 
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS 
Monitor your nutrition, steps, sleep and activity. Earn rewards as you eat better, move more and stay active through the Sincerely Health wellness hub. Take advantage of custom health insights, track your daily wellness metrics, unlock premium rewards for making positive health choices and set achievable goals that support your complete physical well-being. 
FUEL 
Now you can pay and redeem Points for Fuel in the app. Save 10 cents off per gallon for every 100 Points, up to $1 off per gallon. Drive up, fill up and go! Available at select Safeway, Albertsons, Tom Thumb, Carrs, Randalls, Acme, and Vons-owned stations. 
Download the Carrs app and sign in or create your account to start shopping, saving and simplifying your week.

bluejetty:00018240:ios.description:
People's Mobile Banking from People’s Community Federal Credit Union allows you to manage your money anywhere life takes you. Whether you're paying bills, depositing a check, transferring funds, or just checking your balance; mobile banking is at your fingertips! Not yet a PCCU Online Banking User (required to use People’s Mobile Banking)? Go to www.peoplescu.org and sign-up today. Free to all People’s Community Federal Credit Union members (your mobile carrier's message and data rates may apply for People’s Mobile Banking).
Through People’s Mobile Banking, you can:
• View all your account balances
• Deposit checks quickly using your iPhone’s camera 
• Help avoid fees and get notified of suspicious activity with text or email alerts
• View your credit card transactions and manage your rewards program
• Make transfers between your accounts at People’s as well as at other Financial Institutions
• Pay your bills quickly and easily with Free Bill Pay
• With Popmoney, send money to just about anyone in the U.S. without sharing account numbers. All you need is their mobile number or email address.
Security:
Mobile data transmissions are safeguarded by 256-bit SSL (Secure Socket Layer) to prevent unauthorized access
We never transmit your account number (your accounts are referred to only by nicknames), and account information is not stored on your phone

bluejetty:00118755:ios.summary:
