bluejetty:00118755:ios.description:
Full CAD software to share, annotate, create and modify DWG drawings on the go.
### ABOUT ARES TOUCH ###
ARES Touch is a full CAD solution for professionals. It is the ideal companion to read, create, annotate or modify DWG drawings on your iPhone or iPad. Non-subscribers get access to viewing, sharing and dimensioning tools for FREE while subscribers get hundreds of additional tools to create or modify drawings.
TRY THE FULL EXPERIENCE FOR FREE: If you subscribe via In-App purchase you can cancel within 14 days and will not be charged.
### FREE FEATURES ###
=== The following features can be used for free: ===
- FREEDOM: Unlimited number of mobile devices for the same user
- CONTROL: Files can be synchronized with Dropbox, Box, iCloud or Google Drive, OR saved locally on the device.
- POWER: No size limitation to read, save or share 2D and 3D drawings in DWG
- UNIVERSAL: Save in DWG or export to JPEG
- Model space and layouts: switch as required
- Layers palette + advanced layer tools
- High precision tools: Selection, Snap, Loupe, Tracking, Coordinates Input (Polar/Cartesian, Relative/Absolute)
- Simple annotation: Add text, dimensions, leaders, tolerances, revision clouds
ARES Touch is available in English, Japanese and German. More languages are coming.
### PREMIUM FEATURES ###
=== Hundreds of additional features are available for subscribers: ===
- Drawing features: lines, polylines, circles, arcs, ellipses, splines, points, hatches…
- Editing features: Split, weld, trim, extend, align, offset, fillet, chamfer…
- Quick Modify: combine copy, move, rotate and scale actions with the same selection
- Picture Note: Annotate drawings with pictures and comments
- Voice Note: Insert a comment by recording your voice
- Blocks: insertion and creation
### THE ARES TOUCH SUBSCRIPTION ###
=== Get the full experience of ARES Touch ===
The features of the Free Simple Mode are great for viewing and simple annotation but you will need a valid subscription to access the premium features listed above.
To get the Premium features of ARES Touch, we invite you to buy a monthly renewable subscription from iTunes via In-App purchase, directly inside ARES Touch. If you purchased another Graebert software such as ARES Commander, and your subscription includes ARES Touch, you can simply use the same Graebert Account credentials (the one you use for other Graebert products) to log in inside ARES Touch, and this will unlock the Premium features for you.
If you subscribe via iTunes:
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews on a monthly basis unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the offered plan. Auto-renewal subscriptions can be managed straightforwardly via the Account Settings on the device after purchase. 
Customer portal: https://customer-portal.graebert.com/
Privacy Policy: https://www.graebert.com/company/privacypolicy
Terms of Use: https://www.graebert.com/arestouch/termsofuse
### ARES TOUCH FOR DEVELOPERS ###
=== First of its kind CAD platform for mobile apps ===
The C++ and Lisp API of ARES Touch offers an easy way for developers willing to reuse code initially created for the desktop. Developers willing to market a vertical application powered by ARES Touch can contact Graebert to discuss an OEM version.

bluejetty:00077154:ios.description:
This isn't just another fishing app—it's a fishing intelligence engine. LakeMonster's AI analyzes millions of data points to deliver predictive forecasts and tactical maps, giving you an unprecedented edge on the water.
Meet your new fishing partner. And it's an AI.
LakeMonster is the first fishing intelligence platform designed to think like an expert angler. Our powerful AI processes satellite imagery, weather patterns, bathymetric data, and thousands of historical fishing logs to translate complex data into one simple goal: helping you catch more fish.
Stop guessing. Start knowing.
THE AI-POWERED ADVANTAGE:
Predictive Fish Forecasts: Our AI doesn't just report the weather; it predicts fish behavior. Get dynamic forecasts showing peak bite windows and AI-generated hotspot maps for any lake.
Intelligent Safety Maps: Fish with greater confidence. The AI generates predictive Ice Safety Maps by modeling thickness based on weather history and lake dynamics. Our Water Clarity Maps use satellite data to help you find clear water and avoid murky areas.
Tactical Depth & Thermal Maps: Discover underwater structures where fish hide. The AI enhances high-accuracy Bathymetric Depth Maps and pinpoints thermoclines with Thermal Maps to show you exactly where to cast.
BUILT FOR THE SERIOUS ANGLER:
LakeMonster is the essential toolkit for:
Ice Fishing: Find safer ice and target active winter fish.
Kayak & Boat Fishing: Navigate with precision and discover new honey holes.
Tournament Anglers: Get the data-driven, competitive edge when every fish counts.
LakeMonster Pro – Unlock the Full AI Engine
Upgrade to unleash the platform's full potential:
Unlimited AI-Powered Fishing Forecasts & Hotspots
Advanced Predictive Ice Safety Mapping
Full access to Water Clarity, Thermal & 3D Depth Maps
AI-Generated Strategies for your Target Species
Free Version Available
Get started with basic lake conditions, standard weather, and free depth map previews.
Download LakeMonster. Upgrade your tackle box with an AI.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00171581:ios.summary: DrillRoom is your personal AI-powered pool coach, turning your iPhone or iPad into a smart training partner. Whether you're new to cue sports or aiming to compete at a higher level, DrillRoom helps you practice smarter with real-time feedba
bluejetty:00171581:ios.description:
DrillRoom is your personal AI-powered pool coach, turning your iPhone or iPad into a smart training partner. Whether you're new to cue sports or aiming to compete at a higher level, DrillRoom helps you practice smarter with real-time feedback, shot tracking, and drills for every skill level.
TRAIN SMARTER, NOT HARDER
DrillRoom harnesses the power of AI and augmented reality to systematize your training. Choose from drills focusing on speed control, shotmaking, and positional play. The best part? You receive real-time audio feedback, encouraging you to continue and improve. It's like having a personal coach in your pocket!
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Watch your game improve over time! DrillRoom helps you understand your performance by drill type and category, and tracks your shotmaking percentages and speeds. You'll see your progress right on your player's dashboard.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR TRAINING
Use the interactive drill editor to diagram and plan your shots. Define start positions, cue ball paths, and valid pockets, or draw complete layouts from scratch. Instantly capture real table positions with live detection to generate drills from real-world scenarios.
EASY SETUP
No fancy gear needed here! All you need is your iPhone or iPad, a tripod, and a well-lit billiard table. Simply set up your device 5 feet above the ground, and let DrillRoom take care of the rest.
UNLOCK MORE WITH SUBSCRIPTION
Ready to go to the next level? Subscribe to unlock over 50 drills, challenges, and premium features:
* Game Analysis: Get detailed shot analysis diagrams and stats after each drill.
* Multiple Profiles Support. Switch profiles to enable tracking game play & stats for many users. Ideal for families, and groups of friends.
* Shot video clips. Access and share video clips of your shots. Check your shooting stance.
* Challenges, such as Golf Pool, Centerfield Infinite Drill, and the Billiard University Exam I playing ability assessment.
Join the community of pool lovers transforming their game with DrillRoom. We love hearing from our users - send your suggestions and feedback to drillroom@orangeloops.com. And don't forget to visit drillroom.ai for news and updates.
Let's start your billiard journey today with DrillRoom!

bluejetty:00095700:ios.description:
Survive the apocalypse together in Dead Impact – the ultimate co-op zombie survival RPG!
Dive into the intense post-apocalyptic world of Dead Impact, a thrilling MMORPG adventure where survival depends on teamwork. Join forces with friends to raid dangerous locations, battle zombies and deadly bosses, and scavenge for essential supplies. Build your shelter, craft weapons, and upgrade your hero to become an unstoppable survivor.
- Co-op survival action: team up with friends or brave the challenges solo
- Unique classes, each with distinct abilities, so you can create your perfect fighting style and customize your appearance
- Weapons with special powers that can turn the tide of battle
- Survival game with increased durability of items, extensive crafting & construction system
- HARD MODE: for veteran survivors who crave even tougher battles and bigger rewards
- Battle Pass: complete quests and earn exclusive rewards
A world after the asteroid impact
After the asteroid’s destruction of civilization, humanity is scattered across desolate landscapes, clinging to life in small bands of survivors. As the undead roam and danger lurks around every corner, you and your team must find shelter, gather resources, and fight for survival in this transformed world.
Unite and conquer the undead together
Switch between classes like Rogue, Engineer, Alchemist, Trap Master, and Pyromancer—each with unique skills and playstyle.
Immersive multiplayer RPG
Form alliances with friends or other players during intense raids, use chat to coordinate your tactics, and face the challenges of the undead together. 
Customize your hero
In this immersive MMORPG, your hero’s destiny is yours to shape. Unlock new skills, fine-tune your equipment, and become the ultimate survivor.
Craft, loot, and build to thrive
Survive by gathering resources, crafting powerful gear, and constructing shelters to withstand the relentless undead. Conquer the apocalypse in this action-packed multiplayer RPG!
Explore a dangerous world
Journey through a vast open world, from desert sands to frozen forests and the ruins of abandoned cities. Brave the underground catacombs where the dead guard treasures beyond imagination.
Experience the ultimate zombie survival adventure in this cooperative online RPG. Build your team, customize your hero, and forge your path in a world reborn from destruction. Are you ready to face the challenge?

SnapType helps students keep up with their peers in class even when their penmanship holds them back. Students can easily complete school worksheets with the help of an iPad or iPhone.
With SnapType, students can take a picture of their wo
bluejetty:00026153:ios.description:
SnapType helps students keep up with their peers in class even when their penmanship holds them back. Students can easily complete school worksheets with the help of an iPad or iPhone.
With SnapType, students can take a picture of their worksheets, or import worksheets from anywhere on their device. They can then use their iOS device keyboard to add text to these documents and print, email, or share their creations. It is the perfect solution for kids, and even adults, who struggle with their handwriting. Just read a few of our amazing testimonials:
"Dear Amberlynn, Thank you so much for creating this app. You have changed the way my 12 year old son with dyspraxia functions in school. He is more independent and I cannot thank you enough. Please continue to help kids like my son. You are changing lives. Thank you."
"Thank you for this ! I am going to talk to my sons teachers about this -you are a blessing ! I can honestly tell you that I have spent many hours crying inside an Hurting watching my son struggle to write pages of sentences and spelling words and other homework - to the point that I have stopped him and honestly wrote for him left handed to make it look more like a neater version of his because I could not take it anymore ! Thank you"
"I just wanted to personally thank you for creating it, as this is an app that I use nearly every day with my son to do his homework. You have created an app with a simple interface, but with an incredibly powerful impact. Thank you."
"It is wonderful and something so simple yet so so so important for little guys like mine who cannot write BUT is learning to type and has so much to say and SHOW."
"We trialed SnapType with an 8-year old who is receiving school-based occupational therapy due to visual motor and visual perceptual issues. The biggest complaint from teachers about handwriting for this student was related to illegible answers on worksheets. The student quickly learned to take images of the worksheets with her iPad, upload them to the device and type in her answers. In addition to making her writing legible and eliminating issues with visual perceptual skills, the child's interest in the task was greatly improved, as was her pride in her work."
"Thank you so much Amberlynn. What a wonderful idea and gift to those kids that struggle with dysgraphia. I have converted many a workbook page for my son. This is WONDERFUL!"
"Thank you, thank you, thank you. I'm a mother of twins. My son is autistic and my daughter has cerebral palsy. They are still only 2 and a half... but I'm sure they will both need and use this. The fact that you have also made it free and are paying for it out of pocket is just the sweetest thing ever. I read about this last night and cried tears of joy. You are amazing! And I'm going to be telling everyone who will listen about you, this story, and your app. Thank you again, I truly appreciate it!!”

bluejetty:00061460:ios.description:
INAAM is a loyalty Program specially designed to aid the Purchasing habits of our loyal customers extending our service to a family audience by giving them an opportunity to shop more at much less through this innovative program.
INAAM would earn substantial savings to the vast number of customers who consider NESTO as their second home.
Currently operating in the countries of INDIA, UAE, KSA, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar, and Kuwait, the NESTO footprint is soon expected to expand into other markets in Asia.
NESTO is all about getting you All the Quality you need, All the Freshness you need, All the Style you need, All the Fashion you need, All the Range you need, and in short, All that you need to maintain a cost-effective, yet a quality-driven lifestyle.
INAAM adds value to this relationship by fetching your Reward Points for every purchase enabling you to redeem these points for more purchases.
1. How to collect points?
It is simple, just produce your card at the time of your purchase, the cashier will scan your card and complete the billing. The points will be credited to your card immediately. Please note that the points cannot be collected for Cigarettes and Telephone cards.
2. How many points do you collect for your purchase?
You will get 1 point for every AED 5 purchase.
3. How and when to get your vouchers? (Redemption of points)
- You can redeem your points to get the voucher on the basis of the above qualification criteria.
- Redemption of points for a voucher is possible at any time from the INAAM kiosk or the customer service Desk (CSD).
- Once you redeem your points for vouchers, equivalent points will be deducted from your total points available as of that date.

bluejetty:00152950:ios.description:
"The 2025 Tribal Adventure MMORPG is Now Available!
Answer the Call of the Wild. Start Your Hunt Now!
Lore
Parmons, once guarded by gods and ancient dragons, was plunged into darkness by the invasive evil dragon Niro.
With their sacrifice, the gods and dragons sealed him away, preserving the world's glory.
Now, as Niro stirs anew, you—an adventurer of the Howling Dragon Tribe—must rise, lead your tribe and sacred beasts to safeguard the continent's fate.
Features
▶ Boundless Hunting Ground
From dense rainforests to dragonbone deserts, explore a vast world blessed by gods and ancient dragons—yet filled with danger. This is your ultimate hunting ground, where every corner hides treasures, secrets, and powerful foes waiting to be conquered.
▶ Catch Pets Freely
Encounter and tame a wide variety of magical creatures in the wilds, abysses, and hidden realms of Pamons. They are not only pets, but trusted companions who fight fiercely by your side throughout your journey.
▶ Evolve & Ascend
Your pets have unlimited potential! Through battle and nurturing, help them evolve to unlock stunning new forms and devastating skills. Create a one-of-a-kind ultimate pet to take on the coming threats together.
▶ Join A Tribe
Evil can't be stopped by one alone. Call upon allies and form an ultimate hunting party. Team up with players of different classes, devise strategies, and experience true MMORPG camaraderie in intense co-op battles.
▶ Slay The Boss
Nihilo, the sealed evil dragon, has returned, and the world is once again at risk. Confront massive bosses from the otherworld with breathtaking skills and feel the thrill of the hunt. Every strike you make will shape the fate of Pamons."

Turn your phone into a personal AI stylist and body-measurement studio. Abody.ai combines AI body scanning, virtual try-on, size recommendations, health metrics, and progress tracking - everything you need to shop smarter, dress with confidence, and truly understand your body.
*******************************
WHAT'S NEW IN THIS VERSION
*******************************
MAGIC AI STUDIO — Try any outfit before you buy
- Real Try-On — Upload any clothing photo and see it on you instantly
- Future Body — Preview how you will look after reaching your fitness goals
- Surprise Me — Let AI style a random look tailored to your body shape
- Daily Drops — Fresh AI-curated outfits delivered every single day
SMART PROGRESS PHOTOS
- Capture front, side, and back with an on-screen pose guide
- AI pose-consistency score for honest, comparable results
- Before/After AI insights that summarize your transformation
BODY PASSPORT — Your personal AI body summary
- Custom body shape, proportions, and style guidance
- Auto-updates as your measurements evolve over time
STREAKS & MILESTONES
- Daily activity streak with 8 milestone rewards
- Streak Freeze protects you if you miss a single day
- Weekly AI Digest recaps your journey
VIRTUAL LOOKBOOK
- Save your favorite try-on looks in a personal AI closet
- Organize by category, style, or occasion, and share with friends
*******************************
AI BODY SCANNER — 20+ MEASUREMENTS IN UNDER 25 SECONDS
*******************************
- Follow a few simple on-screen poses — no measuring tape, no tailor visit
- Get precise chest, waist, hips, shoulders, thighs, arms, and more
- Track how your body changes over weeks and months
- Beautiful trend charts for BMI, body fat, and waistline
- Share measurements with your designer, tailor, personal trainer, or family
*******************************
PERFECT CLOTHING SIZE — SAY GOODBYE TO RETURNS
*******************************
- Match your body to the exact size across hundreds of brands
- Works for men, women, and kids
- Constantly updated size database
- Pair with our free Chrome extension "Abody.ai: True Fit Size For Shopping" and get instant size recommendations on Amazon, ASOS, Shein, Zara, H&M, and other top stores
- Extension: https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/abodyai-true-fit-size-for/cobfpgeggnjajehgdpnmfiikpadmeijh/
*******************************
HEALTH INSIGHTS THAT UNDERSTAND YOU
*******************************
- Body Shape analysis (Apple, Pear, Hourglass, Rectangle, Inverted Triangle)
- BMI and Body Fat % with personalized interpretation
- BMR and TDEE calculators for calorie and fitness goal planning
- Weight Log with AI-generated insights linking your weight to measurements
- Celebrity Body Match — discover which style icon shares your shape
*******************************
BUILT FOR EVERYONE
*******************************
- Available in 14 languages: English, Vietnamese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Indonesian, Malay
- Supports UK, US, and metric units
- Modern dark and light modes
- Privacy-first — your photos and measurements stay private and secure
*******************************
ABODY STUDIO — UNLOCK EVERYTHING
*******************************
Upgrade to Abody Studio for the full Magic AI experience:
- 50 Magic Credits every month, shared across Real Try-On, Future Body, Surprise Me, and Daily Drops
- Unlimited body scans and full Lookbook capacity
- Weekly AI Digest and premium body insights
- 7-day free trial — cancel anytime
*******************************
Start free today. Whether you want the perfect online fit, a smarter wardrobe, or a clearer picture of your body's progress, Abody.ai is your all-in-one AI companion for fashion, fitness, and confidence.
*******************************

bluejetty:00134692:ios.description:
Juggernaut Training Systems’ revolutionary A.I. strength training system has arrived on iOS. Subscribe to JuggernautAI to access all our coaching and get stronger than you can imagine with The Smartest Program for You.
Designed by legendary coach Chad Wesley Smith with revolutionary technology by Tim Arnold, JuggernautAI is like having the best strength coach in the world with you during every workout in the gym.
HOW IT WORKS
JuggernautAI helps you reach your strength potential using our cutting edge technology - the JuggernautAI Powerlifting and Powerbuilding system - in an efficient and easy to use way;
Decide on your goal of Powerlifting, to focus on building your Squat, Bench, and Deadlift, or Powerbuilding, to balance your focus between bodybuilding and strength training. 
Tell us about yourself, your level of experience, and your strength goals 
JuggernautAI will then design a unique individualized program tailored just for you with the use of expert technology 
As you progress, the system will continue to adapt your training plan based on your real-time individualized feedback, ensuring you continue to grow and achieve your strength goals.
WHY IT WORKS
Your JuggernautAI strength program is specifically tailored to your needs and includes;
◆◆ Individualized Volume Landmarks. 
Do enough training to advance but not so much that you can’t recover.
◆◆ Optimized Training Frequency. 
Decide how many days a week you want to train, and JuggernautAI will optimize when and how often you should Squat, Bench, and Deadlift.
◆◆ Personalized Periodization Strategy. 
JuggernautAI finds the best way to progress to ensure you maximize your training while also managing fatigue through a strategic phasic periodization plan.
◆◆ Exercise Selection for your Weak Points. 
JuggernautAI looks at your weak points and your strength in individual lifts to decide which exercises will be most effective in helping you improve.
As a Powerbuilding user, you can also choose which body part to focus on to ensure your physique improves the way you want it to.
◆ Real-Time Feedback
Your unique individualized program continues to adapt to your feedback with our Readiness Rating System, making adjustments to your program pre-session, intra-session, session to session, week to week, block to block, and program to program
Subscribe to JuggernautAI and get the smartest program for you.
———-
ABOUT JUGGERNAUT TRAINING SYSTEMS
Juggernaut Training Systems is The Leader in Strength, having helped thousands of athletes from beginners to World Champions maximize their results and reach their goals. We deliver principle-based coaching through cutting-edge technology to help you get the best results of your life.
Privacy Policy: https://www.jtsstrength.com/app-privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.jtsstrength.com/app-terms-of-use/

SEE WHAT’S AIRING
• LOCAL LISTINGS: Get a personalized channel schedule by selecting any cable, satellite, or antenna provider in North America.
• NEW TONIGHT: See the top new primetime shows airing on both broadcast and cable, including CBS, NBC, ABC, Fox, Ion, HGTV, Hallmark, USA Network, History, TLC, TBS, Discovery, TNT, The CW, and A&E.
• FAVORITE CHANNELS: View the listings schedule for the channels you love by saving your favorites.
• TIME JUMP: Jump to the primetime lineup for tonight, tomorrow, or any date within the next 2 weeks.
STAY UP TO DATE ON YOUR FAVORITES
• COMING SOON: See upcoming episodes, seasons, or premieres of shows and movies from your Watchlist.
• AVAILABLE NOW: Browse the VOD titles on your Watchlist, and tap Quick Watch to start watching on the best available service.
• AIRING REMINDERS: Get notified 30 minutes before a show or movie on your Watchlist begins airing.
• WATCHLIST EMAIL DIGEST: Check out last week's news and streaming additions, and get ready for next week’s lineup.
Download TV Guide today to keep up with all the best TV shows and movies!

bluejetty:00037818:ios.description:
Vivaldi Browser is a powerful, personal, and private web browser. It comes packed with built-in features including desktop-style tabs, an Ad Blocker, tracking protection. Designed to put you back in control. Trusted by millions of users across the world.
FEATURES:
- Ad Blocker: Browse with minimal distractions.
- Tracker Blocker: Stay protected with leading privacy and security features.
- Custom Wallpapers & Themes: Pick a theme and background that matches your style.
- Dark Mode for all webpages: Force Dark Mode to every website you visit.
- Desktop-like tabs: Efficiently manage multiple websites at once.
- Encrypted Sync: Seamlessly sync data across your mobile and desktop devices.
- Notes: Jot down thoughts and ideas while browsing.
- Bookmarks: Organize your favorite sites effortlessly.
- Reading Lists: Save articles for offline reading.
- Custom App Icon: Personalize Vivaldi's appearance on your home screen.
- Switch Search Engines: Choose your preferred search engine on the fly.
POWERFUL
Packed with flexible features, all built in.
PERSONAL
You make it your own, Vivaldi adapts to you.
PRIVATE
We don't track you, or your behavior.
DESKTOP-LIKE TABS
Bring the robust tab management from your desktop to your iOS device. Vivaldi on iOS features a unique Tab Bar akin to the desktop browser. To activate or deactivate the Tab Bar, head to Vivaldi menu > Settings, and tap on "Show Tab Bar" to toggle the setting.
SYNC ACROSS DEVICES
Never feel out of touch. Sync your data across devices with end-to-end encryption. From open tabs and saved logins to bookmarks and notes, everything is seamlessly available wherever you go. Add an extra layer of security with an encryption password.
SET AS DEFAULT BROWSER
Ready to make the switch? Set Vivaldi as your default browser and experience the web like never before. Here's how: Go to Settings, scroll down to Vivaldi, and select it as your Default Browser App. It's that simple!
ABOUT VIVALDI
With millions active users and a vibrant community of over 1.4 million members worldwide, Vivaldi is redefining what a web browser can be. At Vivaldi, we believe a browser should be powerful, personal, and private. With our unique philosophy of "respect, question, create, and deliver," we're crafting a browsing experience that adapts to you, not the other way around.
Some of the links in this app are affiliate links. If you make a purchase through these links, we may earn a commission at no additional cost to you. This helps support the development of Vivaldi and keeps the web browser independent. Thank you for your support!
By downloading Vivaldi, you are agreeing to the End User License Agreement at https://vivaldi.com/privacy/vivaldi-end-user-license-agreement/. Learn more about how Vivaldi handles and protects your data in our Privacy Policy at https://vivaldi.com/privacy/browser/.

bluejetty:00078619:ios.name: Phlow: Pro Camera Photo Editor
bluejetty:00078619:ios.summary:
Here's everything you get when you subscribe today (we think it's a steal): 
* PHLOWSYNC™: A world first! Never before have you been able to go from capture to professionally colored photo straight to Photos App in full RAW non-destructive
bluejetty:00078619:ios.description:
Here's everything you get when you subscribe today (we think it's a steal): 
* PHLOWSYNC™: A world first! Never before have you been able to go from capture to professionally colored photo straight to Photos App in full RAW non-destructively. No more exporting or duplicate files. Just shoot photos with Phlow and edit them as you normally would. All changes sync back to that file in Photos App. 
* PRO (RAW) CAMERA:
No Fusion. No Jpgs (unless you want them)… The heart of Phlow is our raw camera. Shoot stunning images in PhlowRAW (our proprietary raw imaging process) with your favorite presets and film emulations in real time. Whether you're looking for a vintage effect, polaroid style vibe, or subtle film effect, we have you covered. 
* INTERVAL CAMERA (SELF TIMER):
Solo content creators rejoice! Our beautiful interval camera allows you to take up to 30 photos in your desired interval timing (a photo every 2, 3, 5, 10 seconds etc). 
* UNRIVALED PRO PHOTO & VIDEO FILTERS AND PRESETS (SETS):
Quality over everything. We've perfected the art of color grading to make your life easier. Simple, stunning, and mistakable for film. Natural pro-level color grading including film filters, photo grain, and film effects.
* LIVE PRESET VIDEO COLOR GRADING:
Shoot live videos with your favorite video filter effects and color in real time! A huge time saver for those who want to just shoot and post. Great for longer form content, selfie videos, YouTube makeup tutorial style videos and anything else you don't want to manually edit. 
* SEAMLESS CAMERA ROLL INTEGRATION:
Editing photos and editing videos from anywhere on your device through our seamless camera roll integration. 
* 4K VIDEO EDITING (COLOR GRADING):
Beautiful color grading over your 4K footage, with the ability to scrub and trim your video while you edit. 
* BLUR TOOL, BLOOM TOOL, GRAIN TOOL (MORE COMING SOON!):
The perfect effects for that dream glow and film aesthetic.
* STACK+ "TAP TO ADD" EFFECTS:
STACK+ quick add-ons are a simple way to quickly layer effects on top of your edit. Add authentic Film Curves and effects for real film effects, one click color toning color enhancers, fades and more. 
* HDR VIDEO COLOR GRADING:
HDR is here to stay but that doesn't mean those videos can't be colored to your liking. Your HDR content can now look just as good as your standard video color grades. 
* PRO TOOLS:
Tools that just work well. Pro level exposure tool, HSL for targeting specific colors, copy/paste, and many more to come in future updates.
* PROFESSIONAL LEVEL EXPORT QUALITY:
Forget fuzzy uploads. High quality exports are here and they separate your content from the crowd. Stunning exports that will stand out on instagram, TikTok, and all other social platforms. 
* PHLOW CAMERA WIDGET:
Quick draw access to the Phlow camera! One tap of our widget opens the camera so that you never miss the moment
Join the Phlow family today! We're excited to see you on the inside. 
What others are saying:
"This app is one of the most incredible things I've come across! The raw camera has absolutely blown me away!!! It shoots so dang good and my husband also hasn't stopped raving about it. I just got home from a Europe trip and I was able to get some amazing pictures throughout the beautiful places we visited with Phlow!"
Auto renewable subscription information: 
Start your Phlow subscription with a 7 day free trial on our annual plan. Once your trial ends, you will be charged for the annual subscription. Your Phlow subscription will automatically renew, unless auto renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off your subscription anytime from your phone settings. The seven day trial only applies to the annual subscription.

Read our privacy policy: https://phlowapp.com/pages/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00161384:ios.description:
The Oxford Tube app is here – making travel between Oxford and London even easier.
Time matters, so the Oxford Tube app puts everything you need right at your fingertips.
With a live route map, real-time coach tracking, and expected arrival and departure times, you can plan your journey with confidence and stay in control every step of the way.
The interactive map and journey planner help you make the most of your time in the city – whether you’re heading to work, meeting friends, or catching a connection.
App features:
Follow your coach in real time
See your coach moving along the route and check exactly how far away it is, so you can time your journey perfectly.
Explore the interactive route map
View all stops and coaches in service. Just tap to see journey details and plan your next trip.
Save your favourites
Heading to the same stops often? Save your favourite journeys and stops to make planning even quicker.
Buy and use mobile tickets
Purchase tickets safely and securely on your phone. Your ticket appears instantly – simply activate it when you’re ready to board and show it to the driver.
Share the journey
Buy tickets for others or gift unused tickets to friends or family if your plans change.
Everything you need for travel between Oxford and London – all in one place.
It’s an Oxford Tube thing.

bluejetty:00029633:ios.name: GymGoal Pro
bluejetty:00029633:ios.summary:
Praised by pros and trainers as the most capable and flexible workout planner and tracker.
• The only app that can handle any routine and workout.
• Organizes your workouts and helps you reach your goals in strength, muscle size or weight
bluejetty:00029633:ios.description:
Praised by pros and trainers as the most capable and flexible workout planner and tracker.
• The only app that can handle any routine and workout.
• Organizes your workouts and helps you reach your goals in strength, muscle size or weight loss. It will empower you with knowledge and revolutionize your workouts.
• Featured in The New York Times, Consumer Reports, The Daily. 
FEATURES 
(Everything is included immediately. No additional purchases)
• 390 exercises with animations and step by step instructions. You can add your own exercises.
• Text, pictures, animated GIFs and youtube clips can be attached to any exercise.
• 67 workout routines. You can add your own routines.
• Flexible tracking system for strength, cardio, plyometrics, stretching workouts, circuit training, Tabata or any other workout type. Supports supersets, freeform notes and much more. Workout history is fully editable.
• The workout logging screen is optimized for fast data entry, but remains feature-rich. You can copy data from the history, add new exercises, images and videos without interrupting your workout.
• Bodyweight and assisted-weight exercises automatically account for your body weight.
• Timers for exercise duration, rests, circuits.
• GymGoal calculates your One Rep Max for every exercise.
• Workout history by muscle shows muscles that you neglect.
• Weekly and rotating schedules support up to 4 workout sessions a day.
• Heart rate monitoring with Apple Watch or a Bluetooth 4 device. While working out: graph, max/average, warning when heart rate leaves the target zone. In the workout history: heart rate graphs, stats.
• GPS tracking. Interactive map during the workout. Trail, distance and speed recording. Maps saved to the workout history. Distance, time, speed shown for any trail part.
• Body measurements tracking plus additional custom trackers.
• The best in class Body Fat tracking module includes calculators, several skinfolds (calipers) methods, direct entry.
• One-rep Max, BMI, BMR, TDEE, Target Heart Rate calculators and progress tracking.
• Apple Watch support - workout logging, heart rate, timers.
• Integration with the Health app: two-way syncing of BMI, BMR, Body Fat, weight and height, export of workout data, including burned calories.
• Two-way syncing with RunKeeper and MapMyFitness - both cardio and strength workouts.
• You don't need an Internet connection - everything is stored on your device.
• Ability to back up your data to the server (free), or to email it. You can copy your data between iPhones and other supported devices.
• Workout logs, measurements, routines and the schedule can be emailed for review and printing. Workout logs can be opened in Excel.
• Up to 50 user accounts.
YOU CAN DEPEND ON GYMGOAL 
• GymGoal is in AppStore since 2008. It is used by over a million people, from beginners to pro athletes and trainers, and even in schools. 
• Many people have 9 years of detailed workout history in GymGoal. Years of history do not slow GymGoal down.
• Updates will not lose your routines, schedule or workout history. Even if your iPhone breaks, you will be able to restore your data from the server backup.

* External keyboard and landscape orientation are supported
* Practices are highly customizable
Many more features are waiting for you to explore.
After proper training, you can type faster than native speakers. It is not that difficult as long as you use the right tool. Try it, you will find.

bluejetty:00128014:ios.description:
Welcome to Bubble Boxes, an exceptional 3D balloon collecting, tri-matching extravaganza that seamlessly combines the compelling aspects of real matching master challenges and balloon master 3d puzzles into a dazzling display of interactive entertainment. As a treasure among puzzle games, Bubble Boxes transcends the typical balloon games with its unique triple match framework and enchanting tiles that captivate both the savvy enthusiast and the casual gamer.
Uncover the Magic:
Immerse yourself in an array of splendid levels where matching balloons becomes an art form, and pop your way to victory as a balloon crusher mastering every twist and turn.
Revel in a palette of puzzles that require the deft touch of a balloon master, ensuring that each balloon pop is as satisfying as the last.
Bubble Boxes is designed to be among the free games that cater to a global audience, packing every match puzzle game with excitement and unexpected delights.
Features that Spark Joy and Ignite the Mind:
Enjoy this balloon game with over hundreds of mesmerizing stages, with each one requiring you to match triple balloon sets for that satisfying bubble match.
The offline games functionality means you can indulge in balloon wala game action whenever you desire, independent of wi-fi constraints—ideal for sharpening your skills on the go.
Face the ever-increasing challenge and display your prowess in becoming a triple match aficionado, carefully planning moves to orchestrate the ultimate balloon triple match.
With the balloon pop match 3 feature, engage in a dynamic balloon game that tests your strategic thinking, making Bubble Boxes a superior choice among brain games.
Exclusively Curated for Every Player:
Bubble Boxes welcomes every player into its magical realm, whether you're a real matching master or a newcomer to the balloon game scene.
As a game that continually evolves, 2025 brings even more invigorating levels to this balloon game, ensuring it remains a frontrunner among free puzzle games and brain puzzles.
Games for adults and games for girls alike, "Bubble Boxes" does not discriminate. It's a brain-training puzzle game designed to bring people together through the power of play.
The balon-fueled adventure also integrates teaching elements, making it one of the educational yet fun games that empower players to expand their cognitive abilities through engaging match 3 games.
Beyond the Match:
True to its name, Bubble Boxes propels you into a 3D bubble boxes match scenario where each successful combo triggers a satisfying animation and rhythmic sound, reinforcing the joy of gameplay.
With every triple match balloon game level you conquer, revel in the sense of accomplishment as you join the ranks of balloon masters worldwide.
There has never been a better time to dive into the free, offline, 3D balloon-popping phenomenon that is Bubble Boxes. With a cornucopia of stages that never cease to amaze, updated regularly to keep the balloon game fresh and engaging, it's not just a game – it's your next puzzle obsession.
Don't miss out on the match 3 tiles action, download Bubble Boxes today and let the fun balloon games begin! As you journey towards becoming a matching games legend, remember, each match, each burst, and each level takes you one step closer to puzzle glory.

・Students who want to stay focused on their studies
・Remote workers or freelancers who want to be more productive
・Anyone who wants to spend their time wisely
---
May the bluebird of happiness cross your path.

bluejetty:00087661:ios.name: Canada Citizenship Prep 2025
bluejetty:00087661:ios.summary:
Get ready for your Canadian citizenship test with practice questions based on Discover Canada, the official study guide.
Canada Citizenship Prep Guide gives you everything you need in one calm, easy-to-use app: realistic practice tests, th
bluejetty:00087661:ios.description:
Get ready for your Canadian citizenship test with practice questions based on Discover Canada, the official study guide.
Canada Citizenship Prep Guide gives you everything you need in one calm, easy-to-use app: realistic practice tests, the full study guide as an audio book, key dates in Canadian history, and facts about every province and territory.
UP TO DATE FOR 2026
The question bank has been reviewed and refreshed with 470 extra questions, including recent changes you may be asked about:
• King Charles III as Canada's Head of State
• The updated Oath of Citizenship, which recognizes the rights of Indigenous Peoples
• Truth and Reconciliation, and the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation
• Canada's current Governor General and Prime Minister
• The gender-neutral wording of O Canada
A dedicated "Recent updates" test covers all of these.
PRACTICE THE WAY YOU LIKE
• Practice Mode: take your time and see the right answer after every question
• Timed Mode: 20 seconds per question to build test-day confidence
• Random tests: 20 questions drawn from the whole bank, with your best and last scores saved
• 16 Full Tests: work through every question in the bank, one test at a time, and track which ones you've passed
FEEDBACK THAT ENCOURAGES YOU
Wrong answers aren't punished. You'll see the right answer clearly with a gentle "Good try!" so you learn from every question and keep going.
LISTEN TO DISCOVER CANADA
Download the audio book once and listen any time, even offline. Playback continues in the background and from your lock screen, so you can study while you commute, cook or walk.
LEARN THE ESSENTIALS
• History: key years and dates in Canada's story, with search
• Provinces & Territories: capitals and key facts for all 13
• Did You Know?: a new fact about Canada every time you open the app
DESIGNED FOR FOCUS
A clean, dark design that's easy on the eyes, on both iPhone and iPad. Your progress stays on your device.
ABOUT THE TEST
The citizenship test has 20 questions, and you need 15 correct answers to pass. It covers the rights and responsibilities of citizens, Canada's history, geography, economy, government, laws and symbols. Applicants aged 18 to 54 usually take the test.
This app is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of Canada or Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC). Always check IRCC's website for the latest official information.
Good luck — and welcome to Canada!

bluejetty:00151764:ios.summary: Heartopia is a life simulation game with a high degree of freedom, developed by XD Inc. In Heartopia, a day can start with watering the flowers, or a chat with friends can turn into a trip to the beach. Fishing, cooking, caring for pets, pl
bluejetty:00151764:ios.description:
Heartopia is a life simulation game with a high degree of freedom, developed by XD Inc. In Heartopia, a day can start with watering the flowers, or a chat with friends can turn into a trip to the beach. Fishing, cooking, caring for pets, playing music. Turn your hobbies into everyday life, and slowly make a little house feel like home. No matter your appearance, voice, or gender, and no matter your personality or talents, you can express yourself freely. If you want company, drop by a friend's place. If you want quiet, take a walk and enjoy the view. How you spend your days is up to you.
[Game Features]
◆ Let's Connect! Create Unique Memories
Chat with the charming residents of Heartopia Town, hang out with old friends, and meet new friends every time you log in!
◆ Let's Explore! Gardening, Fishing, Birding...
Hobbies are yours to enjoy, not chores. In Heartopia, feel free to develop six major hobbies, including fishing, cooking, gardening, birdwatching, and more.
◆ Let's Build! Design Your Dream House
Whether you dream of a cozy cottage or a magnificent mansion, Heartopia gives you the tools to turn your vision into a reality. You can also invite your friends over and build your dream home together. 
◆ Let's Dress Up! 1000+ Daily Outfits
Mix and match casual wear, elegant gowns, and whimsical costumes to create the perfect look for any occasion. Express your mood and show the world who you are.
◆ Let's Pet! Adopt Cats and Dogs
Meet your very own animal companions in Heartopia! While each of your furry friends may come with different colors and personalities, they can all bring you warmth and comfort.
[Follow Us]
X：@myheartopia
TikTok：@heartopia_en
Facebook：Heartopia
Instagram：@myheartopia
YouTube：@heartopia-official

bluejetty:00188020:ios.description:
Make your side hustle sizzle with Bacon!
As a flexible work marketplace, Bacon connects you with established companies to work on-demand hourly jobs near you.
Say goodbye to set schedules and hello to flexible work! With Bacon, you get to choose when and where you work, who you work for, and which jobs you take.
Whether you need some extra cash for a trip or just want to try something new, Bacon connects you with flexible work opportunities close to home. Simply jump on the app, search for shifts in your area that best suit your interests and skill level, and apply with one click. You don’t even need an interview or resume!
Within the app, you will find a variety of shifts in industries such as Warehousing, Manufacturing, General Labor, Catering, Cleaning, Events, and more.
After you’ve been accepted for a shift and finish working, you will be able to rate the company you worked with and they will rate you. When you perform at your best it builds your Bacon presence, which leads to more gigs and opportunities for leveling up with our brand new “Level Up” program!
After you’ve worked a shift, the payment process is quick and easy: simply choose between Quick Pay or Weekly Pay on the app and get money deposited into your account as soon as 24 hours later. With Bacon, every day can be payday! 
Working hard never tasted so good.
What are people saying about Bacon?
- “I just love that I have the flexibility to find work where I want and when I want. Bacon is one of the best work apps I’ve found!” -Harmonie
- “The Bacon work app allowed me to fill gaps in my schedule to increase my income at a much faster rate than it would’ve taken to apply for various jobs the traditional way.” -Marc
- “When my husband retired, I needed to have the freedom in my life to pick up and go out of town. The Bacon App works perfect for that. I can work when I want to and be off when I need to.” -Janelle
- “After using Bacon over the summer I was able to save up more than $500 dollars of extra income per week. Right before school started, the money I’d saved from Bacon allowed me to take a trip to New York with some friends!” -Kaitlin
For more information about Bacon, visit baconwork.com or contact us at support@baconinc.com.
Hoping to find a gig near you? Download the app today to see what shifts might be waiting around the corner.
Bring it home!
>> Want to refer a friend? Simply log into the Bacon app for a unique referral link. After your friend works their first shift, you’ll receive a $25 dollar bonus!

bluejetty:00043442:ios.summary:
Swally – Your life organized, in a single app

bluejetty:00043442:ios.description:
Swally – Your life organized, in a single app
No more chaos, no more forgotten tasks, no more overflowing wallets! Swally is the all-in-one app that organizes documents, finances, home, cards, notes and reminders in a smart, simple and fast way. Designed for those who want everything under control, stress-free.
NEW: Finances and Home
Personal and family finances
Keep track of your money without connecting your bank. Record income, expenses and transfers, organize everything by accounts and categories and instantly see where your money goes.
- Accounts, income, expenses and transfers
- Monthly budgets and savings goals
- Automatic recurring transactions
- Charts, analysis and period comparison
- CSV export and data export
- Shared family spaces: manage household expenses together
Home, purchases and warranties
Turn Swally into the archive of your belongings: no more lost receipts or warranties expiring without noticing.
- Product inventory by room and category
- Receipt scanning with OCR: store, date and total filled in automatically
- Warranties with alerts before they expire
- Recurring maintenance with reminders
- Photos, receipts and manuals attached to each product
- Reports on the value of your belongings and PDF export for insurance
- Shared family inventory
Everything you love about Swally
Smart reminders
Set a memo and get a notification at the right time. Never miss a deadline again!
Deadlines Hub
Documents, warranties and maintenance in a single view, with automatic alerts before expiry.
Colorful and organized notes
Write, customize, group. Your ideas have never been so tidy and nice to look at, with checklists and attachments.
Loyalty cards always with you
Goodbye bulky wallets! Save all your loyalty cards and show the barcode straight from your iPhone.
Personal document management
Securely store important documents (passport, ID card, tax code, driver's license and more). Each document has tags and quick search, with automatic OCR filling and expiry alerts.
QR codes always ready
Scan, save or create QR codes and barcodes in a second. Useful, fast, immediate.
Built-in calculator
Need a quick calculation? The calculator is already inside Swally.
Secure and private
Biometric unlock (Face ID / Touch ID), data available offline and optional cloud backup to find everything on every device.
Why choose Swally?
Because it makes life easier. From documents to reminders, from finances to household belongings, from cards to notes: everything in a single app, always at hand. Swally is designed for you who want to live better, with less stress and more organization. Once you try it, you won't be able to do without it!
Swally PRO
Unlock unlimited accounts and products, budgets and goals, unlimited OCR, maintenance, reports, PDF/CSV export, shared family spaces and no ads.
The Swally PRO subscription is available with automatic renewal. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings.
For information, feedback or new ideas, write to us at: theswallyapp@gmail.com
Download Swally and organize documents, expenses, warranties and deadlines in a single app. Start for free today!
Privacy Policy: https://swally.app/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00116212:ios.description:
Robux Wallet for Roblox
Track Robux, Codes & Value in one smart wallet.
About the App :
Robux Wallet for Roblox is a virtual-currency manager built for players who want a crystal-clear view of their Robux balance, spending, and game-item value—all without hacks, generators, or misleading promises.
Key Features :
- Smart Balance Management
• Real-time Robux balance tracking
• Manually add or remove funds for perfect accuracy
• Clean Dark-Mode interface for late-night sessions
- Advanced Analytics
• Detailed breakdown of every spend and earn event
• Visual charts for daily, weekly, or custom ranges
• Category filters to spot where your Robux really goes
- Brain Sprint Challenge
• 30-second math sprints that sharpen quick-count skills
• Earn streaks and level-ups for every five correct answers
• Difficulty scales as you improve—fun practice for fast traders
- Asset Management
• Track limited items, game passes, and their current values
• Organize your collection with tags and custom notes
• View simple price-history snapshots and value estimates
- Smart Goals
• Set Robux saving targets for that dream limited or avatar upgrade
• Progress rings and milestone celebrations keep motivation high
• Flexible timelines—daily, weekly, or custom deadlines
- Premium Experience
• Smooth animations & intuitive navigation
• Secure iCloud backup plus import/export options
• Seamless sync across all your iOS devices
- Security & Privacy
• End-to-end encryption for local and cloud data
• Zero personal data collection—your wallet stays yours
• Regular security updates and bug fixes
Perfect For :
• Roblox traders and collectors

bluejetty:00087650:ios.name: Smart TV Remote Universal
bluejetty:00087650:ios.summary:
Lost the remote again? Your phone is now the only remote you need.
Smart TV Remote Universal turns your iPhone or iPad into a fast, reliable remote for nearly any smart TV — no infrared, no extra hardware, and no digging through couch cush
bluejetty:00087650:ios.description:
Lost the remote again? Your phone is now the only remote you need.
Smart TV Remote Universal turns your iPhone or iPad into a fast, reliable remote for nearly any smart TV — no infrared, no extra hardware, and no digging through couch cushions. Pair once over Wi-Fi and take control in seconds.
ONE APP FOR EVERY TV IN YOUR HOME
Pair multiple TVs and switch between rooms instantly — no re-pairing, no setup every time. Living room to bedroom in one tap.
CONTROL EVERYTHING
Power, volume, channels, inputs, playback and a full D-pad — every button from your physical remote, right on your screen, with real haptic feedback on every press.
TYPE INSTEAD OF HUNTING LETTERS
Stop picking letters one at a time on the TV screen. Use your phone's keyboard — or the numeric pad — to search shows, sign in to apps and enter passwords in a fraction of the time.
SWIPE TO NAVIGATE
A smooth trackpad lets you glide through menus with your thumb — faster and more natural than pressing arrow keys.
SPEAK INSTEAD OF SCROLLING
Use voice input to search and navigate on supported TVs — completely hands-free.
LAUNCH YOUR APPS IN ONE TAP
The apps grid takes you straight to your favorite streaming apps without hunting around the home screen.
CONTROL FROM YOUR HOME SCREEN & LOCK SCREEN
This is where Smart TV Remote Universal goes beyond any ordinary remote app:
- Home Screen widgets: a quick D-pad + volume widget and an app-launcher grid, one tap from anywhere
- Live Activity with Dynamic Island support — compact controls while you do other things
- Siri & Shortcuts support through App Intents: automate your TV or ask Siri
WORKS WITH YOUR TV
Compatible with Samsung, LG, Sony, Vizio, Hisense, Philips, Roku and Roku devices, Fire TV and Fire TV Stick, Google TV, Android TV and many more. If your smart TV is on your Wi-Fi, chances are we support it.
MAKE IT YOURS
Per-brand accent colors (Roku purple, Samsung blue, LG red and more), plus light, dark and system appearance.
READY IN UNDER A MINUTE
Connect your iPhone or iPad to the same Wi-Fi network as your TV and follow the on-screen steps. That's it — no pairing codes, no cables.
GO PRO
Upgrade to Pro for the complete, ad-free experience with unlimited paired devices and all widgets unlocked. Choose a yearly plan with a 3-day free trial, a monthly plan, or a one-time lifetime purchase.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase, after any free trial period. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://tvremoteapp.art.blog/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Samsung, LG, Sony, Vizio, Hisense, Philips, Roku, Amazon, Google or any other TV brand mentioned. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

bluejetty:00183420:ios.description:
Welcome to CSE+, your all-in-one companion for maintaining a healthy lifestyle and achieving your fitness goals. Whether you're a fitness enthusiast, a health-conscious individual, or someone looking to make positive changes in your life, this app is designed to simplify your journey to a healthier, happier you.
Key Features:
- Meal Planning: Browse our large recipe index and create your own custom menu plan and we’ll create an automated grocery list from your custom plan. Short on time? Use the built-in meal plans and grocery lists we already created in our Seasonal 7-Week Meal Plans. Get in on this goodness!

- Guided Workouts: Workout with us anytime you want! We have Guided Workout Videos, Strength Training & HIIT, and Written Workouts with Demo Videos available, so gear up and let's gooooo! 
- Progress Tracking: Stay motivated by tracking your progress in one place. Record your meals, workouts, and see how far you've come on your fitness journey.
Clean Simple Eats is more than just a meal planning app; it's your ultimate wellness companion. Whether you want to lose weight, build muscle, or simply lead a healthier life, this app empowers you to take control of your nutrition, fitness, and overall well-being.
Download Clean Simple Eats now and embark on a journey towards a cleaner, simpler, and healthier you. Let's build the best version of yourself together!

bluejetty:00144395:ios.description:
TCDD Taşımacılık AŞ artık cebinizde. 
TCDD Taşımacılık AŞ, iletişim ve bilişim teknolojisinin sunduğu fırsatlarla daha hızlı ve daha rahat yolculuk imkanı sunuyor. 
Gişeye Gelmeden Online Bilet Alabilirsiniz
Elektronik Yolcu Bilet İşlemleri Sistemi (EYBİS) ile gişelere gelmeden mobil uygulamadan, internetten, çağrı merkezinden biletinizi alabilirsiniz. 
Satış işleminin tamamlanmasının ardından biletiniz SMS ve e-posta ile tarafınıza gönderilir.
Trene binerken resimli bir kimlik belgesi ibraz etmek zorunludur.
Çağrı Merkezi
Çağrı Merkezi, 444 82 33 no.lu özel servis numarası ile 7 gün 24 saat size hizmet veriyor.
Çağrı Merkezimizden; yolcu, yük ve liman hizmetleri konusunda her türlü bilgi verilirken, biletle ilgili işlemlerle öneri ve şikâyetlere ilişkin hizmetler yapılıyor. 
Whatsapp üzerinden Anlık Şikâyet, Anlık Çözüm Uygulaması
0507 321 82 33 numaralı Whatsapp hattına 7/24 ulaştırılan mesajlarınıza 5-15 dakika içerisinde dönüş yapıyoruz. 
YHT Eğlence Sistemi ile Canınız Hiç Sıkılmaz 
YHT Eğlence Sistemi ile koltuklarda yer alan ekranlardan veya kendi dizüstü bilgisayar, tablet, cep telefonlarından bağlanarak film, müzik, e-kitap, oyun gibi içeriklere ulaşabilirsiniz. 
Yolcu Haklarınızı Öğrenin 
TCDD Taşımacılık trenlerinde seyahat eden yolcularımızın hakları vardır. 
Bu hakların bazıları şunlardır: 
Danışma hakkı
Kolay Bilet Satın Alma Hakkı
Güvenli Yolculuk ve Konfor Hakkı
Engelli ve Hareket Kabiliyeti Kısıtlı Yolcuların Yardım Talep Hakkı
Sefer İptalleri ve Tehirlerde Yolcu Hakları
Talep Öneri ve Şikâyet Hakkı 
Seyahati Gözünüzde Büyütmeyin, Yüksek Hızlı Trenle Çok Yakın
Yüksek hızlı trenle, Ankara-Konya, Ankara-Eskişehir, Ankara-İstanbul, Konya-İstanbul hatlarında hızlı konforlu seyahat keyfe dönüşür. 
YHT Bağlantılı Kombine Taşımacılıkla Yolları Kısaltın 
YHT bağlantılı otobüs, Dizel Tren Setleri ile Bursa, Kütahya, Afyonkarahisar, Karaman, Denizli, Antalya’ya YHT konforundan ve hızından faydalanarak kısa sürede gidebilirsiniz.
Trende seyahat konforunuza harika bir lokanta da eşlik ediyor
Yüksek hızlı trenler ile Doğu Ekspresi, Güney-Vangölü, İzmir Mavi, Konya Mavi Trenlerinde bulunan yemekli vagonlarda yiyecek ve içecek ihtiyacınızı karşılamanız mümkündür.
Trenlerde Seyahat Güvence Altında 
Meydana gelen tren kazalarında;
Yolcuların can kaybı ve yaralanmalarında,
Eşyalarının zarar görmesi durumunda,
mevzuat çerçevesinde tazmin edilir. 
YHT’lerde Bilet Tipleri
Değişiklik ve iade hakkına göre ücretlendirilen üç tür bilet bulunur.
“Hesaplı Bilet”, “Standart Bilet” ve “Esnek Bilet” 
Son Dakika Bileti Nasıl Alınır? 
Yolcular, biletlerini trenin çıkış istasyonundaki gişelerden 5 dakika öncesine kadar, 
Diğer satış kanallarından (internet, mobil, çağrı merkezi vb) ise trenin çıkış istasyonundan kalkışına 15 dakika öncesine kadar alabilir.
YHT, Anahat Trenlerinde Biletlerin Geçerliği
YHT ve anahat trenlerinde, biletler satıldığı tarih, sefer, vagon ve yer numarasında geçerlidir. Başka bir tarih ve seferde kullanılamaz. 
Anahat trenlerinde numarasız vagonlara yapılan satışlara ait biletler, biletin üzerinde belirtilen tarih ve seferde geçerlidir. Yolcunun kontrollerde biletini ispat etmesi yeterlidir.
Bölgesel Tren Biletlerinin Geçerliği
Bölgesel tren biletleri, yolculuk mesafesine bağlı olarak bölge, saat, gün ve sefer/ seferler bazında geçerlidir. 
Bölgesel tren seyahatlerinde fiziki bilet ibrazı zorunludur. 
Yolcular, geçerlik süresi içinde kullanılmayan bölgesel tren biletleri için herhangi bir hak talebinde bulunamaz.
Bölgesel tren biletleri tek yön bileti ise satıldığı gün, gidiş-dönüş bileti ise gidiş bileti satıldığı gün, dönüşü ertesi gün dâhil geçerlidir.

• block your card instantly if you lose it and unblock easily when recovered

bluejetty:00120300:ios.name: LilTriangle
bluejetty:00120300:ios.summary: Parenting is Hard Work, but our children are the most important people in our life. They make us laugh, smile and keep us going with whatever we do to make a living. For a parent, there is nothing more fulfilling than to see a child grow an
bluejetty:00120300:ios.description:
Parenting is Hard Work, but our children are the most important people in our life. They make us laugh, smile and keep us going with whatever we do to make a living. For a parent, there is nothing more fulfilling than to see a child grow and you all agree, it happens very fast. In our busy day-to-day lives, we all wish we had more time to spend with our children.
Teaching preschoolers is a lot of work but they leave a lasting impression on a child’s life. We remember the rhymes we learnt in kindergarten. We may forget all math but we never stop using fingers to count. Teachers shouldn’t be spending half their time filling out a tonne of paperwork. They have lessons to teach, brains to mould and a future to build.
We at lilTriangle, transform the hard work from parents and a lot of work from teachers into Smart Work with our Parent-Teacher collaboration app, which is all about our children. We passionately built it with an unwavering focus on children’s safety and development.
In the era of smartphones, tablets and watches, it is no longer rude to check your phone or smartwatch in a packed meeting at work. It is absolutely OK to get updates about our children!
- Why not receive a notification on your smartwatch that your child is in the class? We make that happen with our ATTENDANCE feature.
- Worried about how your kid is coping up with the temperature he had last night? Check with the teacher, using our in-app MESSAGE feature.
- Have time to kill on your long-ride home? Check your kid’s daily activities and upcoming events with a tap on our DAYCARE DIARY and CALENDAR features.
- Running late from work? Let a friend pick-up your kid from school with our PICK AND DROP feature.
- Want to know what your prodigy is up to lately? Find out in our CHILD DEVELOPMENT feature.
- Take a couple more minutes to finish breakfast before rushing to the bus stop. Know the exact location of the bus with our TRANSPORT-TRACKING add-on.
- You just joined your baby at preschool and worried about him? try our Watch Your Baby Feature and see your child live on your mobile screen..!
Teachers, Be productive at work let the app do all your paperwork while you engage with students.
We will never be able to replace your hugs & kisses or your lessons & teachings but we promise to save time for the most important things in your life.
There are more than 1000 preschools across India who is using lilTriangle every day..! what's stopping you?
To learn more, call us @ 7676-LITTLE
or write to hello@liltriangle.com
Saving time for more smiles

bluejetty:00116312:ios.summary:
Avalar: Raid of Shadow
A Dark Fantasy Role-Playing Adventure Where Shadows Reign and Legends Rise
Step into Avalar: Raid of Shadow, one of the best action RPG games on mobile. This dark fantasy game blends thrilling combat, immersive story
bluejetty:00116312:ios.description:
Avalar: Raid of Shadow
A Dark Fantasy Role-Playing Adventure Where Shadows Reign and Legends Rise
Step into Avalar: Raid of Shadow, one of the best action RPG games on mobile. This dark fantasy game blends thrilling combat, immersive storytelling, and community-driven adventures. Wield elemental power, assemble your ultimate squad, and fight to reclaim Avalar from the creeping corruption of shadows.
MASTER THE ELEMENTS, UNLOCK THE LEGENDS
Summon mighty heroes from sly rogue assassins to blazing fire warriors and unlock their true potential. Each Avalar character carries unique roles, elements, and stories, ready to clash in tactical, real-time combat worthy of the finest action RPG games.
RAID THE KINGDOM, FIGHT THE SHADOW
Enter cursed lands, forgotten ruins, and nightbound arenas in this dark fantasy idle RPG. Every raid reveals secrets behind Avalar’s fall as you battle colossal PvE bosses, rival champions in PvP arenas, and wage war against creeping shadows in epic shadow fights and shadow wars.
BUILD YOUR FIGHT SQUAD
From shadow demon slayers to armored titans, form your dream roster through fate-bound summons. With tactical depth rivalling the best ARPG games, every hero you summon strengthens your role-playing journey and prepares you for endless raids of shadow.
FANTASY. STRATEGY. SHOWCASE YOUR POWER.
Rise through evolving RPG systems, guild-based warzones, and dramatic showcase events. Join the Avalar community, claim exclusive rewards through Avalar giftcodes, and unlock Avalar premium benefits to power up faster than ever.
JOIN THE AVALAR COMMUNITY
Heroes don’t fight alone—connect with thousands of players on Discord and Facebook! Share strategies, form alliances, and climb the ranks as you compete in global events to prove who rules Avalar.
YOUR SWORD. YOUR STORY. YOUR LEGENDS.
In Avalar, nothing is random. Every battle is earned, every choice shapes your fate. Conquer darkness, rise as a legend, and leave your mark in the world of shadows.
The shadow rises.
Will you?

bluejetty:00139714:ios.name: Spin The Wheel - Number Picker
bluejetty:00139714:ios.summary: Spin The Wheel – Number Picker is a simple and fun app that helps you make quick decisions in everyday situations. Whether you’re playing games with friends, organizing group activities, or choosing between options, the app provides easy to
bluejetty:00139714:ios.description:
Spin The Wheel – Number Picker is a simple and fun app that helps you make quick decisions in everyday situations. Whether you’re playing games with friends, organizing group activities, or choosing between options, the app provides easy tools to pick randomly and keep things enjoyable.
- Spin the Wheel: Create your own customizable wheel with names, numbers, or options. Spin the wheel to get a fair and unbiased result. This is ideal for classroom activities, and casual decision-making.
- Finger Picker: Place multiple fingers on the screen and let the app randomly select one. A playful way to decide who goes first or who takes the next turn.
- Coin Flip: Make fast yes-or-no decisions with a simple virtual coin flip.

bluejetty:00021789:ios.description:
Securely bank and manage business anytime, anywhere, across any device!
The Synovus Gateway Mobile Banking app provides Synovus commercial customers secure and easy-to-use cash management tools with the ability to bank and manage business anytime, anywhere, across any device. With the Synovus Gateway Mobile Banking app, businesses can monitor accounts, transfer funds, pay vendors and employees, manage deposits and much more.
Synovus Gateway Mobile Banking app offers a single point of control to service modules, such as:
• Accounts and Transactions
• Information Reporting and Intraday Reporting¹
• Mobile Deposit
• User and Policy Management
• Statements
• Robust Alerts
• Business Bill Pay²
• Zelle® for your business²
• External Account Aggregation²
• Financial Management Tools²
• Stop Payments
• Automated Clearing House (ACH)¹
• Domestic and International Wire Transfer¹
• Positive Pay¹
Permissions:
• Location permissions are necessary to determine your current location to display nearby Synovus locations/ATMs and provide mapping directions.
• Camera permissions are necessary for you to use the Mobile Deposit feature or to scan a Zelle® QR Code.
• Internet access permissions are necessary for the app to connect with Synovus Gateway Mobile Banking app.
• Minimum system requirement: iOS 16 or higher.
• Access to your device’s contacts is required for Zelle®.
• Access to your device’s photos is required for Zelle® when selecting a QR code from your saved images.
Our Digital Privacy Statement explains how we collect, share, and use your information. For complete details, please refer to our Digital Privacy Statement at https://www.synovus.com/internet-privacy-statement/.
About Synovus Gateway:
• The Synovus Gateway Mobile Banking App is free to download. Use of the Synovus Gateway Mobile Banking app requires your mobile service provider’s data and/or text plan for which charges may apply.
• You must be enrolled in Synovus Gateway with established Synovus Gateway login credentials and have a compatible device. Registration is required to use the Synovus Gateway mobile app. Your company administrator will enable access for use.
Disclaimers:
1. Separate approval, agreement, fees and/or additional balances may apply.
2. Enrollment required. Separate approval and/or agreement may apply.
The service marks and trademarks used herein belong to their respective owners.

bluejetty:00043408:ios.summary:
LEARN, UNDERSTAND & MEMORIZE THE QURAN. WITH FLASHCARDS & QUIZZES TO RETAIN WHAT YOU MEMORIZED.
Reconnect with the Quran in a deeper, more meaningful way. Whether you’re just beginning your journey or looking to strengthen your memorizatio
bluejetty:00043408:ios.description:
LEARN, UNDERSTAND & MEMORIZE THE QURAN. WITH FLASHCARDS & QUIZZES TO RETAIN WHAT YOU MEMORIZED.
Reconnect with the Quran in a deeper, more meaningful way. Whether you’re just beginning your journey or looking to strengthen your memorization, Quran Buddy is designed to help you engage with the Quran in a meaningful and consistent way. 
It combines simple learning tools with thoughtful structure, making it easier to understand, memorize, and reflect on the words of Allah.
From daily recitation to long-term memorization, the app supports learners of all levels—helping you move forward with clarity, confidence, and purpose.
---- KEY FEATURES ---- 
■ Quran-Based Flashcards
Learn essential Quranic vocabulary through carefully designed flashcards. Each word is selected to help you better understand what you recite, making your reading more thoughtful and connected.
■ Structured Memorization Support
Stay consistent with your memorization through a system built to help you review, retain, and progress at your own pace. Whether you're memorizing short surahs or longer passages, the app keeps you on track.
■ Interactive Quizzes & Review Tools
Reinforce what you’ve learned with simple quizzes that test your memory and understanding. A great way to stay motivated and measure your progress over time.
■ Learn Quranic Arabic
Start recognizing common words and patterns in the Quran, helping you understand meanings without relying entirely on translation.
■ Improve Your Recitation
Strengthen your recitation through regular practice and repetition. Build confidence as you become more familiar with verses and their flow.
■ Designed for All Ages
Simple enough for beginners and engaging enough for children, while still valuable for adults looking to deepen their relationship with the Quran.
■ Offline Access
Continue learning and memorizing wherever you are—no internet connection needed.
■ Support Your Daily Worship
Use what you learn to improve your prayer and bring more focus and understanding into your salah.
Consistency is the key to building a strong relationship with the Quran. With the right tools and a steady routine, even small daily efforts can lead to meaningful progress.
► Download the app today and take a step closer to understanding, memorizing, and living the Quran.

bluejetty:00137828:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00137828:ios.description:
◆ Feels like an adventure. Works like therapy.
Meet Betwixt, the immersive text-based adventure that helps you master your thoughts and feelings.
Written by actual therapists and writers (not an AI), the app takes you on an epic guided journey deep into the mysteries of your own mind.
You’ll travel through a strange, dreamlike world to awaken your imagination, uncover new paths to change, and connect deeply with yourself. 
Betwixt has been designed as an interactive story with enchanting soundscapes to offer an alternative for people who find a CBT diary too dry, and struggle to engage with mindfulness, emotion trackers and journaling. 
◆ Backed by science
Betwixt has been evaluated by two different psychology labs. In just two to three weeks, users report significantly less anxiety, stress and depression, as well as increased self-compassion and a sense of wellbeing.
◆ Benefits
Unlock a whole range of self-awareness powers:
• Ease anxiety, stress and depression
• Improve your self-awareness and self-reflection skills
• Tap into your subconscious through the power of story
• Identify your values to increase your motivation, sense of gratitude and life purpose 
• Overcome sadness, resentment, low self-esteem, negative perception, and insecurities.
◆ Features
• a cozy, choose-your-own-path fantasy story 
• unique immersive experience with soothing soundscapes
• 11 chapter (aka “dreams”) that unlock different self-awareness powers 
• tools for deeper daily practice
• a private online community.
◆ Everyone deserves to live an epic story
We believe that emotion regulation resources should be available to all. 
• If you cannot afford to pay, you can request free access through our scholarship program
If you have any queries, you can reach out to us at hello@betwixt.life

bluejetty:00129063:ios.name: Wildshade Fantasy Horse Races
bluejetty:00129063:ios.summary: Have you heard of the Wildshade horses? Breed your dream horse with over 40 million options, equip each horse with matching tack, and prove that you are worthy of the legendary Wildshade herd. Win magical horse races in a fantastical, adven
bluejetty:00129063:ios.description:
Have you heard of the Wildshade horses? Breed your dream horse with over 40 million options, equip each horse with matching tack, and prove that you are worthy of the legendary Wildshade herd. Win magical horse races in a fantastical, adventure-filled world!
Long ago, once a year near the village of Wildshade, something magical took place. A rainbow glow filled the sky, a sign that the wild horses of Wildshade had returned! Nobody knew where they came from or where they would return to. But one thing they did know for sure was that the horses were proud, brave, and worthy of respect. The villagers gathered for a race, each horse choosing their own rider. No sooner were they on the horse than each rider felt free, unbeatable.
And then, tragedy struck: the village and the surrounding area caught fire, the flames were unstoppable. The Wildshade horses never returned. The village was rebuilt and the people returned, the landscape recovered, but there was no sign of the horses.
The people in the village held horse races in memory of those beautiful wild beasts, trying to recapture those magical moments of the past when the horses would appear and the wild race began.
And now you, too can experience the magic of the Wildshade horses, thanks to Wildshade the game. There are plenty of wild horse races and beautiful, fantastic horses just waiting to meet you!
Features:
Racing
- There are so many new worlds to discover
- Learn new skills as you explore thrilling race tracks
- Increase your abilities with each race as you discover new options
Breeding
- Breed the perfect horse from millions of options
- Each horse has its own set of characteristics
- Each horse is unique
Horses
- Try out tack for your horse
- Select their saddle, bridle, blanket, hairstyle, hair color
- Decide what equipment you need to race
Rider
- Choose your character’s appearance
- Give your character a name
- Pick from one of eight different riders

Safari – limitless safari simulation

Winter - for driving simulation on the snow

There are contract positions where you can enter buy goods and transport them to earn money. You can transport different good also using car trailer. Driving car with trailer is harder but brings more money!
Go ahead! Check your driving skills and enjoy offroad car simulation!

• Note taking

• Neumorphism user interface.
• Optimized for iPad Pro.
