bluejetty:00072904:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Draw Happy Police!
It is a game that draws various things and makes people smile.
How much can you help someone in need?
To clear this game, you have to discover why they are in trouble or in a bad mood. Think of something they will be happy with and write it in your own hands.
If your expectations are correct, their dissatisfaction will be resolved and you will smile!
Can you make the police officers happy or struggle? Do you need a clue or a hint?
Are you looking for intuitive easy puzzle games? Save these officers!
They want to live a happy life, so they need your brain! Help them out!
Let’s test your brain! Start drawing now! Save them all!
How to be a Draw Master
1.Relax and solve puzzles
Calm down and find missing issues
Please don't erase anything, but just scribble on the screen
2. Spend long days in the lives of police officers
Over 200 puzzles and so many episodes of missing parts are packed with fun!
Don’t be braindead! Look for clues and hints.
3. You don't have to draw perfectly—no need to be perfect
Enjoy just like you would on a chalkboard.
You need not feel guilty. You will likely have fun when you find the story behind the scenes!
If you like ibis paint, sketchpad, brainpop and happy glass, Draw Happy Police will also be one of your favorite choices. Let's download Draw Happy Police now, and draw something to solve puzzles! Drawing will put a smile to your face and your family!
This game is so easy that it's perfect for your kids to play! People of all ages can play, so let's play with your family and friends and get excited!
Various series of Draw Happy have been released!
There are many other themes such as dentists, Instagrammers, students and criminals. When you finish playing this game, please try other series! If you play, new discoveries and fun will be waiting for you!
Feature functions:
- Draw by touching directly on the screen (tap and scribble)
- Intuitive UI and UX
- Colorful drawing will entertain your whole family
- Hint and clue are always available for each stage (hint is hidden at the bottom of the screen when you reach a certain stage)
- Short and simple game design to suit any age group
- No need to rush - there is no time limit
- Take your time and relax
- Easy to figure out puzzle
- Judgement is made user friendly
- Friendly tips, all for free!
What are you waiting for? Start drawing now, and save them police officers!
Let's play Draw Happy Police right away!

bluejetty:00069354:ios.description:
There's no need to use tiny screens, annoying HDMI cables or expensive hardware. Prevent eyestrain, save money and get rid of those unsightly & unsafe cables. Discover MirrorMeister today!
Easily connect your TV to your iOS devices with MirrorMeister's revolutionary app. Totally wireless smartcast of course! Enjoy movies, sport, photos, news and all apps on the big screen and make your life more comfortable.
MirrorMeister is a screen mirroring app that allows you to play the media that’s playing on your phone/ tablet to your smart tv.
- Mirror your phone/ tablet to your smart TV.
- No ugly, clumsy & unsafe cables!
- One app for popular TV brands (Samsung, Sony, LG, Panasonic, Hisense, etc.)
- Watch movies.
- Stream sports.
- Screen mirroring cast to tv.
- Binge-watch series.
- Watch breaking news.
- Show photos to loved-ones and impress friends & family.

bluejetty:00023774:ios.description:
Rock your Photo with Unwell Textures and Tones
Grungetastic cranks your photos to 11 with seven hot and heavy looks: Classic Grunge, Bleached Grunge, Worn Pop, Worn Grunge, Gritty Grunge, Distressed and Pop Grunge. These seven fun and aggressive styles let you get down and dirty with your photos. Faster than you can say "filthy," these styles and Grungetastic's easy, hands-on interface will have you smushing delightfully unwell textures and tones with deeply satisfying contrasts, and explosively pleasurable pops for dangerously-addictive ultra-Grungy art. 
Grungetastic is for the Photographer that loves everything grungy! Shadows, Rubbing, Scratching, Ripping, Shredding, Stressing, Distressing, Popping, Exploding, Splatters, Smudging, Glowing, Glaring, Smoking – just some of the wildness that Grungetastic hooks you up with.

Classic Grunge, Bleached, Pop Grunge, Pop Worn, Worn, Gritty and Distressed Grunge

"Randomize" button to quickly show off the power of the app
A full library of textures and borders
Quick, efficient, and very user-friendly interface
Support for full-size images
Presets with the ability to create custom presets
Preview mode for quick workflow (Larger image rendered on save or when emailed)

bluejetty:00122295:ios.description:
VTVgo The Next - một thế hệ trải nghiệm tiếp theo
Tốc độ mượt mà không điểm chờ, trọn vẹn hệ sinh thái nội dung và dịch vụ số.
Một điểm chạm số mới cho khán giả Việt.
VTVgo đang bước sang một thế hệ phát triển mới. Từ Nền tảng truyền hình số trực tuyến quốc gia, VTVgo The Next mở rộng thành một điểm chạm số gần gũi với mỗi người Việt - nơi nội dung chính thống, giải trí chất lượng và những dịch vụ thiết yếu được kết nối trong một hành trình liền mạch.
Không chỉ xem, người dùng có thể khám phá, mua sắm, kết nối, sử dụng dịch vụ và nhận quyền lợi trên cùng một nền tảng. Mọi trải nghiệm được thiết kế để nhanh hơn, thuận tiện hơn và tạo thêm giá trị từ mỗi lần chạm.
MỘT NỀN TẢNG - TRỌN VẸN HỆ SINH THÁI SỐ
Hệ sinh thái nội dung: Truyền hình, tin tức, phim, thể thao, giải trí và nội dung số đặc sắc của VTV.
Ngân hàng - tài chính: Kết nối các sản phẩm và tiện ích tài chính số an toàn, thuận tiện.
VTVshop: Biến cảm hứng từ nội dung thành trải nghiệm khám phá và mua sắm liền mạch.
Dịch vụ công trực tuyến: Mở rộng khả năng tiếp cận các tiện ích thiết yếu ngay trong hành trình số.
Kết nối VNeID: Hướng tới trải nghiệm định danh thuận tiện, an toàn và đồng bộ hơn cho người dùng.
VTVgo Loyalty: Tích lũy điểm, đổi điểm và mở khóa những quyền lợi dành riêng cho khách hàng.
Mỗi nội dung mở ra một trải nghiệm. Mỗi tương tác tạo thêm một giá trị. VTVgo The Next hướng tới trở thành người bạn số đồng hành cùng khán giả Việt - để xem điều mình yêu thích, tiếp cận điều mình cần và tận hưởng nhiều quyền lợi hơn mỗi ngày.
Cập nhật VTVgo và bước vào một thế hệ trải nghiệm tiếp theo.
VTVgo The Next - Trọn vẹn nội dung. Kết nối dịch vụ. Mở rộng giá trị.
THÔNG TIN LIÊN HỆ
Đơn vị phát triển: Trung tâm Nền tảng và Dịch vụ số (VTV Digital), Đài Truyền hình Việt Nam
Địa chỉ: 43 Nguyễn Chí Thanh, Giảng Võ, Hà Nội, Việt Nam
Email: vtvdigital@vtv.vn
Website: https://vtvgo.vn

bluejetty:00139796:ios.description:
# PRIVATE, PROTECTED BROWSING IN ONE TAP
Shelter VPN encrypts your connection and hides your IP address from the sites and networks you use. Connect from the home screen in a single tap and browse, stream, and play as usual.
# ONE TAP TO CONNECT
Open the app and connect. There is no configuration to work through and no profile to build by hand.
# SERVERS AROUND THE WORLD
Choose from servers in the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, India, the Netherlands, and Australia. Pick one, or let the app keep the last one you used.
# STAY PRIVATE ON PUBLIC WI-FI
Hotel, airport, office, and café networks are shared with everyone else on them. An encrypted connection keeps what you send on it to yourself.
# BLOCK ADS IN SAFARI
Turn on the Safari content blocker and pages load without their advertising. Fewer things to download means pages that finish sooner.
# CHECK YOUR SPEED
Measure your connection before and after connecting, so the cost of the tunnel is a number you can see rather than something you have to take on trust.
# UNLIMITED DATA
No usage caps and no throttling. Stream and browse for as long as you like.
# SUBSCRIPTIONS AND AUTOMATIC RENEWAL
- Your subscription includes access to the features listed above.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of your selected subscription period.
- Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in your App Store Account Settings.
# INTENDED USE
Shelter VPN is built for privacy and for security on untrusted networks. It is not intended to deceive anyone or to support fraudulent activity, and users are expected to follow the laws that apply to them.
# LEGAL
Terms of Service: https://cooptimizeit.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://cooptimizeit.com/privacy-policy
# SUPPORT
Contact us at info@cooptimizeit.com. We reply within 48 hours.

bluejetty:00120386:ios.name: My Town : Fire station Rescue
bluejetty:00120386:ios.summary: Become the hero of My town by playing as a fireman or paramedic. Start by dressing your characters in their protective gear, then head into the control room, where you’ll receive emergency calls, then drive the firetruck, helicopter or ambu
bluejetty:00120386:ios.description:
Become the hero of My town by playing as a fireman or paramedic. Start by dressing your characters in their protective gear, then head into the control room, where you’ll receive emergency calls, then drive the firetruck, helicopter or ambulance to reach your missions! and spray the fire, extinguish the burning flames and save lives!
But! There’s more to My Town : Fire Station Rescue than heading out for your missions. Children can learn about the daily lives of emergency workers by exploring what they do while waiting for the next call. Your family can visit you at the fire station and you can challenge them to a ping-pong game. Perhaps they’ve always wanted to see My Town from the sky? You can take them out on a helicopter flight! Just don’t forget to leave time for the gym, so you ensure you are fit and ready for any mission that might come your way. 
FEATURES
*Save game mode: You can exit or log out of the game, and when you pick it back up none of your progress is lost- you can continue on your adventure. 
*Multi Touch function: children can play alone, or with parents and friends on single device. 
*Nine locations in the fire station to explore including the mission control room, rest area, kitchen, ambulance, gym, firetruck garage and more!
If you can imagine it, you can make it. Everything is possible in My Town : Museum!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
TELL US WHAT YOU THINK!
 You can easily contact with us on Facebook or Twitter at any time to let us know what you would like changed or added. Maybe you’ve come up with a new My Town game all on your own – let us know! We promise to read all messages and reply. We love to hear YOUR ideas, so please connect with us! 
Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
 Twitter – https://twitter.com/mytowngames
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

bluejetty:00163777:ios.description:
Rogers Xfinity is here. Connecting you to more of what you love. The Ignite HomeConnect (Shaw) app has been updated to the Rogers Xfinity (Shaw) app.
Included exclusively with Rogers Xfinity plans and TV bundles featuring the Rogers Xfinity Gateway in British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba and parts of Northern Ontario.
You’re in control with Rogers Xfinity. Easily manage and protect your home WiFi and connected devices from anywhere, at any time. 
• Stay in the know – see who’s online at home from anywhere, at anytime
• Pause or schedule WiFi whenever you choose – create Downtime Schedules or set Active Time Limits
• Protect your loved ones – activate easy Parental Controls and Active Time Details for added peace of mind
• Get our most secure WiFi – turn on Advanced Security for worry-free protection of all connected devices; automatically block online threats 24/7 and get alerts about suspicious activity 
• Test your WiFi connections – ensure you’re getting the best WiFi for all your connected devices without having to call tech support
• Never forget your WiFi password again – quickly check, update or share your WiFi passport
• One app that does it all – link and control smart lighting, thermostats and doorlocks from popular brands
• Add Rogers Xfinity Self Protection to any Rogers Xfinity Internet plan and keep an eye on your home with 24/7 home monitoring right at your fingertips. 
Getting Started
• Download and install the Rogers Xfinity (Shaw) app on your smartphone
• Launch the app and sign in using your MyShaw ID 
Requirements
• Rogers Xfinity Gateway, included exclusively with Rogers Xfinity Bundles and Internet packages from Rogers in British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan and Manitoba. (For Ontario, New Brunswick and Newfoundland, please download “Rogers Xfinity (Shaw)”
• App designed for smartphone use only 
For more information see:
shaw.ca/internet/app

bluejetty:00128212:ios.description:
USB Disk lets you store, view and manage documents on your iPhone or iPad. It has an amazing built in document viewer and is very easy to use, with a simple and intuitive interface, yet it contains many powerful features. Drag and drop files in iTunes to transfer them to your iPhone or iPad, then view them anywhere! 
TUAW - "USB Disk is [...] a nicely designed one."
Lifehacker - "The Best. USB Disk for iOS gives you a fast and easy way to transfer documents and images to your device."
Apple - "New and Noteworthy"
TOP REASONS TO BUY
• Access Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive and Box.
• Open and create zip files.
• Store and view files.
• Navigate using swipes (like Photos / iBooks app).
• Thumbnails let you preview your files.
• Copy, paste, cut, delete and create files.
MORE FEATURES
• View and download email attachments.
• Restores last viewing position.
• Full screen file viewer.
• CBR and CBZ file viewer.
• USB file transfers.
• Background audio.
• Slideshow with adjustable delay.
• Fast scrolling, page up/down functionalities.
• Email your documents.
• Lock code.
SUPPORTED FILE TYPES
• PDF files.
• Compressed files (zip, rar).
• MS Office documents.
• iWork documents.
• Pictures (jpg, png, gif, ...).
• eBooks (pdf, ePub, html, txt, ...).
• Comics (cbr, cbz, pdf, ...).
• Audio files (mp3, m4a, wav, ...).
• Video files (m4v, mov, avi, mkv, ...).
UPDATES
Buy now and get free updates.
SUBSCRIPTION
All features listed above can be used without an in app purchase. Some advanced features require an active subscription. These include:
• Access the device's photos library.
• Protect the access to the app or specific files and folders with lock codes.
• Access WebDAV and FTP servers. You can also configure SharePoint connections.
• Edit simple text files. Also annotate PDF files.
• Present files on external screens.

bluejetty:00073784:ios.summary: TroutRoutes by onX is the leading GPS mapping tool for trout streams and fly fishing. As the first mapping tool to offer interactive GPS fishing maps for every trout stream in the continental United States, TroutRoutes provides comprehensiv
bluejetty:00073784:ios.description:
TroutRoutes by onX is the leading GPS mapping tool for trout streams and fly fishing. As the first mapping tool to offer interactive GPS fishing maps for every trout stream in the continental United States, TroutRoutes provides comprehensive information for each stream and river.
Find local fishing spots, explore new waters, and navigate public access like a pro. View maps of over 50,000 trout streams across 48 states, access 280,000+ hand-curated access points, and view 360 million acres of public land. Forecast with real-time stream conditions, view local regulations, and save detailed maps with your own markups for offline use.
Plan your fly fishing trip with advanced filters and decide what you want to see on the map. View trail access, public or private bridges, parking spots, camping opportunities, boat ramps, and more. Filter rivers by fish species, now available in nine western states.
TroutRoutes is the only App that combines classified trout streams, hand-curated access points, and live USGS stream gauge data in one place. Endorsed by fly fishing professionals and industry partners, find more information in local fly shops such as Orvis.
Access a complete trout fishing tool and start exploring new streams with TroutRoutes.
TroutRoutes by onX Features:
▶ How can I use TroutRoutes to find new streams?
Navigate the map or search bar to find color-coded streams, organized by stream class. With over 50,000 trout streams mapped out across 48 states, TroutRoutes delivers an industry-first national trout quality classification system. Plan your trip based on habitat quality, public access opportunities, and more.
▶ How can I navigate public land and water access?
View information on public and private land and download detailed offline maps. Fish confidently with land boundary data that lets you see exactly where you are as you move upstream, even without cell service. Download maps by river or region, and navigate through fishing easements, national forests, or local parks with GPS mapping.
▶ How can TroutRoutes help me plan my next fly fishing trip?
Set custom markups, filter rivers by species, and navigate new waters with 280,000+ unique and hand-curated public access points. Create personalized maps by adding your points of interest. Filter your map by fish species in CA, WA, OR, MT, WY, CO, UT, ID, and NV.
▶ How can I find the right time and stream to fish?
Access real-time stream conditions and compare historical data to forecast the best times to fish. Get live river flow and chart readings with our USGS gauge layer. See slope and contour details for every stream with interactive elevation charts. Identify tailwater, reservoirs, headwaters, and meadows.
▶ Does TroutRoutes give me access to local regulations and fly fishing shops?
View fly fishing regulations and information on fly shops directly in the App. See color-coded fishing regulations and local stream classes. Locate nearby fly shops and view their website and contact info. Plan ahead with parking locations, bridge access, trailheads, put-ins, and more.
Easy to use for beginners and seasoned pros alike, TroutRoutes takes the guesswork out of fly fishing. Plan your next trout fishing adventure today.
▶ Free Trial: Start a 7-day PRO trial for free when you install the App.
▶ Basic Plan (Free): Multi-platform access across desktop and mobile, a basic view of trout streams, and other limited features.
▶ Single-State ($19.99/year): Full PRO features for one state: classified streams, access points, custom markups, offline maps, and more.
▶ PRO ($39.99/year or $9.99/month): Complete access across 48 states, including:
• 50,000+ classified trout streams
• 280,000+ custom access points
• 360 million acres of public land
• Real-time data, offline maps, fishing regulations
▶ Terms of Use: https://www.onxmaps.com/tou
▶ Privacy Policy: https://www.onxmaps.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00119769:ios.name: XING – the right job for you
bluejetty:00119769:ios.summary: On XING, professionals from every industry and career level can browse over 1 million jobs and get found by popular employers and more than 20,000 recruiters. XING’s goal is to match 22 million members with the right job and employer for th
bluejetty:00119769:ios.description:
On XING, professionals from every industry and career level can browse over 1 million jobs and get found by popular employers and more than 20,000 recruiters. XING’s goal is to match 22 million members with the right job and employer for them because people are more than just their CV. This is what XING is all about:
Find just the right job for you:
Whoever you are, whatever your background and aspirations – you’ll find jobs spanning every industry, discipline and career level. Never miss out on another job opportunity again.
Get found by top recruiters:
Looking for a job can be very time-consuming. So why not let the jobs come to you? Employers hiring in Germany, Austria and Switzerland use XING to find and engage with prospective employees.
Receive job recommendations:
Want to work from home? Looking for a part-time position? Need to take your dog to work with you? Interested in relocating? After registering you can set your job preferences and create a search alert so the jobs come to you.
Discover your next step:
The many search options, salary ranges and kununu employer reviews help you determine what you’re looking for in your next position and employer.
Gather unique insights:
Find out what you can earn in advertised jobs along with information about the workplace culture. kununu reviews from hundreds of thousands of employees deliver unique insights into what it’s like to work at a company, while employer profiles let you see what the business is all about and who’ll be reviewing your application.
Foster your network:
Many of the job ads on XING show you who works there so you can get in touch to find out more. You’ll also be able to connect with recruiters who are on hand to help you find the right job. And you’ll see when your contacts are celebrating their birthday, a promotion, or a change of job. As you can expect from a network like XING, you’ll also receive suggestions on who to connect with.
Discover and apply for jobs the smart way:
With a XING profile, you’ve got everything you need to apply for vacancies. More and more companies now offer a streamline application process, allowing you to simply click Apply to get the ball rolling. You can also save interesting jobs, create and edit search alerts, manage the status of ongoing applications, and make a note of any upcoming job interviews.
Privacy and T&Cs:
Information about privacy and our T&Cs are available by visiting xing.com/mobile and xing.com/terms. Terms of use for app stores apply.
If you have any questions or comments, please send them to iphone@xing.com

bluejetty:00175059:ios.name: Matter: Reading App
bluejetty:00175059:ios.summary: Finally, a better reading app. The internet is full of things you want to read – articles, newsletters, Twitter threads, PDFs. Matter brings them together in one place and gives you modern tools, like natural text-to-speech and fluid highli
bluejetty:00175059:ios.description:
Finally, a better reading app. The internet is full of things you want to read – articles, newsletters, Twitter threads, PDFs. Matter brings them together in one place and gives you modern tools, like natural text-to-speech and fluid highlighting, to help you read more comfortably and effectively.
"Matter improves vastly on earlier read-later apps like Pocket and Instapaper" 
– The Wall Street Journal
Save anything:
- Save full articles if you're within the paywall (eg. Bloomberg, NYT, WSJ)
- Podcast transcriptions & synced playback
- Save PDFs and YouTube
Read across devices, including Kindle:
- iPhone, iPad, Web
- Send any article to Kindle in 2-taps
Unified inbox for your subscriptions:
- Sync your newsletters by connecting Gmail
- Follow individual writers for their latest posts
- Add any RSS feed
The most elegant reading experience:
- Best-in-class article parsing + readability
- Available offline by default
- Gorgeous night mode
- Human-like text-to-speech
- Fluid highlighting and note-taking
Export your knowledge:
- Sync your highlights to Notion, Obsidian, Roam, Readwise, and others
Matter offers a free service and a Premium service.
The free version of Matter includes:
- Uncapped read-later library
- Mobile & web extensions to save all types of content
- Best-in-class parsing and readability
- Unlimited tags
- Full-text search
- Customizable themes and fonts
In addition to the free features, Matter Premium offers:
- HD text-to-speech for all your articles
- Seamless AI Co-Reader
- Sync your newsletters, subscribe to writers, and add RSS feeds
- Unlimited highlighting, note-taking, and integrations
- Send to Kindle
Payment for Matter Premium will be charged to your iTunes Account when you subscribe. Annual and monthly subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Manage your Matter Premium subscription by going to Matter's Settings page.
Terms of Use: https://hq.getmatter.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://hq.getmatter.com/privacy

bluejetty:00064377:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00064377:ios.description:
Adopt a dog, adopt a cat, find your forever friend — with WeRescue.
Discover the easiest, most inspiring way to adopt pets near you. With hundreds of thousands of adoptable dogs, cats, puppies, kittens, and more, WeRescue helps you find the right match from shelters and fosters across the U.S. and Canada.
WeRescue is the official pet adoption app trusted by the NBCUniversal Local Clear The Shelters campaign since 2018 — a movement that has helped over 1.3 million pets find homes since 2015. This year's campaign runs August 1–31: explore participating shelters near you, see event days and locations at a glance, and watch the national adoption tracker climb.
MEET WERESCUE SCOUT
Not sure where to start? Chat with Scout. Tell Scout what you're hoping for — adopting, fostering, volunteering, or giving — and Scout builds a plan around your life: real matches from thousands of shelters, rescues that need your kind of help, and helpful reads picked just for you.
Whether you're searching for a playful puppy, a cuddly kitten, or a calm senior companion, WeRescue offers the most powerful filters of any pet adoption app — so you can match with exactly the kind of pet you're looking for.
Search adoptable pets near you, including:
• Dogs and puppies
• Cats and kittens
• Rabbits, reptiles, birds, and barnyard animals
• Small and furry pets like guinea pigs, hamsters, and ferrets
• Horses available for adoption
Key Features:
• Chat with Scout to find pets and shelters that fit your life
• Advanced filters for breed, age, size, color, behavior, gender, distance, and 60 more
• Search by mixed breeds, designer breeds, or specific breeds
• High-resolution pet photos to help you fall in love at first sight
• Local results prioritized — see pets in nearby shelters and foster homes first
• Keep tabs on your favorite shelters and pets
• Share adoptable pets with friends via SMS, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and more — they'll see the exact pet you shared, right in the app
Even if you're not ready to adopt, you can help save lives by sharing pets with others. One post can lead to a forever home.
Join thousands of adopters using WeRescue every day to search, share, and save lives. Whether you're actively looking or just browsing, your next best friend might be one swipe away.
Download WeRescue and be part of something bigger.

bluejetty:00070913:ios.description:
What do you think about playing with the funniest, friendliest, and most adorable letters in the world? Oh, and let’s not forget the majestic and lovely unicorn. Sounds great, right?
Bini ABC is home to dozens of games and activities with these wonderful characters that the whole family is sure to enjoy and benefit from.
Cute living letters are the main characters of this app’s games. With their funny laughter and amusing natures, they will instantly lift everyone’s spirits, help you reboot, and engage the whole family’s attention.
In the Bini ABC app, you’ll:
* Find Value in Play
In the Games Room, there are 14 mini-games and -activities that will help you develop memory, concentration, and coordination. Sharpen your mind and feel your mind expand!
* Interact with Lively Letters
In the Gallery of Letters, you’ll find all the main characters of our app. You can dance with them, run with them, and paint them any way you want. Have fun and get to know your letter friends even better!
* Draw and Relax
There are step-by-step drawing lessons available for you to do at your leisure. Learn to draw animals, elements of nature, and other simple objects. Impress your friends and family with your artistic skills!
* Take the First Steps in Language Learning
In the Learning Path, you can listen to how each letter sounds in a particular language. It’s a great way to get used to unfamiliar pronunciation. Discover the sounds of the world through your device!
* Progress through 17 levels
There are hours of educational entertainment to be had in Bini ABC. Keep the app handy for when you need to take a moment for yourself and relax with a magical Unicorn.
Please note: there is only a part of the content from the screenshots available in the free version of the application. To gain access to the whole content, you need to make the in-app purchase.
Subscription Details
After you subscribe to our app you will get full access to ove learning activities. New added topics and games will be automatically available for all subscribers.
You can have free trial period or can decide to subscribe right after download. We provide different subscription options for your convenience: monthly and annual subscription.
If you change your mind at any point, cancellation is easy through your iTunes settings.
● Payment for subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
● Your Subscription automatically renews unless you turned off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of current period.
● You will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
● You can cancel your subscription anytime through your Account Settings without any cancellation fee.
● You can use your subscription on any device registered with your Apple ID.
● If you need help, have questions or just want to say “hi!”, get in touch at feedback@bini.games
● http://teachdraw.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00069372:ios.developer: Beijing Xiaoxiong Bowang Technology Co., Ltd.
bluejetty:00069372:ios.summary: DU Recorder is a reliable, and easy-to-use stream creator and screen recorder. With DU Recorder , you can livestream your screen to YouTube, Facebook and Twitch and record screen videos. DU Recorder makes it easy to livestream and record co
bluejetty:00069372:ios.description:
DU Recorder is a reliable, and easy-to-use stream creator and screen recorder. With DU Recorder , you can livestream your screen to YouTube, Facebook and Twitch and record screen videos. DU Recorder makes it easy to livestream and record content from your screen, like games, live shows, sports, and more.
Advantages: 
- Support audio recording
- Livestream your screen to different platforms
- High-quality screen recording
- Powerful video editing features
Features:
Livestream to YouTube, Facebook and Twitch
Add the screen recording feature to your control center. Simply log in to your YouTube, Facebook and Twitch account, choose the settings as you want, and start livestreaming to YouTube, Facebook and Twitch via the screen recording feature! These handy options give you a better livestreaming experience:
- Support simultaneous recording of microphone and internal audio
- High-quality livestreaming, with various resolution options
- Set your livestream to public, unlisted, or private to protect privacy
- Supports RTMP address
- A variety of live tools: Custom watermark, live themes, live pause settings and more
- Supports Replaykit, for livestreaming directly from Replaykit-compatible games
Screen Recording
Add the screen recording feature to your control center, tap the Record button, and choose DU Recorder to record your screen and save videos to your device. DU Recorder provides stable and fluid screen recording. With this screen recording feature, you can easily record popular mobile game videos, video calls with family and friends, and even popular live shows!
Video Editing
You can easily perform the following video editing operations with the screen recorder:
- Trim video/Remove the middle part of the video
- Add music, choose from a huge variety of music

bluejetty:00164198:ios.description:

年轮中包含“全部”、“今日”和“计划”页面，总览您的卡片和规划您的复习。
在年轮中添加知识卡片，年轮会在您设定的查阅计划的复习时间点提醒您进行复习。默认可以创建艾宾浩斯查阅计划，当然您可以针对您的需要，来创建自定义查阅计划。
查阅计划还支持暂停复习，比如为一场考试来设定查阅计划，考完完成后暂停复习，所有使用查阅计划的卡片都不会再提醒您复习了。
你可以通过文件夹、标签和颜色标记为卡片进行分类。还可以为标签/文件夹设定查阅计划：在标签/文件夹视图中创建的卡片会自动使用对应的查阅计划。
# 年轮
希望您能通过年轮，记忆您所需要以及的知识，通过多次复习不断的巩固、加深记忆，不会忘记。
高效率地规划每张卡片的复习时间，提高记忆效率。
# 功能
- 使用卡片块来编辑卡片内容，支持文本、代码、数学公式、链接、图片和附件。我们还会不断地加入新的卡片块，来更方便地记录记忆资料。
- 创建多个查阅计划，根据自身特点来规划复习时间。
- 通过文件夹、标签、标记等多种方式分类您的卡片。
- 无缝的 iCloud 同步功能，我们尽最大努力来保护您的数据安全。
- 备份/恢复功能。
# 订阅
年轮采用订阅模式，在试用期可以免费试用所有功能。试用期间，最多可创建20张卡片，超过数量限制后，无法创建、编辑卡片。正常的复习与通知功能不受影响。
欢迎试用，不需要订阅和付费。
如果在试用期间，年轮对您有帮助，请订阅来支持我们以及后续开发。
订阅价格可能因地而异。订阅将通过您的 iTunes 账户进行扣款。
订阅会自动续订，除非您在当前订阅期结束至少 24 小时以前停止自动续订。当前订阅激活后不可取消。
购买后，在 App Store 的账户设置中可以管理您的订阅。您购买订阅服务时，任何未使用的免费试用期立即失效。
订阅过期后年轮会进入试用模式。

您可以通过 hello@yeseni.today 与我们联系，我们期待您的反馈！

New Update: Level 11 – Frozen Survival!
Brace yourself for an epic winter battle! Explore the brand-new Level 11: Winter Outbreak, featuring icy landscapes, chilling enemies, and unique frost mechanics that challenge even the toughest survivors. Can you outlast the cold? 
Walkers Attack: Ultimate Action RPG Adventure
Dive into the thrill of "Walkers Attack", an action-packed RPG where your survival hinges on battling through hordes of zombies. Navigate diverse, apocalyptic worlds with a simple, intuitive control system focused on movement and strategy. Are you ready to become humanity's last hope? 
Seamless Action and RPG Depth 
Experience non-stop action with automatic shooting and strategic movement. Collect resources, complete quests, and unlock new, themed levels from Sci-fi to Medieval and Urban. Your arsenal and skills upgrade as you progress, ensuring you're always ready for the next challenge. 
Explore & Survive 
Embark on an epic adventure, exploring vast landscapes filled with the undead. Upgrade your weapons, improve your stats like health, damage, and speed, and customize your strategy to outlast the zombie apocalypse. 
Dynamic Levels and Thrilling Challenges
Each level increases in complexity, offering new environments and tougher zombies. Tackle extra challenges and time trials to test your survival skills to the limit. 
Join the Adventure 
"Walkers Attack" combines the best of action and RPG with simple gameplay, strategic depth, and a compelling narrative. Embrace the challenge, unlock the mysteries, and carve your path through a world teeming with danger. 
Download now and step into the action. Your quest for survival begins here!

bluejetty:00145722:ios.description:
***THE BEST CONTRACTION TIMER APP FOR A POSITIVE BIRTH EXPERIENCE***
The GentleBirth Contraction Timer app combines guidance from the Award Winning GentleBirth Program with a beautiful interface to make tracking contractions/surges easy, effective and stress free. Created by Positive Birth expert, author, midwife and Founder of GentleBirth, Tracy Donegan. 
GentleBirth has guided tens of thousands of parents around to world through their own positive birth experience.
WHAT’S INCLUDED
Track contractions in real time, edit contractions previously recorded, manually add contractions or delete when necessary.
GentleBirth Guidance provides individualized audio labor coaching based on your reported experience as you track each contraction. Using mindfulness, focus and breathing significantly effects pain perception.
Separate background sounds allow you to play sounds in the background of the GentleBirth Guidance, background sounds only, or no audio at all. All easily controlled from one screen.
Beautiful and easy to read charts and statistics allow you to see trends over time. You can change the timeframe to view the information that is most important you at any point during your labor.
Email your surge history and release of water data to yourself or your care-provider directly from the app.
The GentleBirth Indicator analyses the duration and frequency of surges and will notify you when it’s time to go to hospital or if there are patterns of contractions that indicate you should contact your care-provider.
WE’D LOVE TO CONNECT
We want to hear about about your GentleBirth Contraction Timer experience. Please don’t hesitate to reach out to us on social media if you have any feedback or questions about pregnancy, birth, the GentleBirth program or the Contraction Timer app. Email us at team@gentlebirth.com or contact support within the Contraction Timer app.
NOTE
This app does not provide medical advice. Our recommendations are based on standard indicators. Your labor may occur differently. Always consult your care-provider to orient yourself in terms of contraction frequency and duration.
TERMS OF SERVICE
https://gentlebirth.app/terms/
PRIVACY POLICY
https://gentlebirth.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00145876:ios.summary:
Introducing VALPAW, your ultimate companion app for VALORANT!
Elevate your VALORANT experience with VALPAW, the all-in-one app designed to enhance your gameplay.
Whether you're managing your party or tracking your progress, VALPAW has you
bluejetty:00145876:ios.description:
Introducing VALPAW, your ultimate companion app for VALORANT!
Elevate your VALORANT experience with VALPAW, the all-in-one app designed to enhance your gameplay.
Whether you're managing your party or tracking your progress, VALPAW has you covered.
PARTY MANAGEMENT
- Start / Stop the queue
- Manage group invitations and requests with ease.
- Customize settings such as game modes, servers, party codes, and more.
- View current party members, including profiles and ranks.
MISSIONS TRACKING
- Daily Checkpoints: View your current daily checkpoints progress.
- Weekly Missions: Track your current weekly missions, including objectives and progress.
- Queued Up Weeklies: See which weekly missions will become available after completing your current ones.
- Future Weeklies: Preview upcoming weekly missions scheduled for a specific future date.
BATTLE PASS PROGRESS
- Progress: Monitor your current Battle Pass progress, including your current tier and the amount of XP needed to reach the next tier.
- Upcoming Tier Reward: Preview the reward you’ll receive upon completing the current Battle Pass Tier.
LOADOUT CUSTOMIZATION
- Player Card: Customize your current player card.
- Player Title: Update your current player title.
- Skins: Fully personalize your weapon skins with a comprehensive menu. Adjust the skin’s color, select different variants, and add or change the weapon buddy.
- Sprays: Choose and customize your sprays to express your style.
PROFILES
- Profile Overview: Access detailed information about your profile or other players’ profiles.
- Player Information: View essential details such as Name#Tag, Title, Player Card, and current level.
- Match History: Review a player’s match history and see how it affects their ranking.
- Match Details: Dive into specific matches, including data like scoreboards and more in-depth data.
- Intuitive Filter System: Easily filter the data to view only the specific information you’re interested in, providing a tailored view of the player’s profile.
... and much more! But the best part, you can do all this and more, anytime and anywhere!
YOUR FEEDBACK
- VALPAW is developed with the community in mind, and I want to involve you as much as possible.
- Share your feedback and suggestions; your input is invaluable in making VALPAW the best it can be.
- Thank you for being part of this journey and supporting VALPAW!

bluejetty:00184456:ios.description:
The most amazing dice game you can ever play!
Join the only free-to-play multiplayer Yatzy community, that takes Yazty game seriously. Whether you call it yahtzee, yacht, yatzee, yachty, there is only one ultimate version of the dice game - Yatzy Ultimate!
Play alone or against opponents from around the world in a real PvP multiplayer experience. No double rolls, no pay-to-win, no fancy graphics, just a pure form of yatzy being played in our community. Choose from one of the 3 rulesets to play by: Yatzy, Maxi Yatzy and American Yatzy.
Yatzy Ultimate is one of the most popular and fun Yatzy board games that is free to play. We completely reinvented the Yatzy concept based on player inputs and made it more exciting by adding new and unique game features.
Start the journey as a Newbie on Noob Alley, and advance to higher levels using your skills and a little luck. Play Online and Challenge games and soon you’ll become the Ultimate Yatzy Champion.
Build your own buddy list by adding your friends and family, or meet new friends from all over the world. You can challenge your buddies from your buddy list and always have someone to play with.
▪ FEATURES ▪
▪ Multiplayer - play against the best opponents from around the world
▪ Level Up - ranks which will provide you constant challenge playing with more experienced players
▪ Buddies - invite your buddies and play with them
▪ Solo Challenge - don’t feel experienced enough, try the challenge mode and play against yourself for both coins and experience.
▪ Global Leaderboards - beat high scores and climb straight to the top
▪ Chat - Chat with your Buddies
▪ Archive - History of all your games
▪ Bonus - Progressive daily bonus, First Win of the Day, First Loss of the day
▪ HIGHLIGHTS ▪
▪ Play for FREE
▪ Play on any device
▪ 3 Game Modes: Yatzy (Scandinavian), Maxi Yatzy and American Yatzy
▪ Suitable for all ages — play with all your friends and family!
▪ Play'n'wait - if you want to challenge yourself to a classical game with some experienced opponents.
▪ Available in 8 languages: English, French, German, Danish, Swedish, Spanish, Russian and Turkish
Let us know your suggestions and improvements or issues/bugs you have: support@snowballgames.io.
Let's roll!

bluejetty:00023505:ios.description:
GtrLib Chords – The Ultimate Guitar Chord Library
Unlock the full potential of your guitar playing with GtrLib Chords, the most comprehensive and easy-to-use chord reference for guitarists of all levels. Whether you're just starting out and need a reliable guide to essential chords or you're an advanced player looking to explore complex voicings and inversions, this app provides everything you need to learn, practice, and master guitar chords with confidence and precision.
With an extensive library of thousands of chords, including multiple voicings, suggested finger positions, and audio demonstrations, this app provides everything you need to expand your chord vocabulary and improve your playing.
Key Features:
Comprehensive Chord Library
• Explore a vast collection of chords in every key, including major, minor, diminished, augmented, suspended, extended, and more.
• View all possible chord variations, inversions, and positions across the fretboard.
• Learn chord placements from the open position to the highest frets.
Learn & Play with Confidence
• Suggested fingerings to improve technique and efficiency.
• Audio playback to hear how every chord sounds before playing.
• Fretboard visualization for better understanding of chord structures.
Quick Search & Instant Access
• Built-in search to find any chord instantly.
• Spotlight search integration to locate chords directly from your device.
Customize Your Experience
• Left-handed mode for left-handed guitarists.
• Key switching to transpose chords effortlessly.
• Dark mode support for a visually comfortable experience.
Export, Share & Save
• Export chords as PNG or MIDI files for easy reference or music production.
• Use exported MIDI files in DAWs like GarageBand, Logic Pro, Ableton Live, and FL Studio.
• Print or share chords with students, bandmates, or collaborators.
Designed for Everyone
• VoiceOver accessibility for visually impaired users.
• User-friendly interface for smooth navigation and ease of use.
Who Is GtrLib Chords For?
• Beginners – Learn fundamental chords with clear diagrams and audio playback.
• Intermediate & advanced guitarists – Explore complex voicings, inversions, and extended chords.
• Songwriters & composers – Quickly find the perfect chord for any song.
• Guitar teachers & students – Use it as a reliable teaching and learning tool.
• Producers & musicians – Integrate MIDI chord files into music production.
Why Choose GtrLib Chords?
Unlike generic chord books or basic online chord finders, GtrLib Chords provides:
• A massive, well-organized chord library with multiple variations.
• Fingering recommendations to improve accuracy.
• Audio demonstrations to help you recognize chords by ear.
• Offline access for anytime, anywhere learning.
• High-quality exports for musicians, songwriters, and educators.
Download GtrLib Chords Today!
Discover a powerful, easy-to-use tool designed for guitarists of all levels. Whether you're practicing, performing, or composing, GtrLib Chords will help you unlock the full potential of your guitar playing.
Get started now and take your guitar skills to the next level!

bluejetty:00121945:ios.description:
The Long Night has come. Beneath the endless snow, an ancient kingdom lies in ruin. 
You are the last ranger.This is not a war of conquest. It is a journey of survival, bonds, and rebirth.
DAY 1: The Darkfall
An eternal winter devours the land—awaken among the ruins. Your first lesson: survive.
DAY 7: Breakthrough
Hunted by shadows, carve your way through the brink. No retreat. Only forward.
DAY 10: Seek the Legendary Weapon
Descend into forgotten crypts. Claim a lost relic and awaken its runic power.
DAY 15: Rally the Company
Gather survivors in the frozen wilds—a shieldmaiden, a mage, a dwarven warrior. Alone you fall. Together, you rise.
DAY 20: Strike Back
Lead your company against the dark legion. Steel and sorcery clash. For the first time, the darkness fears.
DAY 30: Rebuild the Homeland
The long night fades. Dawn returns. Raise the first tower from the ruins—this is the dawn of a new realm.
Key Features
Dynamic Doom World
Rifts, frozen terrain, scattered resources—every run is a new struggle for survival.
Legendary Weapon Progression
From ancient relics to forged masterpieces. Each weapon holds unique runes and evolves with you.
Bond & Recruitment System
Recruit companions with their own stories. Your choices shape their loyalties and fates.
Homestead & Legacy
Every stone you place becomes your mark. Your stronghold endures, and each rebuild adds a new verse to your legend.
Frostfall Season Events
Limited-time challenges—dragon invasions, rift anomalies. Earn exclusive skins and legendary blueprints.
Ranger Alliances
Form guilds, defend settlements, and vie for control of the rare Eternal Springs in guild wars.
The Long Night won’t end on its own. Ranger, take up your bow…

bluejetty:00083367:ios.description:
Welcome to Farm Merge, a casual game that combines planting, collecting, merging, and fighting. Here, you'll meet a group of friends with different personalities and unique experiences, and build a farm with them. Plant crops, fulfill orders, raise various cute animals, and enjoy the fun of pastoral life. As your farm grows, You'll also unlock buildings such as railway stations and ports, participate in crop trade, and bring further development to the farm. Turn yourself into a boss, making this place more and more bustling!
Now, let's forget about the tired and hectic life for a while, and start a decompression and healing farm journey!
Game Features:
-The farm is rich in products, hundreds of illustrated book items, a wide variety, unlock as much as you want.
-Merging 3 identical items can be upgraded to a higher level; Merging 5 identical items will be even more cost-effective.
-Merging cute pets can get more hearts and unlock more land.

bluejetty:00098090:android.description:
Awaken your survival instinct - Let's fight!
INTRODUCTION
Food Land - Survival is an action role-playing, shooting, hand-to-hand fight, time-based survival, adventure game with roguelite elements. This is a survival game with a completely new storyline, different from other kinds of survival. Besides overly familiar topics such as shooting zombies or fantasy creatures, Food Land - Survival offers a story that is both intimate and novel about the battle of food heroes with insects.
Nowhere else to run or hide, the only choice is to fight to survive.
PLOT
Our food friends have been arrested by the zombies. The insects and vermin are gathering to attack. They had the ambition of devouring it all. 
It is an emergency, let’s fight now!
Become a hero of chivalry, survive and take the responsibility of surviving to achieve a heroic end. You will play as food characters and survive through the battle by killing all vermin. Red pepper - Charlie survivor, Pumpkin - Jack survivor, Banana - Bart survivor, Brotato Bob survivor, ... Each character has different powers and strengths, choose a favorite character for yourself and destroy zombie enemies with powerful weapons in your survival fight.
HOW TO PLAY
Control the character with joystick, the character's weapons will automatically attack the nearest enemy. Remaining survival for a given period of time, you will pass the game. After eliminating all the monsters and vermin at each stage, your character will gain experience and level up. When the zombie enemies are destroyed, there are hero coins that will be automatically collected at the end of the survival day. Use the accumulated coins to equip and upgrade the most advanced weapons. Besides, pay attention to your HP bar to prolong your survival because it won’t be regenerated.
FEATURE
1. Variety of characters with different kinds of power
There are different classes of food heroes who will join in this survival battle. You can choose to become pumpkin hero - Jack survivor with damage resistance, banana hero - Bart survivor with variable speed movement ability, pepper hero - Charlie survivor with powerful damage resistance,… Dozens of survival characters with distinguished abilities await your discovery.
2. Diversity of weapons, combine them to deal higher damage.
Choose to use high-damage weapons such as crossbows, bows, darts, shotguns, bazoka,... Or defend yourself with everyday items like fists, rocks, boxing, etc. You can use up to 6 weapons at the same time to survive the crowd. Playing with Boomerang survival, Kunai survival, Mystic Harp survival, Lightsaber survival,… hundreds of remarkable weapons. Upgrade through battles, combine and reinforce different skills, and fight your way to be the strongest in the survival game!
3. Surviving through a swarming mob of zombie insects by destroying them all
Through the survival battle, the more the crowd vermin zombie, the more formidable they are. Be always careful, especially with the last zombie bosses and their fury.
4. Multiple items to help you increase your in-game survival
Bonus little gifts in the game will randomly fall out, instant immunity, instant coin magnet, speed-up movement help you maintain your enduring fighting power in survival combat.
5. Lively shooting sound combined with fantasy background music.
Starting with "Food Land - Survival" - Fight alone, survive to be unstoppable!
Food Land - Survival is one of many free games created by TQC. If you are into playing survival games, simulation games, running games, free games, popular games, try Food Land - Survival.
We aim to be the leading popular game company, creating fun free games, simulator games and compelling role-playing games.
In the future, we will try our best to bring you more game modes including infinity mode and multiplayer mode for you and your friends to fight together.
Share your survival fighting gameplay and comments - we'd love to hear your opinion!

bluejetty:00169759:ios.description:
Recommended by CNN and Lonely Planet, this is Shenzhen's best subway map! Up-to-date with all the metro lines; Works offline; Routeplanner, GPS, Street maps; English and Chinese included.
Download the app completely free! The free app is ad-supported. Upgrade to VIP features if you'd like to get extra features, remove ads and support future development!
WHY EXPLOREMETRO?
1. Fully up-to-date
Accurate metro map, includes every station on every line. Free updates for future station openings and timetable changes.
2. Designed for iPhone
Our gorgeous maps have been fully redesigned for all iPhone devices. Runs on all iOS10-14 devices.
3. Designed for iPad 
Specially redesigned interface for the larger iPad screen with split screen. Drag and drop station names, tips, maps and timetables into other apps.
4. Street maps for every station 
Need to get your bearings at a station? Integrated Street maps show you metro exits and nearby streets for every station.
5. Route-planner 
A really easy route-planner. Get route and time information for any journey with just three taps.
6. "Find my nearest station" 
Using your GPS, see a list of the closest metro stations to your current location.
7. Works offline 
Everything works without an Internet connection. Search stations and plan routes on the go.
UPGRADE TO VIP FOR EVEN MORE FEATURES
I've been developing this app for 9 years. Upgrading to VIP helps support future development of the app. VIP users get additional features, like NO ADS, accurate prices for every journey, first/last train times, offline street maps, tips at every station, and a general warm fuzzy feeling.
REVIEWS
CNN Travel: "These maps are very easy on the eye and simple to navigate. They work offline and also include free updates of stations that have yet to be completed, operating hours and schedules." 
Lonely Planet: "Easy to use, up to date and work offline. Very handy, especially when they've run out of paper maps at the stations."
SUGGESTIONS
We'd love to hear your comments and suggestions on ways to improve the app. Please contact us via support@exploremetro.com, as we can't respond to comments left in the reviews.

bluejetty:00022502:ios.description:
Welcome to RAID & RUSH! Assemble a team of heroes, set out on an adventure, and fight to protect your gold in an action-packed strategy RPG!
Brave Knights, deadly Archers, powerful Mages, and other unique heroes are ready for battle and await your command. Build your squad, plan your formation, and don't let the enemy reach your cart full of gold!
CLASSIC ADVENTURE:
● Assemble a squad of unique heroes with different abilities and fighting styles.
● Position your heroes around the gold cart, plan your strategy, and fight off waves of incoming enemies.
● Protect your gold at all costs! The more gold reaches the finish line, the more stars you earn.
● Explore new lands, complete levels, and battle Orcs, Dragons, and other dangerous enemies.
● Open chests, unlock new heroes, and grow stronger with every adventure.
● Replay completed levels, change your strategy, and fight for the maximum reward.
HEROES & STRATEGY:
● Collect heroes of different classes and create your own powerful battle combinations.
● Upgrade your heroes, improve their abilities, and make your squad even stronger.
● Experiment with team compositions and formations — sometimes putting the right hero in the right place can change the entire battle.
● Adapt your strategy to different enemies and powerful bosses.
● Build a team capable of taking on any challenge!

bluejetty:00027151:ios.name: FAR AIM by Flightready
bluejetty:00027151:ios.summary:
A comprehensive, easy-to-use FAR/AIM with powerful search, personalized regulation filters, and advanced annotations. Try any subscription free for one month, or purchase lifetime access with a single payment.
COMPREHENSIVE AVIATION REGULA
bluejetty:00027151:ios.description:
A comprehensive, easy-to-use FAR/AIM with powerful search, personalized regulation filters, and advanced annotations. Try any subscription free for one month, or purchase lifetime access with a single payment.
COMPREHENSIVE AVIATION REGULATIONS
▸ All of Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations, including Parts 1, 43, 48, 61, 65, 67, 68, 71, 73, 91, 97, 103, 105, 107, 110, 117, 119, 121, 135, 136, 137, 141, and 142.
▸ Title 49 Parts 172 and 175 (HazMat), 830 (NTSB), and 1544 and 1552 (TSA).
▸ Every section of the FAA Aeronautical Information Manual (AIM), including the original figures.
▸ The complete Pilot/Controller Glossary.
▸ Updated regularly with the latest content.
FARs FILTERED FOR YOUR USE CASE
▸ Filter regulations by use case: General Aviation, Sport Pilot, Private Pilot, Instrument Rating, Commercial Pilot, Flight Instructor, Flight Crew, Remote Pilot, or Maintenance.
▸ Your selected filter applies to FAR lists, search results, and the Next and Previous buttons in the reader. Choose All Regulations to see everything.
POWERFUL SEARCH
▸ Search every document at once, or limit a search to the FAR, AIM, Pilot/Controller Glossary, NTSB, HazMat, or TSA.
▸ Search exact phrases using quotation marks, combine terms with OR, and exclude terms with a minus sign.
▸ Narrow searches to a specific FAR Part, section titles, or whole words.
▸ Search results include preview lines with matching terms highlighted.
▸ Sort results by relevance or document order.
▸ Matches within the section you’re reading appear first and are highlighted on the page. Navigate between matches one by one (iOS 17.2 and later).
ANNOTATIONS
▸ Bookmark any section, add notes, and highlight text in five colors.
▸ Give sections custom names and organize them with color tags.
▸ Manage all annotations in one place, with filters for type, document, or tag.
▸ Automatically sync annotations across your Apple devices using iCloud.
▸ Optionally create a FlightReady account to back up your bookmarks, notes, highlights, tags, and reading history and keep them synchronized across devices.
MORE FEATURES
▸ Reading history organized by day.
▸ Email, print, or share any FAR section, AIM paragraph, or glossary definition.
▸ Adjustable text size with support for iOS Dynamic Type.
▸ Light and dark themes, or automatic switching to match your system settings.
▸ Portrait and landscape orientations, with multitasking support on iPad.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Start with a free one-month trial on any subscription. Free trials automatically convert to paid subscriptions unless canceled before the trial ends.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. To cancel a subscription or free trial, open Settings, tap your name, then Subscriptions. You can also manage subscriptions in the App Store by tapping your profile picture and selecting Subscriptions. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.
All FAR/AIM content comes from public sources, including the Federal Aviation Administration and the Government Publishing Office.
Terms of Service: https://www.flightready.net/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://www.flightready.net/privacy-policy/
Customer Service: https://www.flightready.net

SportNinja is the leading real-time Digital Scoring and streaming app, providing live updates to players, league 
officials and followers. A comprehensive suite of League and Team Management functionality in a single, integrated platform on web and mobile.
Steps to get started (as a Player / Team Rep / Official): 
1. Download the SportNinja app. It’s FREE for participants
2. Click the invitation email (which you will receive from your team/ league via SportNinja) and follow the steps to Join. 
3. OR, track teams and competitions by searching and starring, using the Following tab.
Steps to get started (as a League Owner / Admin):
1. Download the SportNinja app and create an Account.
2. Log into the Web platform www.sportninja.com to complete your organization set up.
3. Invite Team Reps, Officials, Players in with the appropriate roles,, to download and join their teams, etc..
We are continuously working to improve the app with updates and new features. We would love to hear your feedback - info@sportninja.com.

bluejetty:00145858:ios.description:
▣ 遊戲介紹 ▣
天下風雲出我輩，一入江湖歲月催。
皇圖霸業談笑中，不勝人生一場醉。
都說武俠是成年人的童話，可是兒時的大俠夢，你們，還記得嗎？
《武林英雄傳》是一款放置類武俠遊戲，日常僅需「10分鐘」，「無定點活動」超佛系，能夠真正的了解並滿足諸多武俠迷的訴求。
遊戲內有多達「十四個門派」可供選擇，更有「上千本神功密卷」等你來拿！
自古正邪不兩立，行俠成魔一念間！
在這片純粹的武俠凈土裡，路見不平，你可以拔刀相助；一言不合，也可以揮劍相向。
休戚一體的幫派兄弟會在萬眾矚目的戰場上演繹一場巔峰之戰，知根知底的同門也可能為了一個寶藏而大打出手......
絕世武功、神兵利器、知己紅顏......你想要的，這裡都有！
▣ 特色玩法介紹▣
【 十四門派】：逐鹿爭鋒，江湖豪俠群龍無首，亟待英豪出世一統江湖。江湖代有高人出，各領風騷數百年。想要與諸多同門一起振興師門嗎？武當、少林、丐幫、峨眉、華山、全真、古墓、血刀、明教、銅人、大理、逍遙...精研門派武學，帶給你最純粹的江湖體驗！
【上千武學】： 桃花影落飛神劍，碧海潮生弄玉簫。在這裡，共有1000多種武俠迷耳熟能詳的經典武學可供選擇。初入江湖的小蝦米可集眾家之長於一身，通過戰鬥與歷練不斷地磨礪自己的武學，最終成為名動江湖的一代大俠。
【決戰巔峰】：十載寒窗無人問，一舉成名天下知。江湖上不僅有生死與共的朋友，更有許多肝膽相照的對手。只需要將自己的戰力提升到門派前二，即可代表師門出戰，與各派高手決戰巔峰！作為武林中的一顆新星，你準備好接受歡呼了嗎？
【 歸藏風雲】：沙場烽火連胡月，海畔雲山擁薊城。大宋積弱，四方夷狄蠢蠢欲動。值此危難之際，身懷絕世武學的你，又會做出怎樣的選擇？
【比武擂台】：自古文無第一，武無第二。這個江湖中，誰才是真正的強者？我們擂台見！
【江湖歷練】：閱盡紅塵惹一笑,從此別去自逍遙。受夠了在乏味的掛機中無休止的等待？豐富的劇情事件、貼心的快速歷練，讓你不再為每日的瑣事掛心！江湖，就是要快意恩仇！
【絕境秘地】：匹夫無罪，懷璧其罪。尋寶的路上不知有多少宵小在暗中窺伺。憑你幾路來，我只一路去。雖萬千人，吾往矣！
【陣法大師】：運籌帷幄之中，決勝千裏之外。文武雙全的你，快快靈活運用各類陣法，在一次次戰鬥中脫穎而出吧！
▣ 官方粉絲團▣
如果喜歡我們的遊戲，想要第一時間掌握遊戲最新動態，就請關註我們的FB粉絲專頁和官方網頁
◈ 立刻前往官方網頁：https://wulin.tecogames.com/
◈ 立刻前往FB粉絲團：fb.com/wulines/

bluejetty:00144587:ios.description:
RG Digital SP é o aplicativo oficial de identidade digital do Instituto de Identificação da Polícia Civil de São Paulo.
Agora você pode ter o seu RG Digital de São Paulo sempre disponível no seu dispositivo celular. RG Digital SP é um aplicativo gratuito que proporciona maior privacidade de dados, segurança e praticidade ao se identificar.
IMPORTANTE:
Para utilizar o RG Digital SP, verifique se a sua carteira de identidade possui Código QR na parte interna (disponível no RG impresso emitido a partir de 02/2014).
A versão digital através do RG Digital SP é válida em todo o território nacional e possui o mesmo valor jurídico da versão impressa.
Para a sua segurança, este aplicativo não pode ser utilizado em dois ou mais dispositivos ao mesmo tempo.
Confira os benefícios de se identificar no seu dia a dia através da versão digital:
Acesso ao seu RG Digital, independentemente de conectividade à internet, após a conclusão da primeira validação do documento;
Armazenamento e transporte das suas informações de identificação com maior segurança por meio de proteção biométrica e senha;
A versão digital dispensa cópia autenticada em cartório, uma vez que é válida assim como o documento impresso;
Identidade digital na palma da sua mão através do dispositivo celular para ter acesso a serviços de instituições públicas e privadas;
Inclusão e gerenciamento de documentos de identificação de filhos e dependentes no aplicativo;
Possibilidade de compartilhar cópia segura, assinada digitalmente com certificado digital, compatível e adequado aos padrões ICP-Brasil.
COMO UTILIZAR O RG DIGITAL:
Passo 1: Instale o aplicativo RG Digital SP no seu dispositivo celular. Para o primeiro acesso, é necessário ter em mãos a versão impressa emitida após fevereiro de 2014.
Passo 2: Identifique o Código QR na parte interna do seu RG impresso e siga as instruções para validação do código e verificação biométrica do seu rosto.
Passo 3: Pronto! Agora é só aguardar a confirmação dos seus dados.
Em poucos minutos, o seu RG Digital estará disponível no seu dispositivo celular para maior praticidade e segurança.
O RG Digital SP é um aplicativo Instituto de Identificação Ricardo Gumbleton Daunt - Polícia Civil desenvolvido através da prestação de serviço pela empresa Valid.
Copyright: @VALID

bluejetty:00042017:ios.name: Weight Loss Bet by HealthyWage
bluejetty:00042017:ios.summary: Win up to $10,000 by making a "bet" on your own weight loss, or by participating in one of our many weight loss and fitness challenges. There’s a reason we paid out millions to our participants last year - our challenges are fun, effective,
bluejetty:00042017:ios.description:
Win up to $10,000 by making a "bet" on your own weight loss, or by participating in one of our many weight loss and fitness challenges. There’s a reason we paid out millions to our participants last year - our challenges are fun, effective, and people love to win money for losing weight!
According to one of our participants, “HealthyWage has flipped on a switch that I just couldn’t seem to get clicked on by myself. Not sure, or what science is behind it, but this...is astounding!”
Time and again, we've provided participants with the motivation to get healthier that they've been searching for. In fact, 45% of our participants report weight loss¹ when participating in a HealthyWage Challenge, with an average prize payout of $1,386². Oh, and we DO know the science behind it. We’re kind of nerdy like that!
Check out some of the features you’ll enjoy with the HealthyWage app:
- Take and post-victory and before-and-after photos
- Participate with a vibrant community for support and accountability
- Keep track of your weight loss and your progress toward hitting your goal (and winning money!)
- Track your step activity throughout the day
- Create and submit your beginning and ending weigh-in verification videos
- Access your winnings to cash out or begin another challenge
- Keep an eye on your standing among other players
- Build friendships, get inspired by others success, and practice your best cheerleading skills
- Easily find and enter new challenges
There are 4 different types of HealthyWage Challenges you can join through the app. Those are:
The HealthyWager
Win up to $10,000 in an individual weight loss bet. Set the terms using the Prize Calculator (you choose your weight loss goal, wager amount, etc.). Play with the calculator all you like without commitment.
$10,000 Team Challenge
Teams of five compete to win cash prizes -- first prize is $10,000.
Jackpot Challenges
Individuals and teams try to achieve specific weight loss goals to earn a share of the pot.
Step Challenge
Individuals and teams connect step devices to calculate a custom goal. Achieve the step goal and earn a share of the pot! Devices available: Apple Health (Apple phones and watches via HealthKit), Garmin and Fitbit.
HealthyWage's weight loss challenges have been featured on the Today show, Good Morning America, CNN, ABC News, NBC News, Fox News, and in The Wall Street Journal & The New York Times.
From our participants:
“HealthyWage is great for motivation. People have good intentions but lack the motivation. After having to stick with it for a period of time, that helps you change your habits for good and a healthy lifestyle becomes your new habit.”
"HealthyWage really exploited my competitive nature and used it to work for me!”
“There's nothing better than losing weight, feeling great, getting healthy AND winning money at the same time!"
"Putting up my own money definitely helped me win...the thought of the prize kept me focused. And, as weight started to come off, I was very excited about the process. It was not as hard as I thought it would be once I got my mind focused. I would definitely (and have) recommended this program to my friends! For people who are competitive, it will definitely motivate them to win!”
“I would not have seen the results I got without HealthyWage. It offers something totally unique and takes away all the excuse.”
Once you experience the thrill of HealthyWage, you'll never go back to struggling on your own. Try it and see for yourself! Start a diet, bet on it, and win big! Losing weight and getting active with HealthyWage pays off in more ways than one!
¹As reported by HealthyWage participants from June 2023 through June 2024. Stat will be updated at least annually.
²The average prize amount varies seasonally. The average listed here includes all new bets created from June 2023 through June 2024 and will be updated periodically.

bluejetty:00087109:ios.name: Clippit: AI Text To Speech
bluejetty:00087109:ios.summary: Turn any PDF, article, note, or screenshot into audio you can listen to anywhere. Clippit is a powerful text-to-speech app that transforms your reading list into a personal, podcast‑style listening experience, perfect for commutes, workouts
bluejetty:00087109:ios.description:
Turn any PDF, article, note, or screenshot into audio you can listen to anywhere. Clippit is a powerful text-to-speech app that transforms your reading list into a personal, podcast‑style listening experience, perfect for commutes, workouts, or study sessions.
Clippit doesn’t just read text aloud. It turns your content into natural, conversational audio that feels like your favorite podcast.
"Clippit revolutionized how I consume content. Instead of spending hours reading, I can now listen during my commute or walk to college." - Elliot G.
WHY LISTEN INSTEAD OF READ?
Clippit helps you reclaim your time and stay on top of what matters by turning any text into engaging audio:
- Study smarter: Convert lecture notes, slides, and online study guides into a podcast-style review.
- Stay informed on the go: Turn long-form articles, reports, and newsletters into audio you can listen to hands-free.
Audio learning has been shown to improve retention, save time, and enable true multitasking. Clippit makes that accessible for anything you read.
WHAT MAKES CLIPPIT DIFFERENT?
Most text-to-speech apps sound robotic and monotonous. Clippit gives you:
- Podcast-style conversations: Your content is synthesized into a back-and-forth between multiple speakers, so it feels like you’re listening to a real show.
- Voices inspired by your favorite hosts: Choose from different voice styles and tones to match the kind of podcast you love.
- Smart synthesis: Clippit doesn’t just read text; it summarizes and structures it into a more listenable, flowing conversation.
WHAT OUR COMMUNITY IS SAYING
"I love the way the app turns my study notes and class readings into entertaining podcasts while emulating my favourite podcast online" - Emily M.
"I started using NotebookLM, but when I found this app it made it so much easier to listen to content on the go. It does a great job synthesizing the content uploaded and creates a very listenable conversation" - Jennifer S.
"It’s so funny to create podcast clips that sound like Joe Rogan and Alex Cooper" - Daniel Z.
"It’s so much easier to listen to a podcast version of my notes and online study guides to help me study" - Sam R.
FEATURES
- Intelligent Content Import: Easily import PDFs, articles, notes, screenshots, and links. Clippit’s smart content recognition pulls out the text and gets it ready for audio.
- 2-Speaker Conversation Style: Turn dry text into a dynamic two-speaker conversation. Choose from a variety of voice styles inspired by popular podcasters and adjust the duration of each episode.
- Topic Generation: Not sure where to start? Use AI-powered suggestions to generate engaging audio content on any topic, from class subjects to industry trends.
- Customizable Playback: Listen your way, change playback speed, skip forward or back 15 seconds, and pick up right where you left off.
GO PRO
Unlock the full power of Clippit with Clippit Pro:
- Unlimited text-to-audio generations from unlimited sources
- 2-speaker podcast clips
- 10+ high-quality voice options
Need help? Contact us at hi@clippit.fm
Terms of Use: https://mep.sh/clipslm/terms

bluejetty:00153386:ios.description:
Dive into a colorful world of yarn in Yarn Town and enjoy the fun of collecting and matching!
Welcome to Yarn Town, a charming little village made entirely of yarn, buttons, and dreams. As the town’s newest resident, you’re entrusted with a special task: help restore the town’s color and vibrancy by collecting magical yarns hidden within whimsical models.
Your mission is simple but delightful — observe the target yarn color and tap the matching yarns on the model to collect them. Match three of the same color to weave a dazzling combination! With constantly shifting colors and clever combinations, every level blends strategy and luck in a delightful challenge.
Each yarn you collect brings life back to the town: light up the Yarn Bakery’s glowing sign, repair the threads of the Spinning Windmill, or help the shy Button Cat decorate her cozy yarn nest.
Are you ready to become the hero who weaves joy back into the heart of Yarn Town?
Join this creative and challenging adventure today — and see if you can become a true master of collecting!

bluejetty:00167773:ios.description:
Get a health check for yourself and your relatives with the Ada App.
You can access a symptom checker 24/7 to find out possible causes.
Whatever’s bothering you, from pain, headache, or anxiety to allergy or food intolerance, the free Ada App connects you to an assessment where you can find answers from the comfort of your home.
How does the free app work?
You access the symptom assessment by tapping on a button in the app.
The symptom assessment will open and you answer simple questions about your health and symptoms.

The symptom assessment will open and you answer simple questions about your health and symptoms.
The AI of the Ada assessment evaluates your answers against its medical dictionary of thousands of disorders and medical conditions.
You receive a personalized assessment report that tells you what may be wrong and what you could do next.
What can you expect from our app?
Data privacy and security – we apply the strictest data regulations to protect and keep your information private.
Access to smart results – the app is connected to the core system which combines medical knowledge with intelligent technology.
Health assessment report – share relevant information with your doctor by accessing and exporting your historical assessment reports.
24/7 access – you can access the free symptom checker anytime, anywhere.
Available in 7 languages – choose your language and change it from the settings at any point: English, German, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Swahili and Romanian.
This app connects users to a CE-marked medical device.
Detailed information regarding our medical quality standards is available here: [https://about.ada.com/medical-quality/]
CAUTION: the services/features that you access through the Ada App cannot give you a medical diagnosis. Contact urgent care immediately in an emergency. Ada does not replace your healthcare professional's advice or an appointment with your doctor.
We want to hear from you. If you have any feedback or just want to get in touch, reach us at support@ada.com. Your feedback will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy. [https://ada.com/raw/privacy-policy/]

bluejetty:00186747:ios.description:
Embark on a prehistoric adventure with Dinosaur Farm – an enthralling and educational game specially crafted for preschoolers and toddlers. This unique game merges the fascinating world of dinosaurs with traditional farm activities, providing a distinctive and engaging preschool education experience through interactive learning games.
Key Features of Dinosaur Farm:
• Educational Games: Dinosaur Farm combines fun with educational content, allowing children to explore a world where dinosaurs and farming coexist.
• Preschool Education Reinvented: Designed for children aged 2-5, this game introduces basic concepts of farming and dinosaur knowledge in an interactive environment.
• Animal Games for Kids with a Dinosaur Twist: Unlike traditional farm games, kids will interact with dinosaurs, learning about these magnificent creatures while understanding the importance of care for animals.
• Unique Farm Games: Children get to participate in farming activities alongside dinosaurs, offering a blend of learning and excitement.
• Innovative Tractor Games: Drive a tractor in a prehistoric setting, engaging in construction games that are both educational and immensely fun.
• Tailored Games for Toddlers: Dinosaur Farm is perfectly suited for toddlers, introducing them to the basics of farming and paleontology in a captivating way.
• Learning Games: The game encourages learning through play, making complex concepts like paleontology and agriculture accessible and enjoyable for young minds.
• Child-Friendly Gameplay: With an intuitive interface, Dinosaur Farm is easy and safe for children to play.
• Offline Games for Access Anywhere: Playable without an internet connection, this game is great for entertainment on the go.
• Brain Games for Cognitive Development: Over 30 interactive animations stimulate young brains, making learning about dinosaurs and farming engaging and effective.
• No Third-Party Ads: Enjoy a safe, focused environment for uninterrupted learning.
• A New Angle on Learning Through Play: Dinosaur Farm offers a unique approach to learning, combining the intrigue of dinosaurs with the practicality of farming.
Parents, use Dinosaur Farm as a tool to discuss topics like environmental stewardship, the history of life on Earth, and the basics of agriculture. It's more than just a game; it's a comprehensive educational journey into a world where prehistoric creatures and modern farming techniques coexist. Let your children's imagination and knowledge grow with Dinosaur Farm!
About Yateland:
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00045108:ios.description:
Transform any occasion into an unforgettable adventure with Scavos! Whether for birthdays, events, or just casual fun, Scavos offers engaging scavenger hunts you can create or join with friends. Packed with puzzles, photo challenges, and real-time leaderboards, it’s all about having a blast together.
*New Adventure Assistant*
Introducing the Adventure Assistant: Instantly create a scavenger hunt by answering a few questions! Adventure Assistant generates ~20 unique missions, a catchy title, description, and a fun cover photo—making it easier than ever to jump into the action.
Key Features:
- Adventure Assistant: Quickly create custom hunts with AI-generated missions based on your input.
- Play Anywhere: Host hunts at any location or remotely, allowing players to join from different places.
- Photo & Video Missions: Capture moments to complete challenges with a real-time leaderboard to track progress.
- Riddle & Quiz Missions: Add a twist to your hunt with riddle and quiz challenges that engage players' problem-solving skills.
- Photo-Enhanced Prompts: Attach images to prompts, enabling missions like "recreate this pose" or "find this landmark."
- Quest & Scramble Modes: Complete missions in order with 'Quest' mode, or tackle them in any order with 'Scramble' mode.
- Mission Gallery: Browse all photos and videos captured during the hunt, organized by mission, and download them as a .zip file.
- Compete or Collaborate: Choose competitive or collaborative gameplay to match your group’s mood.
- Quick Comments: Instantly comment on submissions to keep the fun going.
- Tours: Discover professionally designed scavenger hunts that mix guided walking tours with escape-room-style puzzles.
- Player Slots & Player Packs: Each game has 3 free Player Slots. Purchase additional slots through the "Player Pack" in-app purchase to allow more players to join.
Download Scavos today and start exploring!
